title: Characteristic Mode Analysis of Composite Nanostructures using a Coupled System of Volume Integral and Hydrodynamic Equations
summary: Full-structure and sub-structure characteristic mode analysis (CMA) formulations are developed for composite metallic--dielectric nanostructures based on a coupled system of volume integral equations (VIE) and the hydrodynamic equation (HDE). In the full-structure CMA, the generalized eigenvalue equation (GEE) is constructed from the matrix of the complete coupled system, and the resulting characteristic currents describe the response of the entire composite nanostructure. In the sub-structure CMA, the GEE is constructed from a reduced system, derived from the coupled system by eliminating the dielectric-region unknowns, so that it is expressed only in terms of the metallic-region currents. This isolates the resonances of the metallic region while still incorporating the effect of the dielectric region through the reduced system. Because the reduced system has a smaller dimension, the sub-structure CMA is computationally more efficient than the full-structure CMA and, when the dielectric does not resonate in the frequency range of interest, identifies the same resonances. Both formulations are validated against extinction cross-section (ECS) results and are used to characterize how a dielectric environment reshapes the metallic resonances, including substrate-induced red-shifts and, for high-contrast substrates in direct contact, hybridized modal responses.

AI.tldr: 本文基于体积积分方程（VIE）与流体动力学方程（HDE）耦合系统，为复合金属-介电纳米结构发展了全结构和子结构特征模式分析（CMA）公式。全结构CMA从完整耦合系统的矩阵构造广义特征值方程（GEE），描述整个复合结构响应；子结构CMA通过消去介电区域未知量构造缩减系统，仅用金属区域电流表达，隔离金属共振同时仍包含介电区域影响，且计算效率更高。两种公式均通过消光截面（ECS）结果验证，并用于表征介电环境如何重塑金属共振。
AI.motivation: 复合金属-介电纳米结构在纳米光子学中具有重要应用，但缺乏一种系统化的特征模式分析方法来分解和理解其共振行为。现有的CMA方法难以同时处理金属的等离子体响应和介电区域的电磁响应，需要开发新的全结构和子结构分析框架。
AI.method: 基于体积积分方程（VIE）和流体动力学方程（HDE）的耦合系统，发展两种CMA公式：(1) 全结构CMA——直接从完整耦合系统的矩阵构造广义特征值方程，特征电流描述整个复合结构的响应；(2) 子结构CMA——通过消去介电区域未知量得到缩减系统，仅用金属区域电流表达，在保留介电区域效应的同时隔离金属共振，且因维度更小而计算效率更高。
AI.result: 两种CMA公式均通过消光截面（ECS）结果验证。子结构CMA在介电区域不共振的频率范围内能识别与全结构CMA相同的共振，且计算效率更高。两种方法成功表征了介电环境对金属共振的重塑作用，包括基底诱导的红移以及高对比度基底直接接触时产生的混合模态响应。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为复合金属-介电纳米结构提供了两种互补的CMA分析工具：全结构CMA提供完整的结构响应视图，子结构CMA则在保持介电区域影响的同时实现高效的计算分析。这些方法为理解和设计介电环境调控的等离激元纳米结构提供了理论支撑。

title: A wide-range temperature-dependent deep potential for sodium with near-experimental accuracy from melting to the critical point
summary: We construct temperature-dependent deep potentials for sodium using finite-temperature DFT data obtained with the PBE, AM05, and $r^2$SCAN exchange-correlation functionals and investigate the thermophysical properties of sodium from room temperature to the critical region. The predicted critical parameters show a dependence on the exchange-correlation functional. The model based on the $r^2$SCAN functional gives a critical temperature $T_c=2.508(8)$ kK, density $ρ_c=0.203(4)$ g/cm$^{3}$, and pressure $P_c=0.249(6)$ kbar, in close agreement with the recommended values. This model is then used to reconstruct the normal-pressure and critical isobars and to calculate the enthalpy, heat capacities, thermal expansion coefficient, bulk moduli, Grüneisen parameter, and speed of sound. The calculated normal-pressure bcc density differs by only 0.06% from the experimental value. Direct solid-liquid coexistence simulations give a melting temperature of $346(2)$ K, 25 K below the recommended value, consistent with the sensitivity expected from meV/atom free-energy errors. Liquid-vapor coexistence simulations reproduce the binodal and yield a surface tension that approaches zero near the critical point. The calculated self-diffusion coefficient and shear viscosity extend the available transport-property data into the expanded-liquid and near-critical regions, where direct experimental information is sparse. We also demonstrate the thermodynamic consistency of the results by comparing the speed of sound obtained from direct acoustic simulations with that calculated from the equation of state.

AI.tldr: 本文利用有限温度DFT数据为钠构建了温度相关的深度势（分别采用PBE、AM05和r²SCAN三种交换关联泛函），系统研究了从室温到临界区钠的热物理性质。基于r²SCAN的模型给出的临界参数与推荐值高度吻合，并用于重构等压线、计算热力学性质、声速及输运性质等。
AI.motivation: 钠作为一种重要金属，其高温高压下的热物理性质（特别是在临界区附近）实验数据匮乏，需要可靠的分子模拟方法来预测。传统经验势难以准确描述液态金属的复杂行为，而第一性原理分子模拟计算成本高昂，因此需要开发高效且准确的机器学习势能面。
AI.method: 使用有限温度DFT数据（PBE、AM05和r²SCAN三种交换关联泛函）训练温度相关的深度势（Deep Potential），用于分子动力学模拟。通过固液共存和液气共存模拟分别获取熔点和临界性质，同时计算焓、热容、热膨胀系数、体模量、Grüneisen参数和声速等热物理性质，并通过直接声学模拟与状态方程计算的声速对比验证热力学一致性。
AI.result: r²SCAN模型给出临界温度T_c=2.508 kK、临界密度ρ_c=0.203 g/cm³、临界压力P_c=0.249 kbar，与推荐值吻合良好。正常压力下bcc密度与实验值仅差0.06%，固液共存模拟给出熔点346 K（比推荐值低25 K），液气共存模拟复现了双节线并使表面张力在临界点趋近于零。自扩散系数和剪切粘度数据扩展到了膨胀液体和近临界区域。
AI.conclusion: 温度相关的深度势能够可靠地预测钠从室温到临界区的热物理性质，其中r²SCAN泛函表现最佳。该方法为缺乏实验数据的极端条件下金属热物理性质的预测提供了有效途径，并展示了机器学习势能面在高温液态金属研究中的强大能力。

title: Cartesian tensor equivariant machine-learning force field for spin-dependent atomistic simulations
summary: Magnetic materials exhibit an intricate coupling between atomic structure and spin degrees of freedom, posing a fundamental challenge for atomistic simulations across experimentally relevant length and time scales. Here we introduce HotPP-Spin, a spin-dependent extension of HotPP for magnetic machine learning interatomic potentials, built on Cartesian tensor equivariant message passing. Atomic magnetic moments are treated as explicit axial-vector degrees of freedom, while spatial-inversion and time-reversal parities are propagated through the tensor couplings. This construction provides a unified representation of exchange-dominated and spin-orbit-induced interactions without imposing predefined analytical interaction forms. A scalar spin-dependent potential energy surface yields energy-conserving atomic forces and magnetic effective fields through differentiation. Benchmarks spanning collinear magnetism, noncollinear magnetism, and spin-orbit-coupling-induced magnetic anisotropy show that HotPP-Spin accurately describes magnetic energy landscapes, magnetic forces, and magnetic-order-dependent energy-volume relations within the same general framework. For H-phase monolayer VSe\(_2\), stochastic spin-dynamics simulations using the learned magnetic effective fields locate the finite-size magnetic ordering crossover at 415--435~K, in close numerical agreement with the reported experimental value of \(418.5\pm7.8\)~K. These results establish Cartesian tensor message passing as a general route for connecting first-principles magnetic energetics with large-scale atomistic simulations of coupled structural and spin phenomena.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了HotPP-Spin，一种基于笛卡尔张量等变消息传递的自旋依赖机器学习原子间势，将原子磁矩作为显式轴矢量自由度处理，统一描述交换主导和自旋-轨道耦合诱导的磁性相互作用，并通过标量自旋依赖势能面实现能量守恒的原子力和磁有效场。在共线磁性、非共线磁性和磁各向异性基准上验证了其准确性，并成功预测了VSe₂单层的磁有序转变温度。
AI.motivation: 磁性材料中原子结构与自旋自由度之间存在复杂的耦合，现有原子级模拟方法难以覆盖实验相关的长度和时间尺度，缺乏统一的机器学习框架来同时描述多种磁性相互作用。
AI.method: 基于笛卡尔张量等变消息传递构建自旋依赖势；将原子磁矩视为显式轴矢量自由度；在张量耦合中传播空间反演和时间反演宇称；通过标量自旋依赖势能面对势能进行微分以获得原子力和磁有效场。
AI.result: 在共线磁性、非共线磁性和自旋-轨道耦合诱导磁各向异性基准上均准确描述磁性能量景观、磁力和磁序依赖的能量-体积关系；对H相单层VSe₂的随机自旋动力学模拟预测有限尺寸磁有序转变温度为415-435 K，与实验值418.5±7.8 K接近。
AI.conclusion: 笛卡尔张量消息传递为将第一性原理磁性能量与大规模原子级结构-自旋耦合模拟连接起来提供了一条通用途径。

title: OpenMUSTANC (MUltiple Scattering Theory At Nanoplasmonic Cavities): A MATLAB toolbox for the simulation of Plasmonic Sphere Aggregates
summary: Mesoscopic physical models, including the Hydrodynamic Drude Model (HDM), the Generalized Nonlocal Optical Response (GNOR) Model, and the Surface Response Model (SRM), have been proposed to investigate nonlocal effects in nanometric structures. The combination of classical electromagnetism with these mesoscopic material models calls for new computational electromagnetic (CEM) algorithms, or update of conventional ones, in what is termed computational mesoscopic electromagnetics (CMEM). In this work, we present a MATLAB toolbox for the simulation of multiple spherical interfaces with arbitrary relative positions, with the incorporation of the aforementioned mesoscopic models. The method exploits vector spherical wave functions to properly express electric and magnetic fields, an S matrix formulation for the efficient treatment of incident and scattered fields at spherical interfaces, and a translation matrix to deal with propagating waves with different expansion centers. Excitation sources can be chosen among arbitrarily polarized plane waves, dipoles and electron beams. For the post-processing part, the calculation of cross sections and far/near-field mapping; fluorescence enhancement, Purcell factor and quantum yield; and cathodoluminescence and electron energy-loss probability is implemented. The toolbox is built in a modular manner, and each part (routine) has its own important functionality. This paper provides a full explanation of the proposed highly efficient and general toolbox, and a detailed guideline for researchers in the nanoplasmonics community.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个MATLAB工具箱，用于模拟任意相对位置的多球面界面系统中的介观非局域光学效应，整合了HDM、GNOR和SRM三种介观物理模型。该工具箱基于矢量球面波函数、S矩阵公式和转换矩阵，支持平面波、偶极子和电子束等多种激发源，并实现了截面计算、远/近场绘图、荧光增强、Purcell因子、量子产率、阴极发光和电子能量损失概率等后处理功能。
AI.motivation: 纳米结构中非局域效应的重要性日益凸显，但现有计算电磁学算法难以直接处理介观尺度下的非局域光学响应。将经典电磁学与介观材料模型结合需要新的计算电磁学算法或对传统算法的更新，这催生了计算介观电磁学(CMEM)这一新兴领域，因此亟需高效且通用的模拟工具。
AI.method: 该方法采用矢量球面波函数来表达电磁场，利用S矩阵公式高效处理球面界面上的入射和散射场，并通过转换矩阵处理不同膨胀中心的传播波。工具箱以模块化方式构建，每个例程具有独立功能，支持任意偏振平面波、偶极子和电子束作为激发源。
AI.result: 该工具箱实现了对多球面界面系统中非局域效应的全面模拟，包括三种介观模型的整合，以及丰富的后处理功能：截面计算、远/近场映射、荧光增强、Purcell因子、量子产率、阴极发光和电子能量损失概率。
AI.conclusion: 该论文提供了一个高效、通用且模块化的MATLAB工具箱，并对纳米等离子体领域的研究人员提供了详细的使用指南，填补了计算介观电磁学领域计算工具的空白。

title: Determinant Quantum-Quantum Monte Carlo: Coherent Auxiliary-Field Sampling
summary: We introduce determinant quantum-quantum Monte Carlo (DQ$^2$MC), a quantum algorithm that lifts the auxiliary-field sampling and averaging at the operational core of determinant quantum Monte Carlo onto a quantum computer. A determinant oracle synthesizes the DQMC amplitudes directly from a block encoding of the single-particle action matrix via quantum singular value transformations, so that the exponentially many Hubbard-Stratonovich weights are never enumerated, precomputed, or stored. Since the fermions are free for fixed auxiliary fields, the construction operates entirely at the single-particle level, requiring $O(\log N_{\mathrm{st}})$ system qubits and no Jordan-Wigner or Bravyi-Kitaev encoding, where $N_{\mathrm{st}}$ is the space-time volume. A full-quantum protocol makes observables interference amplitudes, eliminating the Markov chain and its autocorrelation time altogether; a hybrid quantum-classical protocol retains a constant-size active block of qubits and replaces the Metropolis-Hastings acceptance step with an exact heat-bath draw, so that cluster updates of any size are rejection-free, and passes only classical information between updates, admitting parallel tempering and distributed execution across quantum processors. The circuit-depth scales more favorably with spatial volume than classical DQMC, at the price of a post-selection overhead determined exactly by the largest target probability --- polynomial for smooth distributions, exponential for sharply peaked ones. Finally, the reweighting estimator underlying the fermion sign problem maps exactly onto a quantum weak value, placing the exponential cost of sign-problematic DQMC in precise correspondence with the post-selection overhead of weak-value extraction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出行列式量子-量子蒙特卡洛（DQ²MC）算法，将经典行列式量子蒙特卡洛的核心（辅助场采样与平均）移植到量子计算机上。通过行列式预言机结合量子奇异值变换，从单粒子作用量矩阵的块编码直接合成DQMC振幅，避免枚举指数级Hubbard-Stratonovich权重。该算法只需O(log N_st)个系统量子比特，无需Jordan-Wigner编码。全量子协议将可观测量变为干涉振幅，彻底消除马尔可夫链与自相关时间；混合量子-经典协议保留恒定大小活跃量子块，用精确热浴采样替代Metropolis-Hastings验收步骤，实现无拒绝的簇更新，并支持并行回火与分布式执行。电路深度随空间体积的扩展比经典DQMC更有利，代价是后选择开销（与最大目标概率相关）。费米符号问题的重新加权估计器精确映射为量子弱值，将符号问题的指数代价与弱值提取的后选择开销建立精确对应。
AI.motivation: 经典行列式量子蒙特卡洛（DQMC）虽然在强关联电子体系研究中具有重要地位，但面临两个根本性瓶颈：一是必须枚举和存储指数级的Hubbard-Stratonovich权重，计算开销巨大；二是基于马尔可夫链的采样框架存在自相关时间问题，且费米符号问题导致指数级计算代价。作者希望利用量子计算的优势，从根本上克服这些经典限制。
AI.method: DQ²MC算法的核心方法包括：(1) 构造行列式预言机，通过量子奇异值变换从单粒子作用量矩阵的块编码直接合成DQMC振幅，避免显式枚举指数级权重；(2) 全量子协议将可观测量构造为干涉振幅，消除马尔可夫链；(3) 混合量子-经典协议保留恒定大小活跃量子块，使用精确热浴采样替代Metropolis-Hastings，实现无拒绝簇更新，并支持并行回火与分布式执行；(4) 将费米符号问题的reweighting估计器映射为量子弱值，建立符号问题指数代价与后选择开销的对应关系。
AI.result: 该算法在系统量子比特数上仅需O(log N_st)，无需Jordan-Wigner或Bravyi-Kitaev编码；电路深度随空间体积的扩展优于经典DQMC；后选择开销由最大目标概率精确决定——平滑分布为多项式，尖锐分布为指数；将符号问题的指数代价精确对应到量子弱值提取的后选择开销。
AI.conclusion: DQ²MC为强关联量子多体问题提供了一种全新的量子计算框架，从根本上消除了经典DQMC的马尔可夫链采样瓶颈，并以量子弱值的形式给出了费米符号问题代价的精确量子力学诠释，为未来容错量子计算机上模拟强关联电子体系开辟了新途径。

title: Charge-State Dependence of Electronic Excitations in keV Ions Transmitted Through Solids Probed by Ion-Photon Coincidence Measurements
summary: Investigating the electronic excitations caused by light keV ions in matter contributes to a better understanding of materials modification such as space weathering or plasma-wall interactions in fusion reactors as well as improved materials analysis methods such as low or medium energy ion scattering. This study investigates the dependence of specific excitations in keV He projectiles, the most common projectile employed in these analytical methods, on the kinetic energy of the ion. We report on photon emission at energies >10eV emitted by projectiles excited upon transmission through different sample systems. We separate exit charge states and report on measurements of ion-photon pairs in coincidence, i.e. we can link a photon to the specific ion emitting it. From these measurements we extracted charge state resolved photon yields and obtained a deep insight into the electronic excitation occurring. Our results show that the electronic excitation of the helium projectile is largely material independent and rising strongly with the kinetic energy of the projectile. The photon yields are in good agreement with a common excitation model initially developed for beam foil spectroscopy. We hence extend the validity of this model to higher photon energies and different sample materials. We further provide a detailed analysis of the employed coincidence approach and necessary corrections to the raw data, as the methodology has a broad applicability in fundamental research and materials analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了keV能量氦离子穿过不同材料样品时，由电子激发引起的单光子发射现象。通过离子-光子符合测量技术，分离了出射电荷态，获得了电荷态分辨的光子产额，揭示了氦弹丸的电子激发在很大程度上与材料无关，且随离子动能强烈增强。实验结果与束箔光谱学的通用激发模型高度吻合，将该模型的有效性扩展到了更高光子能量和不同样品材料。
AI.motivation: 研究keV轻离子（如氦）在物质中引起的电子激发，有助于理解空间风化、聚变反应堆中等离子体-壁相互作用等材料改性过程，并能改进低能/中能离子散射等材料分析方法。理解激发对离子动能的依赖性对于这些应用至关重要。
AI.method: 采用离子-光子符合测量技术：氦离子穿过不同样品系统后产生>10eV光子发射，同时分离出射离子的电荷态，将特定光子与发射该光子的离子关联起来。从符合数据中提取电荷态分辨的光子产额，并进行了详细的符合方法学分析及原始数据校正。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，氦弹丸的电子激发在很大程度上与材料无关，且随离子动能强烈增强。光子产额与最初为束箔光谱学开发的通用激发模型高度吻合，将该模型的有效性扩展到了更高光子能量和不同样品材料。
AI.conclusion: 该研究建立了keV氦离子动能在材料中电子激发效应的定量理解，证实了通用激发模型在不同材料和更高光子能量下的适用性，并为符合测量方法在基础研究和材料分析中的广泛应用提供了详细的方法论指导。

title: Statistical Properties of a Fluctuation-Driven Nanomechanical Duffing Resonator
summary: We investigate the fluctuating nonlinear dynamics of multiple modes of a nanomechanical doubly clamped beam resonator. Each mode is driven by Gaussian force noise centered around the resonance; the mode response is monitored while the force magnitude is increased, inducing a transition from harmonic to the nonlinear Duffing regime. To characterize the dynamics, we introduce an effective temperature based on the mode fluctuation amplitude. As the nonlinearity becomes prominent at large amplitudes, we observe a reduction in the effective thermal energy and a crossover in response statistics from Gaussian to platykurtic, consistent with the dynamics expected in a Duffing potential.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了纳米机械双钳梁谐振器多个模式的涨落非线性动力学。每个模式由高斯力噪声驱动，随着力幅度增大，系统从谐波过渡到非线性Duffing regime。作者引入基于模式涨落幅度的有效温度来表征动力学，发现当非线性在大振幅下变得显著时，有效热能降低，响应统计从高斯分布交叉到platykurtic（低峰态）分布，与Duffing势中的预期动力学一致。
AI.motivation: 理解纳米机械谐振器在噪声驱动下的非线性动力学行为，特别是从线性到非线性Duffing regime的转变过程中，模式涨落和统计特性的变化规律。
AI.method: 通过高斯力噪声驱动纳米机械双钳梁谐振器的多个模式，逐步增加力幅度诱导系统从谐波过渡到非线性Duffing regime；引入基于模式涨落幅度的有效温度作为表征工具，分析有效热能变化和响应统计分布（高斯到platykurtic）的转变。
AI.result: 观察到非线性显著时有效热能的降低，以及响应统计从高斯分布到platykurtic分布的交叉，实验结果与Duffing势中预期动力学一致。
AI.conclusion: 纳米机械谐振器在强噪声驱动下进入非线性Duffing regime后，其涨落统计不再是高斯分布，有效温度也随之降低，这一发现为理解纳米机械系统在非线性区域的能量学和统计特性提供了新见解。

title: Direct Evidence of Unconventional Superconductivity in Doped Kagome system RV$_3$Sb$_5$
summary: The superconducting pairing symmetry of kagome metals remains a central unresolved question largely because phase-sensitive experiments capable of distinguishing between different possible order parameters have been difficult to implement. The spatial and energetic characteristics of impurity bound states measured by spectroscopic-imaging scanning tunneling microscopy encode information on the superconducting order parameter. Here, we use impurity-bound state spectroscopy to investigate optimally doped RbV$_3$Sb$_{5}$ where the charge-density wave instability is fully suppressed. We find that the superconducting state is fully gapped and exhibits two distinct energy scales, consistent with a multiband order parameter. Atomic-scale spectroscopy around nonmagnetic defects reveals pronounced particle-hole asymmetric bound states. Comparison with theoretical calculations demonstrates that these bound states are incompatible with conventional $s$-wave and sign-changing $s^{\pm}$ pairing. Our calculations also show that the data are fully consistent with a chiral order parameter. Our results establish impurity-bound-state spectroscopy as a powerful phase-sensitive probe of superconductivity in kagome materials and provide strong evidence that optimally doped RbV$_3$Sb$_{5}$ realizes a fully gapped chiral superconducting state.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用扫描隧道显微镜（STM）的杂质束缚态光谱技术，研究最优掺杂的RbV₃Sb₅（一种kagome金属）的超导配对对称性。研究发现该材料是一个具有两个不同能量尺度的全能隙超导体，且其非磁性缺陷周围的束缚态与常规s波和符号反转的s±配对均不兼容，但与手性序参量完全一致，为kagome材料实现全能隙手性超导态提供了有力证据。
AI.motivation: kagome金属的超导配对对称性一直是核心未解问题，主要困难在于缺乏能够区分不同序参量的相位敏感实验方法。作者希望通过杂质束缚态光谱作为相位敏感探针来揭示超导序参量的本质。
AI.method: 使用光谱成像扫描隧道显微镜（SI-STM）测量杂质束缚态的空间和能量特征。在电荷密度波不稳定性被完全抑制的最优掺杂RbV₃Sb₅中进行实验，并利用理论计算对比不同配对对称性（s波、s±和手性序参量）下的束缚态特征。
AI.result: 超导态是全能隙的，具有两个不同的能量尺度（多带序参量特征）。非磁性缺陷周围观察到显著的粒子-空穴不对称束缚态。理论对比表明传统s波和s±配对无法解释这些束缚态，而手性序参量能与实验数据完全吻合。
AI.conclusion: 杂质束缚态光谱被确立为kagome材料中超导性的有效相位敏感探针；最优掺杂RbV₃Sb₅很可能实现了全能隙手性超导态。

title: Light-induced nonconservative static forces in many-body systems
summary: In a quantum many-body system, a periodic drive can often generate effective static forces on the slow collective degrees of freedom. We study the static forces generated by light on electronic order parameters in solid-state systems. We show that the forces can have nonconservative components that originate from dissipation, i.e., optical absorption. This effect is demonstrated in two nontrivial examples. In excitonic insulators, via interband excitations, the light field generates a nonconservative force on the phase of the excitonic order parameter. This force leads to an acceleration of the phase, which manifests as a shift of the photon emission peak from an exciton condensate. In materials with an incommensurate charge density wave, a propagating light field generates a nonconservative force on the phase of its order parameter. It drives the charge density wave into sliding motion, leading to a DC electric current via topological Thouless pumping.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了量子多体系统中周期驱动（光）对固态电子有序参量产生的静力。作者证明这些力可以包含源自耗散（即光学吸收）的非保守分量，并在激子绝缘体和不相称电荷密度波两个体系中展示了该效应。
AI.motivation: 周期驱动可以产生有效的静态力作用于慢集体自由度，但在固态系统中，光对电子有序参量产生的力可能具有非保守分量（来自光学吸收），这一效应此前未被充分研究。
AI.method: 作者从理论上分析了周期驱动对电子有序参量产生的静态力，通过两个具体的非平凡例子（激子绝缘体中的带间激发和不称称电荷密度波）来证明非保守力的存在及其物理后果。
AI.result: 1）在激子绝缘体中，光场通过带间激发对激子有序参量的相位产生非保守力，导致相位加速，表现为激子凝聚体光子发射峰发生频移。2）在不称称电荷密度波材料中，传播光场对有序参量相位产生非保守力，驱动电荷密度波进入滑移运动，通过拓扑Thouless泵浦产生直流电流。
AI.conclusion: 光在固态电子有序参量上产生的静态力可以包含源自光学吸收的非保守分量，这些力能导致可观测的物理现象（如光子发射峰位移和直流电流），为理解和操控光-物质相互作用提供了新途径。

title: libNLPBE: An Open-Source Python Package for Solving the Non-Linear Poisson-Boltzmann Equation
summary: Solvent environments surrounding a solute can significantly alter its chemical properties. These changes become more prominent in electrolyte solutions, where mobile ions largely influence the solute through electrostatic interactions. A theoretical description of these ionic effects will benefit the design of chemistry performed in electrolyte solutions. As a result, the non-linear Poisson-Boltzmann equation (NLPBE) has emerged as an efficient implicit solvent model for electronic structure calculations to address such effects. However, the limited availability of NLPBE solvers for molecular electronic structure calculations greatly hinders theoretical investigation into the ionic effects. To improve accessibility of the NLPBE, we present libNLPBE, an open-source Python library, that solves the NLPBE for molecular systems in combination with density functional calculations, specifically to obtain electrostatic correction terms arising from the electrolyte solution environment for the Fock matrix. The library employs the density fitting (DF) approximation to efficiently calculate solute electrostatic potentials. Furthermore, we develop the modified Damped Inexact Newton Multigrid developed by Holst (mDINMH) method for solving the NLPBE. The mDINMH features a symmetric preconditioner for solving the Newton equation, which enables the use of robust multigrid methods designed for symmetric linear operators. In addition, an algebraic multigrid method has been incorporated into the mDINMH to support a broad range of grid points. We also present a GPU-accelerated version of libNLPBE to leverage parallelization efficiency of GPUs.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了libNLPBE，一个开源Python库，用于求解分子系统的非线性Poisson-Boltzmann方程（NLPBE），并集成到密度泛函计算中，以获得电解质溶液环境对Fock矩阵的静电修正项。该库采用密度拟合近似计算溶质静电势，并开发了改进的mDINMH求解方法（含对称预条件子和代数多重网格），同时提供GPU加速版本。
AI.motivation: 电解质溶液中移动离子通过静电相互作用显著影响溶质化学性质，而非线性Poisson-Boltzmann方程（NLPBE）是描述这些离子效应的有效隐式溶剂模型。然而，可用于分子电子结构计算的NLPBE求解器十分有限，严重阻碍了对离子效应的理论研究。
AI.method: 1) 开发libNLPBE开源Python库，将NLPBE求解与密度泛函计算结合，获得电解质环境对Fock矩阵的静电校正项。2) 采用密度拟合（DF）近似高效计算溶质静电势。3) 提出改进的mDINMH方法，其关键创新在于为Newton方程引入对称预条件子，从而能够使用为对称线性算子设计的多重网格方法。4) 在mDINMH中集成代数多重网格以支持广泛的网格点。5) 提供GPU加速版本以利用GPU并行效率。
AI.result: 该库提供了求解NLPBE的有效实现，结合密度拟合近似提高静电势计算效率，所提出的mDINMH方法通过对称预条件子使多重网格方法得以应用，代数多重网格扩展了网格点适用范围，GPU版本进一步提升了计算性能。
AI.conclusion: libNLPBE作为开源库提高了NLPBE求解器的可及性，有望促进电解质溶液体系中离子效应的理论研究，并助力电解质溶液中的化学设计。

title: Elastic properties of amorphous LiTaCl$_6$ solid-state electrolyte
summary: Amorphous solid-state electrolytes are attractive candidates for safe, high-energy-density all-solid-state batteries, yet their mechanical properties remain poorly understood from a computational perspective. Here, we investigate the elastic behavior of the recently discovered amorphous superionic Li-ion conductor LiTaCl$_6$ using density-functional-theory (DFT)-based methods, including unrelaxed static, relaxed static, and strain fluctuations from molecular dynamics (MD) simulations in the isobaric--isothermal (NPT) ensemble with DFT-trained machine-learning force fields (MLFFs). While the unrelaxed static method predicts a Young's modulus an order of magnitude higher than the experiment, the relaxed static method---commonly applied to crystalline electrolytes---still overestimates the modulus by more than 170%. In contrast, the MD approach using MLFFs yields a Young's modulus of $2.84 \pm 0.26$ GPa, which quantitatively agrees with the experimental value of $2.91 \pm 0.32$ GPa. Using the MLFF-MD approach, we further predict bulk modulus (4.44 GPa), shear modulus (1.02 GPa), and Poisson's ratio (0.39) for amorphous LiTaCl$_6$ and conclude that elastically it behaves like a soft polymer or gel. These results demonstrate that amorphous superionic materials possess some unique elastic properties and that, among the methods examined, only the MLFF-MD approach yields quantitative agreement with experiment, highlighting the necessity of a dynamical treatment to simulate their elastic response, consistent with recent findings for crystalline superionic conductors.

AI.tldr: 本文利用基于DFT训练的机器学习力场（MLFF）进行分子动力学（MD）模拟，研究了无定形超离子导体LiTaCl₆的弹性行为，得到了与实验定量一致的杨氏模量（2.84 GPa vs 实验2.91 GPa），并预测了体模量、剪切模量和泊松比，表明该材料在弹性上类似于软聚合物或凝胶。
AI.motivation: 无定形固态电解质是安全、高能量密度全固态电池的理想候选材料，但其力学性质在计算层面仍缺乏充分理解。
AI.method: 采用三种DFT基方法：非弛豫静态法、弛豫静态法，以及使用DFT训练的机器学习力场（MLFF）在NPT系综中进行分子动力学的应变波动法。
AI.result: 非弛豫静态法高估杨氏模量一个数量级；弛豫静态法仍高估170%以上；MLFF-MD方法得到的杨氏模量（2.84±0.26 GPa）与实验值（2.91±0.32 GPa）定量吻合。此外预测体模量4.44 GPa、剪切模量1.02 GPa、泊松比0.39。
AI.conclusion: 只有MLFF-MD方法能够定量重现实验弹性行为，说明无定形超离子导体的弹性响应需要动力学处理；该材料在弹性上表现出类似软聚合物或凝胶的独特性质。

title: Floquet engineering of competing antiferromagnetism and $d$-wave superconductivity on the square lattice
summary: We propose a driven Lieb--Hubbard quantum simulator whose prethermal dynamics realize a square-lattice spin-1/2 fermion model with independently tunable repulsive on-site and attractive bond interactions. Periodically modulating the charge-transfer offset between the site ($d$) and bond ($p$) orbitals of the Lieb lattice brings a $p$-orbital doublon energetically close to a pair in the $d$ manifold while keeping all $p$-orbital singlons off resonance, thereby creating a synthetic ``negative-$U$'' center on a Lieb-lattice bond site. Two controlled eliminations then generate a compact bond attraction in the reduced $d$-only model on the square lattice, despite the microscopic repulsion in the $p$ orbital. The resulting interaction $J$ is tunable independently of the Hubbard repulsion $U_d$ on the $d$ orbitals, while interference between photon-assisted paths provides access to an intermediate-coupling regime in which $J$ and $U_d$ are both comparable to the effective hopping. At half filling, a mean-field calculation in this regime finds adjacent antiferromagnetic and $d$-wave superconducting phases, as well as narrow coexistence regions, suggesting close competition between these orders. We discuss the branch-preparation, prethermal, and higher-band conditions required to translate the formal construction into an optical-lattice protocol. More broadly, our work identifies a structural similarity between Floquet systems and electron-phonon problems that may guide the design of novel quantum-simulation protocols.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种驱动的Lieb-Hubbard量子模拟器，通过周期性调制电荷转移偏移，在Lieb晶格上合成可独立调谐的吸引键相互作用，实现方晶格自旋1/2费米子模型，并在半填充时通过平均场计算发现反铁磁与d波超导相邻相及共存区。
AI.motivation: 在量子模拟中，需要实现具有可独立调控的排斥Hubbard相互作用和吸引键相互作用的费米子模型，以研究反铁磁与超导等竞争有序态。然而微观上晶格天然存在排斥相互作用，难以直接产生吸引相互作用，因此需要新的合成方案。
AI.method: 该方法利用Floquet驱动（周期性调制Lieb晶格的d轨道与p轨道之间的电荷转移偏移），将p轨道双占据态调谐到与d流形中的对接近共振，同时保持p轨道单占据态远离共振，从而在Lieb键位点上合成有效的负U中心。通过两次受控消去，在d子空间还原出方晶格上的紧凑键吸引相互作用J，该J可与d轨道上的Hubbard排斥Ud独立调谐。光子辅助路径的干涉还允许进入J和Ud均与有效跳跃可比的中间耦合区域。
AI.result: 平均场计算表明，在半填充的中间耦合区域，系统呈现出相邻的反铁磁相和d波超导相，以及狭窄的共存区域，提示这些有序态之间存在密切竞争。此外，论文还讨论了实现形式化构造所需的分支制备、预热以及高能带条件。
AI.conclusion: 该工作识别出Floquet系统与电子-声子问题之间的结构相似性，这可能为指导新型量子模拟方案的设计提供更广泛的启示。

title: Benchtop Momentum-Resolved Phonon Spectroscopy: Unlocking Lattice Dynamics via X-ray Diffuse Scattering
summary: Momentum-resolved phonon spectroscopy is essential for understanding the thermal, electronic, and structural properties of materials, yet it traditionally necessitates access to large-scale synchrotron or neutron facilities. We report a paradigm shift by demonstrating the accurate measurement and quantitative analysis of Thermal Diffuse Scattering (TDS) patterns using a commercially available benchtop Small/Wide-Angle X-ray Scattering (SAXS/WAXS) instrument. By utilizing a low-energy (8 keV) X-ray source and a custom-integrated vacuum geometry, we acquired characteristic TDS patterns in silicon (111) and (100) slabs. We demonstrate that these benchtop images contain sufficient information to extract interatomic force constants (IFCs) through global optimization algorithms, achieving a fitting accuracy comparable to those obtained from simulated data with statistical noise. Crucially, this capability provides access to phonon information across the entire Brillouin Zone, a critical component of lattice dynamics unavailable via standard laboratory techniques like first-order Raman spectroscopy. This low-barrier approach makes synchrotron-level lattice dynamics characterization accessible to virtually any research laboratory, enabling new avenues for the study of intrinsic strain and anisotropic lattice dynamics in emerging material systems.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了一项范式转变：利用商业化的台式SAXS/WAXS仪器，通过低能X射线源和定制真空几何结构，成功测量并定量分析了热漫散射（TDS）图案，从而从硅（111）和（100）样品中提取出原子间力常数（IFCs），准确度与模拟数据相当。该方法使得整个布里渊区的声子信息获取不再依赖大型同步辐射或中子设施。
AI.motivation: 动量分辨的声子谱学对理解材料的热学、电子和结构性质至关重要，但传统上必须依赖大型同步辐射或中子设施，这严重限制了普通实验室的研究能力。作者希望打破这一壁垒，使声子动力学表征变得低门槛、易获取。
AI.method: 使用商用台式SAXS/WAXS仪器，配备低能量（8 keV）X射线源和定制集成的真空几何结构，采集硅（111）和（100）薄片中的特征TDS图案。然后通过全局优化算法从这些台式仪器获取的图像中提取原子间力常数（IFCs），实现对声子信息的定量分析。
AI.result: 台式仪器采集的TDS图像包含足够的信息来提取IFCs，拟合精度与带统计噪声的模拟数据相当。该方法能够获取整个布里渊区的声子信息，这是标准实验室技术（如一阶拉曼光谱）无法实现的。
AI.conclusion: 这种低门槛方法使同步辐射级别的晶格动力学表征对几乎所有研究实验室变得可实现，为研究新兴材料体系中的内在应变和各向异性晶格动力学开辟了新途径。

title: Domain walls with alternating magnetic order in a model with dipolar coupling
summary: A model for a one-dimensional chain of elongated nano-scale magnetic islands with dipole interactions is analyzed here for the properties of its static domain walls with site-by-site alternating order. The anisotropic magnetic islands on a nonmagnetic substrate have their longer axes oriented transverse ($y$-direction) to the chain direction ($x$-direction), in a transverse applied magnetic field. The islands' magnetic dipoles $\vecμ_n$ are represented as macrospins of fixed length $μ$. The nearest-neighbor (NN) dipole interactions drive transverse alternating order, allowing for doubly-degenerate, uniform, static, $y$-alternating states, where the dipoles alternately point transverse to the chain direction, as in $\vecμ_n = \pm(-1)^n μ\hat{y}$. Assuming only NN interactions, the domain walls connecting these two alternating states are found with numerical relaxation simulations and analyzed in a two-sublattice continuum theory. As the uniaxial anisotropy constant $K_1$ descends from larger values until it closely approaches the NN dipolar coupling constant $D$, the domain wall width grows indefinitely, and the large-$x$ continuum solutions closely approach the lattice numerical solutions. The applied field produces a very slight canting of the dipoles towards the field, maximum in the center of the domain wall. The dipoles on the two sublattices are found to rotate in {\em opposite senses} as one scans along the lattice, resulting in a large longitudinal magnetic moment of the domain wall. A much smaller transverse magnetic moment has a topological contribution that depends on whether the chain length is odd or even.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了一维链状纳米磁岛（椭球形、偶极相互作用）中静磁畴壁的性质。磁岛长轴垂直于链方向，在横向外加磁场下，最近邻偶极相互作用驱动横向交替有序，形成双重简并的均匀y-交替态。畴壁连接这两个交替态，其宽度随单轴各向异性常数K1接近偶极耦合常数D而无限增长。畴壁具有大的纵向磁矩，以及一个依赖于链长奇偶性的拓扑横向磁矩贡献。
AI.motivation: 理解纳米尺度磁岛链中由偶极相互作用驱动的静态畴壁结构和性质，特别是当各向异性与偶极耦合接近时畴壁的临界扩展行为，以及畴壁产生的磁矩特征。
AI.method: 通过数值弛豫模拟求解一维磁岛链的畴壁构型，并建立双子格连续介质理论进行分析。模型将磁岛表示为单位长度有限的宏自旋，考虑最近邻偶极相互作用和单轴各向异性，在横向外加磁场下研究连接两个交替有序态的畴壁。
AI.result: 当单轴各向异性常数K1从较大值下降到接近偶极耦合常数D时，畴壁宽度无限增长，连续介质解在大x极限下与数值格点解接近。外加磁场使偶极子向场方向轻微倾斜，在畴壁中心最大。两个子格上的偶极子在沿晶格扫描时以相反方向旋转，产生大的纵向畴壁磁矩；横向磁矩较小且具有依赖于链长奇偶性的拓扑贡献。
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了横向交替有序磁岛链中畴壁的临界扩展现象、子格反向旋转机制导致的畴壁大纵向磁矩，以及具有拓扑本质的奇偶依赖横向磁矩，为理解纳米磁人工结构中磁畴壁行为提供了理论基础。

title: Superconductivity and Magnetism in Bi-Ni System: From Bulk to Heterostructures
summary: Unconventional superconductivity with ingredients of magnetism such as time reversal breaking, triplet pairing and proximity effects has been a long time pursued topic in physics and material science as a new source of innovative phenomena and effects to drive further scientific advances and technologies. The Bi-Ni system has emerged as a convenient candidate for the investigation of such phenomenology. Strictly speaking, the term Bi-Ni system refers to two different schemes, first to the NiBi$_{3}$ intermetallic compound, a 4 K superconductor in which a complex magnetism seems to govern electrical properties in the normal phase, but without implication in the superconducting properties. The second Bi-Ni system is not quite a material but a heterostructure formed by a bilayer of Bi and Ni. Here the superconducting phase has to steal the spotlight by showing strong evidence of time-reversal breaking and triplet pairing featuring a complex unconventional state. The ease of preparing the samples, compared to other candidates for such unconventionality, usually Uranium-based compounds, has accelerated the research in this system. Here, we went through a detailed review of the main results about the electronic properties of these two systems as well as a discussion of the main open questions to be solved in order to reach the complete understanding in this topic.

AI.tldr: 本文详细综述了Bi-Ni系统中的非常规超导现象，涵盖两种体系：NiBi₃金属间化合物（4K超导体，正常相存在复杂磁性但不影响超导性质）和Bi/Ni双层异质结构（表现出时间反演对称性破缺和三重态配对的强证据）。文章回顾了这两个体系的电子性质主要研究成果，并讨论了为全面理解该主题仍需解决的关键开放问题。
AI.motivation: 非常规超导（涉及时间反演破缺、三重态配对和邻近效应等磁性要素）长期以来是物理和材料科学中追求的重要课题，有望驱动新的科学进步和技术发展。Bi-Ni体系因样品制备简便（相比铀基化合物等其他候选材料）而成为研究这类现象的理想平台，亟需系统的综述来梳理已有成果并明确待解问题。
AI.method: 这是一篇综述性论文，作者对Bi-Ni体系的两类方案（NiBi₃金属间化合物和Bi/Ni双层异质结构）的电子性质研究成果进行了系统的回顾和总结，并对该领域未解决的开放问题进行了讨论。
AI.result: 文中指出：NiBi₃是4K超导体，正常相中复杂磁性主导电学性质但与超导性质无直接关联；而Bi/Ni双层异质结构中超导相展现出时间反演对称性破缺和三重态配对的强证据，呈现复杂的非常规超导态。
AI.conclusion: Bi-Ni体系为非常规超导研究提供了便捷的实验平台，但仍有若干关键问题有待解决，才能实现对该主题的完全理解。

title: Ornstein-Uhlenbeck Process Driven by Multiple Dichotomous Noises
summary: We study a generalized Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process driven by a superposition of $K$ independent dichotomous noises with arbitrary fixed amplitudes and switching rates. Unlike the classical Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process driven by equilibrium Gaussian white noise, the present system is governed by bounded nonequilibrium fluctuations with finite correlation times. We obtain exact expressions for the stationary position distribution and all cumulants, and show that the stationary state possesses an unexpectedly rich structure, including compact support, algebraic branch-point singularities, edge divergences, and multiple extrema. We establish a mapping onto a heterogeneous random-flight process with bounded jumps, yielding a transparent probabilistic interpretation of the stationary measure. We further analyze several limiting regimes, including the crossover to Gaussian statistics for large numbers of noise sources. For ensembles with exponentially-distributed quenched amplitudes, we derive exact disorder-averaged stationary distributions and show that disorder fundamentally alters the stationary state, producing exponential tails decorated by algebraic prefactors with non-trivial exponents.

AI.tldr: 本文研究由K个独立二值噪声（dichotomous noises）叠加驱动的广义Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程。作者得到了稳态位置分布和所有累积量的精确表达式，揭示了稳态具有紧支撑、代数支点奇异性、边缘发散和多极值等丰富结构。通过映射到异质随机飞行过程（heterogeneous random-flight process）给出概率解释，并分析了多种极限，包括到大数噪声源时的高斯交叉。对于指数分布淬火振幅的系综，推导了精确的无序平均稳态分布，表明无序会从根本上改变稳态，产生带有非平凡指数代数前因子的指数尾部。
AI.motivation: 经典Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程由平衡高斯白噪声驱动，而现实中的许多物理和生物系统受到有界、非平衡、具有有限相关时间的涨落驱动。作者旨在理解这类广义OU过程在二值噪声叠加驱动下的稳态统计特性，揭示其与经典情形截然不同的丰富结构。
AI.method: 通过解析方法推导稳态位置分布和所有累积量的精确表达式；建立到具有有界跳跃的异质随机飞行过程的映射以获得概率解释；分析多个极限情形（如大K时的高斯交叉）；对淬火无序（指数分布振幅）情形推导无序平均的精确稳态分布。
AI.result: 精确求解了K个独立二值噪声驱动的广义OU过程的稳态性质，发现稳态分布具有紧支撑、代数支点奇异性、边缘发散和多极值等非平凡结构；建立了与随机飞行过程的映射；发现在无序情形下，稳态被根本改变，产生指数尾部带有非平凡代数前因子的新统计特征。
AI.conclusion: 由多个独立二值噪声叠加驱动的OU过程具有远比经典白噪声情形更丰富的稳态结构，其有界性和有限相关时间导致了新颖的统计现象；无序的引入进一步丰富了系统的行为，给出了新的普适性特征。

title: Simulating spectrally resolved exciton--exciton-interaction pump--probe spectroscopy
summary: Exciton--exciton-interaction pump--probe spectroscopy (EEI--PP) captures the fifth-order signal of light-matter interaction, directly probing exciton--exciton annihilation. This allows studying excitation energy transport even in extended, nearly isoenergetic landscapes. Although spectrally resolved fifth-order signals have already been explored in simplified cases, in larger systems only spectrally integrated signals have been analyzed. We present a microscopic theoretical description for spectrally resolved EEI--PP response with realistic lineshapes, revealing how single- and multi-exciton state structure shape the spectral features and dynamics. The description is applicable to large molecular systems such as squaraine polymers, facilitating a direct comparison with experimental spectra. By a decomposition of the total signal into individual excitation pathways, we demonstrate that the spectral resolution is needed to distinguish otherwise intertwined single- and multi-exciton dynamics, such as single-exciton relaxation and exciton--exciton annihilation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了激子-激子相互作用泵浦-探测光谱（EEI-PP）的微观理论描述，实现了在大型分子体系中具有真实线形的光谱分辨五阶信号计算，并通过对激发路径的分解展示了光谱分辨能力对区分单激子和多激子动力学的必要性。
AI.motivation: 虽然光谱分辨的五阶信号已在简化情形中研究过，但在大型体系中仅有光谱积分信号被分析。光谱分辨的EEI-PP信号能够直接探测激子-激子湮灭并研究能量传输，但缺乏适用于大型分子系统的理论描述，无法与实验光谱直接比较。
AI.method: 作者发展了一个微观理论框架，用于计算具有真实线形（realistic lineshapes）的光谱分辨EEI-PP响应。该方法适用于大型分子系统（如方酸菁聚合物），并通过将总信号分解为单个激发路径来揭示单激子和多激子态结构如何塑造光谱特征和动力学。
AI.result: 研究表明光谱分辨对于区分原本交织在一起的单激子和多激子动力学（如单激子弛豫与激子-激子湮灭）是必需的。该方法可直接与实验光谱进行比较，适用于方酸菁聚合物等大型分子体系。
AI.conclusion: 该工作填补了大型分子体系中光谱分辨EEI-PP理论描述的空白，为直接比较理论计算与实验光谱提供了工具，并阐明了光谱分辨在解耦单激子与多激子动力学中的关键作用。

title: Harnessing the skyrmion Hall effect for low-power skyrmion transport in a tubular synthetic antiferromagnet
summary: We show that optimal control can turn the skyrmion Hall effect from a source of typically unwanted transverse motion into a mechanism for reducing Ohmic losses in skyrmion transport. We consider a pair of antiferromagnetically coupled skyrmions confined to a tubular geometry, where their relative transverse displacement becomes a periodic internal coordinate. The skyrmion Hall effect drives this coordinate, while finite interlayer coupling makes the resulting relation between applied current and longitudinal velocity nonlinear, allowing different current protocols to produce the same prescribed average velocity. We determine which of these protocols minimizes Joule heating. Depending on the interlayer coupling and spin-transfer-torque parameters, the optimal current is either constant, with the skyrmion pair maintaining a fixed relative position, or time dependent, with the pair undergoing periodic relative motion around the tube. In either case, the additional internal degree of freedom created by the skyrmion Hall effect and interlayer coupling enables skyrmion transport at a lower power than in the uncoupled limit.

AI.tldr: 该研究表明，通过最优控制可以将其视为"缺陷"的斯格明子霍尔效应转变为降低斯格明子输运中欧姆损耗的机制。在管状几何结构中，反铁磁耦合的斯格明子对因霍尔效应产生周期性的内部坐标运动，结合层间耦合产生非线性速度-电流关系，从而可通过不同电流协议实现相同平均速度，并从中找到焦耳热最小的最优方案。
AI.motivation: 斯格明子霍尔效应通常导致横向运动，被视为斯格明子输运中的不利因素。作者试图扭转这一观念，将其利用为降低输运功耗的机制，而非单纯消除其影响。
AI.method: 考虑管状几何中一对反铁磁耦合的斯格明子，斯格明子霍尔效应驱动其相对横向位移成为一个周期性内部坐标。利用有限层间耦合使电流-纵向速度关系非线性化，比较恒定电流与随时间变化电流两种协议，通过最优控制确定使焦耳热最小化的电流方案。
AI.result: 最优电流协议取决于层间耦合和自旋转移力矩参数：某些参数下为恒定电流（斯格明子对保持固定相对位置），另一些参数下为随时间变化的电流（斯格明子对绕管做周期性相对运动）。两种情况下，由斯格明子霍尔效应和层间耦合创造的额外内部自由度都能在更低功率下实现斯格明子输运。
AI.conclusion: 斯格明子霍尔效应与层间耦合结合所产生的内部自由度，可以被最优控制利用以实现比无耦合极限更节能的斯格明子输运，将传统上的"障碍"转化为"优势"。

title: Phase stability, charge ordering, and charge-liquid formation in the Falicov-Kimball model on triangular and kagome lattices
summary: We present a systematic investigation of the stability of the phase diagram of the spinless Falicov-Kimball model on two-dimensional non-bipartite lattices, the triangular and kagome lattices, using Markov-chain Monte Carlo simulations. Three filling or chemical potential conditions are examined: fixed chemical potentials ($μ_f = μ_c = U/2$), "generalized" half-filling ($\bar{n}_f = 1/3$, $\bar{n}_c = 2/3$), and conventional half-filling ($\bar{n}_f = \bar{n}_c = 1/2$). For each condition, the effects of a perturbatively small next-nearest-neighbor hopping are studied. On the triangular lattice, Anderson insulator, Mott insulator, and charge-density wave (CDW) phases are found in all cases, with the CDW driven by Coulomb-interaction-mediated nesting. Evidence for a charge-liquid regime is found in the region between the weakly correlated regime and the CDW, characterized by competing charge-ordering wavevectors and the absence of universal scaling behavior, whose extent shrinks progressively from the grand-canonical to the conventional half-filling condition. On the kagome lattice, the CDW phase is completely absent; instead, an insulating ground state, plausibly of the Mott type, is found, with signatures of a possible quantum phase transition at zero temperature. Our results establish the crucial role of lattice geometry and particle-hole symmetry breaking in shaping the phase diagram of correlated electron systems.

AI.tldr: 本文利用马尔可夫链蒙特卡罗模拟，系统研究了二维非二分性晶格（三角晶格和kagome晶格）上无自旋Falicov-Kimball模型的相图稳定性。在三种填充条件（固定化学势、广义半填充、常规半填充）下考察微扰小次近邻跳跃的影响，发现三角晶格上存在Anderson绝缘体、Mott绝缘体和电荷密度波（CDW）相，而kagome晶格上CDW完全缺失，仅有Mott型绝缘基态。
AI.motivation: 此前对Falicov-Kimball模型相图的研究多集中在二分性晶格（如方格子），而晶格几何和粒子-空穴对称性对相图的影响尚未被系统研究。理解非二分性晶格上关联电子系统的相图对于揭示晶格拓扑与电子关联的相互作用至关重要。
AI.method: 采用马尔可夫链蒙特卡罗（MCMC）模拟方法，在三角晶格和kagome晶格上研究无自旋Falicov-Kimball模型。设置三种填充/化学势条件（固定化学势μf=μc=U/2、广义半填充nf=1/3, nc=2/3、常规半填充nf=nc=1/2），并在每种条件下考察微扰次近邻跳跃的影响，系统扫描相图。
AI.result: 三角晶格上三种条件下均发现Anderson绝缘体、Mott绝缘体和CDW相，CDW由库仑相互作用介导的嵌套机制驱动；电荷液体区域存在于弱关联区和CDW之间，其范围从巨正则系综到常规半填充条件逐渐缩小。kagome晶格上CDW完全缺失，仅发现Mott型绝缘基态，并存在零温量子相变的迹象。
AI.conclusion: 晶格几何和粒子-空穴对称性破缺对关联电子系统相图起决定性作用。三角晶格的嵌套特性支持CDW相的形成，而kagome晶格的几何阻挫抑制了CDW。填充条件的改变显著影响电荷液体区域的稳定性，揭示了非二分性晶格上关联电子系统的丰富物理。

title: Engineering Excitons through Polymorphism and Dimensional Confinement in Low-Dimensional Tellurium
summary: The interplay between dimensionality, band-edge electronic structure, and electron-hole interactions governs the optical response of low-dimensional tellurium, yet the microscopic origin of its excitonic behavior remains largely unexplored. Here, we investigate the quasiparticle, excitonic, and optical properties of two-dimensional tellurium polymorphs and one-dimensional helical nanowires using many-body GW and the Bethe--Salpeter equation. Our results reveal a strong dependence of the excitonic response on band-edge dispersion, crystal symmetry, and dimensional confinement. $α$-tellurene exhibits comparatively weak and spatially extended electron-hole correlations, whereas the SOC-induced quasi-flat band-edge states of $β$-tellurene give rise to a strongly bound and anisotropic near-infrared exciton. Momentum-resolved BSE eigenvectors and real-space exciton wave functions directly reveal the contrasting localization and anisotropy of these excitonic states. Remarkably, hydrogen-passivated hexagonal tellurene, previously identified as a quantum spin Hall phase with $Z_2=1$, supports an even larger direct exciton binding energy of 0.51 eV together with a compact and nearly isotropic in-plane excitonic distribution. This demonstrates that strong electron-hole correlations are fully compatible with nontrivial band topology, while the binding strength and spatial character of the exciton remain strongly dependent on the underlying band-edge electronic structure and crystal symmetry. The one-dimensional helical nanowire represents the strong-confinement limit, exhibiting a direct high exciton binding energy and a pronounced shift of the optical response toward the ultraviolet.

AI.tldr: 本文利用多体GW方法和Bethe-Salpeter方程，系统研究了二维碲多晶型（α-碲烯、β-碲烯、六方碲烯）和一维螺旋纳米线的准粒子、激子及光学性质。研究发现激子响应强烈依赖于能带边缘色散、晶体对称性和维度约束：α-碲烯具有较弱且空间扩展的电子-空穴关联；β-碲烯中SOC诱导的准平坦带边缘态产生强束缚各向异性近红外激子；氢钝化的六方碲烯（量子自旋霍尔相）具有0.51 eV的直接激子束缚能及紧凑近各向同性分布；一维螺旋纳米线则是强约束极限，表现出高激子束缚能和向紫外的光学响应急剧移动。
AI.motivation: 低维碲材料的光学响应由维度、带边缘电子结构和电子-空穴相互作用共同决定，但其中激子行为的微观起源尚未被充分探索。作者旨在填补这一认知空白，揭示不同维度与晶体对称性下碲材料激子行为的物理机制。
AI.method: 采用多体GW方法计算准粒子能带结构，并利用Bethe-Salpeter方程（BSE）求解激子态；通过动量分辨的BSE本征矢量和实空间激子波函数分析激子的局域化与各向异性特征。
AI.result: 发现激子响应与带边缘色散、晶体对称性和维度约束强相关。α-碲烯激子弱且扩展；β-碲烯因SOC诱导准平坦带出现强束缚、各向异性的近红外激子；氢钝化六方碲烯（拓扑非平庸Z2=1）具有0.51 eV的直接激子束缚能和紧凑近各向同性分布，证明强电子-空穴关联与非平庸带拓扑可兼容；一维纳米线达到强约束极限，激子束缚能高且光学响应移向紫外。
AI.conclusion: 强电子-空穴关联与非平庸带拓扑完全兼容，激子束缚强度与空间特征强烈依赖底层带边缘电子结构和晶体对称性。该研究为低维碲材料在光电和拓扑光电子器件中的应用提供了理论基础。

title: Electrochemical impedance spectroscopy of graphene nanogaps
summary: Graphene nanogaps represent an emerging platform for nanoscale electrochemical and sensing devices, with potential applications in next-generation biomolecular sequencing. However, their interfacial behavior in aqueous environments remains poorly characterized, particularly with respect to frequency-dependent impedance and charge transport mechanisms at the graphene edge. We fabricate graphene nanogaps by controlled electrical breakdown in an inert atmosphere and study their electrochemical response. Upon exposure to ambient conditions, a surface contamination layer supports electrochemical activity within an adsorbed ultrathin conductive film between the graphene edges. Electrochemical impedance spectroscopy reveals distinct frequency-dependent responses consistent with a Warburg element associated with diffusion in this confined interfacial film. The impedance evolves systematically with liquid $\mathrm{p}H$, reflecting changes in electrochemical reaction-diffusion processes at the graphene edges. A quantitative equivalent-circuit model captures these effects and enables extraction of an effective nanogap length scale from impedance spectra, providing information complementary to that obtained from tunneling measurements.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过受控电击穿制备石墨烯纳米间隙，利用电化学阻抗谱研究其在水环境中的界面行为，发现表面污染层支撑的吸附超薄导电膜中存在的Warburg扩散元件主导了频率依赖响应，并建立了等效电路模型来提取纳米间隙的有效长度尺度。
AI.motivation: 石墨烯纳米间隙是纳米电化学和传感设备（尤其是下一代生物分子测序）的重要平台，但其在水环境中的界面行为（尤其是频率依赖阻抗和石墨烯边缘的电荷传输机制）仍缺乏充分表征。
AI.method: 在惰性气氛中通过受控电击穿制备石墨烯纳米间隙；暴露于环境条件后，用电化学阻抗谱研究其电化学响应；结合定量等效电路模型分析Warburg元件行为，并提取纳米间隙有效长度尺度。
AI.result: 发现纳米间隙暴露于环境条件后，表面污染层在石墨烯边缘间的吸附超薄导电膜中支持电化学活性；阻抗谱呈现与Warburg元件一致的频率依赖响应；阻抗随溶液pH系统性演化，反映电化学反应-扩散过程的变化；等效电路模型能定量捕获这些效应并提取有效纳米间隙长度尺度。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作首次系统地表征了石墨烯纳米间隙在水环境中的电化学阻抗行为，证明了等效电路模型可作为提取纳米间隙特征长度的有效工具，为经典的隧穿测量提供了互补信息，有望推动石墨烯纳米间隙在生物分子测序和纳米电化学器件中的应用。

title: Electronic state of vortices at twin boundaries in a nematic superconductor
summary: Local electronic states of vortices in an s $\pm$ d wave nematic superconductor are studied both in the absence and presence of twin boundaries. The Bogoliubov-de Gennes theory for a tight-binding model is used with its nematicity represented by the anisotropy in the transfer integrals and attractive interactions between the nearest-neighbor sites. We evaluate s and d wave components of the pair potentials and the local density of states, and analyze the effects of nematicity on the vortex core structures with/without twin boundaries. We find that a single vortex trapped at the twin boundary is composed of a bound pair of fractional vortices accompanied by weakly-induced s $\pm$ id wave components, despite that such s $\pm$ id wave components do not appear in a zero magnetic field. The calculated spatial structures of the local electronic states are compared with the vortex image measured by STM experiments in an iron-based superconductor FeSe.

AI.tldr: 本文利用Bogoliubov-de Gennes理论，研究了s±d波向列超导体中涡旋的局域电子态，特别关注孪晶界存在与否两种情况下的涡旋结构，并与FeSe的STM实验观测结果进行对比。
AI.motivation: 理解向列性（nematicity）对超导体涡旋芯结构的影响，以及孪晶界在涡旋钉扎和拓扑结构形成中的作用，进而解释铁基超导体FeSe中STM观测到的涡旋图像。
AI.method: 采用紧束缚模型的Bogoliubov-de Gennes理论，通过转移积分和各向异性吸引相互作用的各向异性来表征向列性；计算s波和d波配对势分量及局域态密度；分析有无孪晶界情况下向列性对涡旋芯结构的影响。
AI.result: 发现孪晶界处俘获的单涡旋由分数涡旋束缚对组成，并伴随弱诱导的s±id波分量；而在零磁场下这些s±id波分量并不出现。
AI.conclusion: 孪晶界对涡旋结构有显著影响，可诱导出分数涡旋对和s±id波分量，计算得到的局域电子态空间结构与FeSe的STM实验涡旋图像吻合。

title: Phase Diagram and Critical Behaviour of the Two-Dimensional Potts Model with Long-Range Quenched Disorder
summary: We study the phase diagram and critical properties of the $q = 3$ and $q = 8$ Potts models with spatially correlated disorder governed by a power-law decay with exponent $a$. Building on the phase diagram proposed by Chippari et al. [3], where a transition from finite-disorder to infinite-disorder fixed points was identified as a function of a, we refine this picture by using wrapping probabilities of Fortuin-Kasteleyn clusters. Furthermore, using magnetic observables, we clarify the physical origin of the double-peak structure in the magnetic susceptibility and establish the validity of the hyper-scaling relation across all investigated regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了具有空间相关无序（幂律衰减，指数为a）的q=3和q=8 Potts模型的相图与临界性质，利用Fortuin-Kasteleyn簇的缠绕概率精化了Chippari等人提出的相图，并通过磁学观测量阐明了磁化率双峰结构的物理起源，同时验证了超标度关系在所有研究区域的有效性。
AI.motivation: 已有研究（Chippari等人）提出了随参数a变化的相图，其中存在从有限无序到无限无序不动点的转变，但该相图需要进一步精化；此外，磁化率的双峰结构物理起源尚不明确，超标度关系的适用范围也需要验证。
AI.method: 采用Fortuin-Kasteleyn簇的缠绕概率来精化相图；利用磁学观测量来分析磁化率的双峰结构；通过系统地扫描不同无序指数a和不同q值（q=3和q=8）来研究相图与临界性质。
AI.result: 精化了Chippari等人的相图，明确了有限无序与无限无序不动点之间的转变；阐明了磁化率双峰结构的物理起源；验证了超标度关系在所有研究区域均成立。
AI.conclusion: 缠绕概率是精化Potts模型相图的有效工具；磁化率的双峰结构与无序性质密切相关；超标度关系在空间相关无序下依然保持普适有效性。

title: Transition states and dynamical bottlenecks in the Li-NC <-> Li-CN isomerizing reaction with the Lagrangian betweenness
summary: We study the vibrational dynamics that is responsible for Li-NC <-> Li-CN isomerization reaction using the Lagrangian betweenness, a tool recently developed to identify dynamical bottlenecks in the context of oceanographic transport. Following the spirit of the betweenness-centrality metric, which efficiently identifies the nodes that act as bottlenecks in complex networks, the Lagrangian betweenness is similarly capable to identify bottlenecks in dynamical systems. On the one hand, in this paper we show the ability of the Lagrangian betweenness to identify transition states, which are short-lived states that are formed at the top of the energetic barrier that the system must surpass in order to transition the reaction from the (initial) reactants to the (final) products. On the other hand, we also demonstrate that the Lagrangian betweenness is also able to identify other dynamical bottlenecks, and phase-space invariant structures such as manifolds, chains of islands and invariant tori, which are also responsible for the intricate vibrational dynamics of the system.

AI.tldr: 本文利用拉格朗日介数中心性（Lagrangian betweenness）研究 Li-NC ↔ Li-CN 异构化反应的振动动力学。该方法原本用于海洋输运中的动力学瓶颈识别，本文首次将其应用于化学反应体系，证明其不仅能识别过渡态，还能识别相空间中的流形、岛链和不变环面等动力学瓶颈结构。
AI.motivation: 化学反应动力学中的瓶颈识别对于理解反应机制至关重要，但传统方法往往难以全面捕捉相空间中的复杂不变结构。本文将海洋学中开发的拉格朗日介数方法引入化学动力学领域，旨在提供一种统一的工具来识别过渡态及其他动力学瓶颈结构。
AI.method: 采用拉格朗日介数（Lagrangian betweenness）这一基于网络介数中心性思想推广的动力学工具，将其应用于Li-NC与Li-CN异构化反应的振动动力学分析，考察其识别相空间中过渡态及不变结构的能力。
AI.result: 结果表明拉格朗日介数不仅能有效识别位于能垒顶部的过渡态（短寿命状态），还能识别其他动力学瓶颈，包括流形（manifolds）、岛链（chains of islands）和不变环面（invariant tori）等相空间不变结构。
AI.conclusion: 拉格朗日介数是一种多功能的动力学瓶颈识别工具，能够从统一的视角揭示化学反应体系中的过渡态和丰富的相空间动力学结构，为理解Li-NC ↔ Li-CN异构化反应的复杂振动动力学提供了新途径。

title: Chemical potentials from structure factors: II. Charged multi-component mixtures
summary: The chemical potentials of charged multi-component mixtures are central to electrolyte thermo- dynamics, but remain difficult to compute from atomistic simulations. The S0 method enables computing chemical potentials of mixtures from equilibrium molecular dynamics simulations. Here we extend the S0 method to charged mixtures by combining the composition-space framework developed in Part I: Neutral Multi-component Mixtures with a Coulombic treatment of the small- wavenumber limits of static structure factors. This approach separates thermodynamically relevant neutral composition fluctuations from forbidden macroscopic charge fluctuations, and further ac- counts for charge-neutrality constraints. We use the method to compute the chemical potentials of multiple-halide aqueous salt solutions, elucidating the ion-specific thermodynamic effects. We also calculate the mixing free energies of molten salt mixtures, demonstrating the importance of correctly describing long-wavelength electrostatic correlations.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了S0方法以计算带电多组分混合物的化学势，通过结合组分空间框架和库仑处理静态结构因子的小波数极限，成功应用于多卤化物盐水溶液和熔盐混合物的自由能计算。
AI.motivation: 带电多组分混合物的化学势是电解质热力学的核心，但从原子模拟中计算这些量仍然很困难。现有的S0方法只能处理中性混合物，需要扩展以处理带电体系，同时需要正确处理热力学相关的中性组分涨落与禁止的宏观电荷涨落之间的分离。
AI.method: 将Part I中开发的中性多组分混合物组分空间框架与静态结构因子小波数极限的库仑处理相结合，扩展S0方法至带电混合物。该方法将热力学相关的中性组分涨落与禁止的宏观电荷涨落分离，并考虑电荷中性约束。
AI.result: 计算了多卤化物水盐溶液的化学势，阐明了离子特异性热力学效应；同时计算了熔盐混合物的混合自由能，证明了正确描述长波静电关联的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 扩展后的S0方法能够从平衡分子动力学模拟中可靠计算带电混合物的化学势，揭示了长波静电关联在熔盐混合物热力学中的关键作用。

title: Enhanced Diffusion from Twist-Angle Disorder
summary: We consider the effect of twist-angle disorder on the single-particle properties of twisted bilayer systems. These materials are a natural playground for studying how tiny, uncontrolled spatial variations may become unusually consequential; a local change in the twist geometry can give rise to spatially-correlated alterations of the parent Hamiltonian, which in turn affect the coarse-grained properties of the substrate such as transport and ordering tendencies. In analogy to electrodynamics, where the magnetic field is given by the curl of the vector potential, we model the twist angle as the curl of the relative displacement between the two bilayers. We find that geometric scattering constraints imposed here by the twist structure substantially suppress momentum relaxation relative to mean-rate-matched white noise. We quantify these effects and show that the problem can be mapped onto a non-linear sigma model (NLSM).

AI.tldr: 本文研究扭转双层体系中扭转角无序对单粒子性质的影响，将扭转角类比为电动力学中磁场的旋度，建立扭转角与双层相对位移的旋度关系，发现几何散射约束显著抑制动量弛豫，并将问题映射为非线性sigma模型（NLSM）进行量化分析。
AI.motivation: 扭转双层体系中微小的扭转角空间变化（无序）可能产生异常显著的影响，导致哈密顿量的空间关联改变，进而影响输运和有序化倾向。作者希望理解这种无序如何影响体系性质，特别是与白噪声情况相比，几何约束如何改变散射行为。
AI.method: 将扭转角建模为两层间相对位移的旋度（类比电动力学中磁场=矢势的旋度），利用这种几何约束分析动量弛豫过程，并将整个问题映射到非线性sigma模型（NLSM）框架中进行处理。
AI.result: 发现扭转结构施加的几何散射约束能显著抑制动量弛豫（相对于均值速率匹配的白噪声情形），并对这一效应进行了量化。
AI.conclusion: 扭转角无序问题可以系统映射到NLSM框架，为理解扭转双层体系中无序效应的输运和有序化倾向提供了新的理论工具。

title: Revealing low-energy surfaces of multinary compounds by controlling surface coordination environments
comment: 27 pages, 8 figures, 2 tables; Supplementary information included as appendices; Open-source software repository: https://github.com/caneparesearch/salami
summary: When modeling surfaces of multinary compounds, conventional cleavage planes often cut through strongly bonded polyhedra, resulting in unphysical surface energies. Here, we introduce SALAMI (Symmetric Atomic Layers for Arbitrary Multinary Interfaces), a Python package that generates symmetric, charge-neutral, dipole-free, and low-energy slab models for multinary compounds. SALAMI performs combinatorial searches to selectively remove surface atoms and generate corrugated terminations that preserve optimal coordination environments. We applied this workflow to all symmetrically inequivalent crystallographic orientations with Miller indices up to 2 for two prototypical structures: the solid-state electrolyte Li3PS4 and the transparent conducting oxide ZnSb2O6. Density functional theory calculations reveal that Li3PS4 must preserve all PS4 units to achieve the minimum surface energy. For ZnSb2O6, low-energy surfaces are achieved by partial undercoordination of surface Sb atoms to SbO5 or SbO4 from the bulk SbO6, depending on the surface orientations. Compared to surface models generated with unconstrained coordination, applying constraints to achieve optimal local coordination environments significantly lowers surface energies, shrinking the volume of the predicted Wulff shape by approximately 20%. Our results demonstrate that meticulous control of local coordination environments is necessary for accurately predicting the surface energetics of multinary compounds.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了SALAMI，一个用于生成多组分化合物对称、电荷中性、无偶极且低能表面模型的Python包。通过对Li3PS4和ZnSb2O6的研究，发现保持最优配位环境（如保留PS4单元、Sb原子从SbO6降配位到SbO5/SbO4）能显著降低表面能，使预测的Wulff形状体积缩小约20%。
AI.motivation: 多组分化合物表面建模时，传统解理面往往切断强键合的配位多面体，导致不物理的表面能，亟需一种能保持最优配位环境并生成低能表面模型的方法。
AI.method: 开发SALAMI Python包，通过组合搜索选择性移除表面原子，生成具有凹凸（corrugated）终止面且保持最优配位环境的对称、电荷中性、无偶极的slab模型；结合DFT计算评估表面能。
AI.result: Li3PS4需保留所有PS4单元以获得最低表面能；ZnSb2O6低能表面通过Sb原子部分欠配位（从SbO6降至SbO5或SbO4）实现；施加配位约束相比无约束可显著降低表面能，使Wulff形状体积缩小约20%。
AI.conclusion: 精确控制局部配位环境对准确预测多组分化合物的表面能量至关重要，SALAMI为这一需求提供了有效工具。

title: Design and Modeling of the Charge Readout of a SiMOS Quantum Dot with a Single Electron Transistor and CryoCMOS
summary: Single electron spin qubits trapped in SiMOS quantum dots are a promising technology for scaling to thousand- or million-qubit systems due to their compatibility with mature CMOS manufacturing processes. A readout system that combines a single electron transistor with a custom cryogenic CMOS amplification and digitization chain offers key advantages by avoiding the use of bulky RF components or room-temperature interconnects. We present design techniques and simulation results for an optimized qubit-SET cryoCMOS interface, culminating in the design of the QNDR1 ASIC, the first cryogenic readout ASIC designed under the Quandarum project, which targets the development of a many-channel spin qubit based detector for use in high energy physics.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了QNDR1 ASIC的设计，这是Quandarum项目下首个低温读出ASIC，用于SiMOS量子点中单电子自旋量子比特的读出。该设计采用单电子晶体管结合定制低温CMOS放大和数字化链，避免了体积庞大的射频组件和室温互连，目标是开发用于高能物理的多通道自旋量子比特探测器。
AI.motivation: 单电子自旋量子比特需要扩展到数千至百万量子比特系统，而传统的读出系统依赖体积庞大的射频组件和室温互连，限制了可扩展性。因此需要开发与成熟CMOS制造工艺兼容的低温读出方案。
AI.method: 采用单电子晶体管（SET）与定制低温CMOS放大和数字化链相结合的读出方案，通过设计优化量子比特-SET与低温CMOS的接口电路，最终实现QNDR1 ASIC的设计。
AI.result: 提出了优化的量子比特-SET低温CMOS接口设计技术和仿真结果，成功设计出QNDR1 ASIC——Quandarum项目下首个低温读出ASIC。
AI.conclusion: 该低温CMOS读出方案为多通道自旋量子比特探测器（用于高能物理）的开发奠定了基础，展示了可扩展的量子读出架构。

title: Doping-driven evolution of pairing symmetry in pressurized La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$
summary: We investigate the superconducting pairing symmetry and its doping evolution in pressurized La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$. For the undoped compound, the most favorable pairing state is found to be $s_{\pm}$-wave, characterized by sign reversal of the gap functions between the Fermi pockets. A detailed analysis of the pairing interactions reveals that this unconventional state originates from repulsive interactions mediated by the magnetic odd modes of the bilayer nickelate. Upon hole doping, the $γ$ Fermi pocket expands, which amplifies the intrapocket repulsions on this pocket. These repulsions, driven by the magnetic even modes, gradually dominates the pairing interactions and ultimately drive a transition in pairing symmetry from $s_{\pm}$-wave to $d_{xy}$-wave in the heavily hole-doped regime. In stark contrast, the $s_{\pm}$-wave pairing persists under electron doping, even deep into the heavily electron-doped regime where a Lifshitz transition occurs. This finding suggests that the $γ$ Fermi pocket is not essential for the emergence of superconductivity in bilayer nickelates. In fact, the $s_{\pm}$-wave pairing becomes more robust in the absence of the $γ$ pocket, as spin fluctuations are strongly enhanced by the favorable nesting between the $α$ and $β$ pockets --- a condition guaranteed by Luttinger's theorem and the Fermi surface topology. We believe that exploring the doping evolution of superconducting pairing will open a new realm for testing the pairing mechanism in pressurized La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了加压La₃Ni₂O₇中超导配对对称性及其随掺杂的演化。未掺杂时最有利的配对态为s±波（费米口袋间间隙函数符号反转），源于双层镍酸盐磁性奇模介导的排斥相互作用。空穴掺杂时γ费米口袋膨胀增强口袋内排斥作用，最终驱动s±波向dxy波转变；而电子掺杂下s±波持续存在，即使经历Lifshitz转变。研究发现γ口袋对超导并非必需，去除后α和β口袋间的有利嵌套反而增强自旋涨落，使s±波配对更稳健。
AI.motivation: 理解加压La₃Ni₂O₇中非常规超导的配对机制及其掺杂演化，以检验双层镍酸盐的超导配对机理，为高温超导理论提供新的约束条件。
AI.method: 通过理论分析研究配对对称性及其掺杂演化。具体包括：分析未掺杂化合物的费米口袋结构与配对相互作用；区分磁性奇模和偶模对配对相互作用的贡献；跟踪空穴/电子掺杂下费米面拓扑变化及自旋涨落强弱，结合Luttinger定理和费米面拓扑分析嵌套条件。
AI.result: 未掺杂时s±波配对最稳定，源于磁性奇模介导的排斥相互作用。空穴掺杂导致γ口袋膨胀，磁性偶模驱动的口袋内排斥增强，在重空穴掺杂区驱动s±波向dxy波转变。电子掺杂下s±波配对持续存在，即使经历Lifshitz转变；去除γ口袋后，α-β口袋间的有利嵌套增强自旋涨落，s±波配对反而更稳健。
AI.conclusion: γ费米口袋并非超导产生所必需，s±波配对在无γ口袋时更稳健。掺杂依赖的配对对称性演化（s±→dxy）为实验上检验加压La₃Ni₂O₇的配对机制开辟了新途径。

title: Representation Transitions Reveal Predictive Structure in Complex Systems: A Trajectory-Level Reconstruction in a Critical System
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures, plus Supplementary Material (7 pages). Submitted to PLOS Complex Systems (Manuscript PCSY-D-26-00116)
summary: Trajectories in complex systems often contain structure that is not captured by the population-averaged, scalar statistics traditionally used to describe them. Here we reconstruct, through independent numerical re-simulation rather than literature review, a systematic search across representational forms - from single scalar statistics, through two independent discrete multi-feature classification attempts, to a trajectory-level structural representation and a diagnostic surrogate test, to a continuous low-dimensional compression - applied to the same underlying trajectory ensemble in a critical complex system. Predictive failure is not explained by insufficient correlation: one discrete representation's own strongest individual feature correlates with the target more strongly ($r=0.588$) than the eventual successful representation's own headline statistic ($r=0.540$), yet fails to separate the ensemble's two most consequential cases - while the continuous representation succeeds, robustly, across eight independent scale-removal folds ($r=0.677$-$0.717$, all $p<0.001$). The determining factor was not correlation strength but whether the representation preserved the structure relevant to prediction. These results indicate that the choice of representation determines whether predictive structure in complex systems becomes accessible - a scientific variable in its own right, not a downstream analysis choice.

AI.tldr: 本文通过独立数值重模拟，系统比较了从标量统计量到连续低维压缩等多种表征形式在同一临界复杂系统轨迹集合上的预测能力，发现预测成败的决定因素不是相关强度，而是表征是否保留了与预测相关的结构。
AI.motivation: 复杂系统的轨迹常常包含传统群体平均标量统计量无法捕捉的结构，现有方法对表征形式的选择缺乏系统性研究，需要明确表征选择本身对预测可及性的影响。
AI.method: 通过独立数值重模拟（而非文献综述）进行系统性搜索，依次测试了单标量统计量、两种独立的离散多特征分类方法、轨迹级结构表征与诊断性替代检验、以及连续低维压缩，并将它们应用于同一临界复杂系统的轨迹集合上。
AI.result: 一种离散表征的最强特征与目标的相关性（r=0.588）高于最终成功表征的代表性统计量（r=0.540），却无法区分集合中两个最重要的案例；而连续表征在八次独立的尺度移除交叉验证中均稳健成功（r=0.677-0.717，全部p<0.001）。
AI.conclusion: 表征的选择决定了复杂系统中预测性结构是否可及，这本身就是一个科学变量，而非下游分析中的次要选择。

title: Site-Specific Vibrational Dynamics to Probe Local and Global Protein Motions
summary: Vibrational spectroscopic probes can provide site-specific information on protein structure and dynamics. In this work, the possibility to relate protein motion with the vibrational response for --SCN, --N$_3$, and --SNO labels covalently linked to all alanine-residues in lysozyme is investigated. Depending on the position of the probe along the polypeptide chain, its local hydration, and the dynamics of its environment, the vibrational response can encode not only local fluctuations but also low-frequency, collective motions of the protein. The spectroscopic probes are described using machine-learning-based models for both bonded interactions, represented by reproducing-kernel models, and electrostatic interactions, represented by fluctuating minimally distributed charges. Spectroscopic dynamics are characterized through frequency fluctuation correlation functions (FFCFs). For many probe locations, the FFCFs contain a non-decaying component on the simulation time scale, indicating residual slow dynamics and incomplete sampling of the underlying conformational fluctuations. The magnitude of these static contributions is consistent with previous experimental observations, providing qualitative validation of the simulations. Overall, the results demonstrate that site-specific vibrational probes can report on dynamics extending beyond their immediate local environment and can, at suitable locations, provide information on collective protein motions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了溶菌酶中所有丙氨酸残基上共价连接的振动光谱探针（--SCN、--N₃、--SNO），发现探针的振动响应不仅能反映局部涨落，还能编码蛋白质的低频集体运动，并通过频率涨落相关函数（FFCFs）验证了静态贡献与实验观察一致。
AI.motivation: 振动光谱探针可提供蛋白质结构和动力学的位点特异信息，但探针的振动响应能否反映超出局部环境的蛋白质集体运动尚不明确。本研究旨在系统探索探针位置、局部水合环境和环境动力学如何影响振动响应，以及探针能否报告蛋白质的集体运动。
AI.method: 采用基于机器学习的模型描述光谱探针：键合相互作用用再生核模型（reproducing-kernel models）表示，静电相互作用用波动的极小化分布电荷（fluctuating minimally distributed charges）表示。将三种探针（--SCN、--N₃、--SNO）共价连接到溶菌酶的所有丙氨酸残基上，通过频率涨落相关函数（FFCFs）表征光谱动力学。
AI.result: 许多探针位点的FFCFs在模拟时间尺度内包含不衰减的成分，表明存在残差慢动力学和对构象涨落采样的不完全。这些静态贡献的大小与先前的实验观察一致，为模拟提供了定性验证。结果表明位点特异性振动探针可以报告超出其局部环境之外的动力学。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明振动光谱探针在合适的位置能够提供蛋白质集体运动的信息，其振动响应不仅编码局部涨落，还能反映低频集体运动，扩展了振动光谱探针在蛋白质动力学研究中的应用范围。

title: Dark exciton signatures in the infrared transient absorption of MoS$_2$ monolayer
summary: Dark excitons play a central role in the nonequilibrium dynamics of two-dimensional semiconductors, but remain difficult to characterize. In this work we show that transient-absorption experiments, with probe pulses tuned in the exciton-exciton transitions energy range (exc-tr-abs), can be used to detect excitations from any populated dark excitonic state, including symmetry-forbidden, spin-forbidden, and finite momentum ones. We develop a fully ab initio scheme, on top of $GW$+BSE, for computing exc-tr-abs spectra from arbitrary populated exciton distributions. The different classes of dark excitons are included on an equal footing, by evaluating exciton-exciton dipole matrix elements in a locally smooth gauge, which accounts for both intra-band and inter-band contributions. As a test case, we consider monolayer MoS$_2$, for which experimental data are available. The exc-tr-abs signal emerges from a sum of contributions from four different valleys in the exciton dispersion, namely $Γ$, $K$, $M$, and $Q$ valleys. The interpretation of the final signal is substantially different from the one based on transitions at $\mathbf{q}=Γ$ alone. The exciton-exciton dipoles show similar intensity among these valleys, while their relative weight is mostly dictated by the initial excitonic population. State- and spin-resolved analyses show that the main peaks can be described as $1s \rightarrow 2p$ and $1s \rightarrow 3p$ transitions from A and B excitons, but with a superposition of transitions from both spin-flip and spin-conserving excitons across the valleys, and with contributions averaged over different momenta within the individual valleys.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种全从头算（ab initio）方案，基于GW+BSE框架计算瞬态吸收（exc-tr-abs）光谱，用于探测二维半导体中任意布居的暗激子态（包括对称禁戒、自旋禁戒和有限动量态）。以单层MoS₂为测试体系，发现信号来源于激子色散中Γ、K、M、Q四个能谷的贡献，且其解释与此前仅考虑Γ谷跃迁的理解有本质不同。
AI.motivation: 暗激子在二维半导体的非平衡动力学中起核心作用，但由于其光学暗性（不含法性），长期以来难以被直接表征。现有的实验和理论手段难以全面探测各类暗激子态，亟需一种能够同等对待所有暗激子类别（对称禁戒、自旋禁戒、有限动量）的检测与计算方法。
AI.method: 作者在GW+BSE理论之上发展了一套完整的从头算框架，用于计算任意布居激子分布下的exc-tr-abs光谱。核心创新在于：在局域光滑规范（locally smooth gauge）下计算激子-激子偶极矩阵元，同时考虑带内和带间贡献，从而将不同类别的暗激子置于同等地位处理。通过对激子布居分布进行态分辨和自旋分辨分析，可识别各主要峰所对应的跃迁通道。
AI.result: 以单层MoS₂为测试案例，exc-tr-abs信号由激子色散中Γ、K、M、Q四个能谷的贡献叠加而成。各能谷间的激子-激子偶极强度相近，信号相对权重主要由初始激子布居决定。态与自旋分辨分析表明，主峰可描述为A和B激子的1s→2p与1s→3p跃迁，但实际是不同能谷间自旋翻转和自旋守恒激子跃迁的叠加，并在各能谷内对不同动量贡献取平均。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明exc-tr-abs是一种通用的暗激子探测手段，能够同等覆盖各类暗激子态。其信号解释必须考虑多能谷贡献，仅基于q=Γ跃迁的传统理解是不够的。所发展的理论框架为未来研究二维材料中暗激子非平衡动力学提供了有力的计算工具。

title: Duality Between Twist-Angle Disorder and Non-Hermitian Disorder
summary: We propose and study a model of moire heterobilayer systems where the twist angle remains uniform and well defined only within a finite range, but deforms randomly at larger distances. The local twist angle is then subject to a certain probability distribution that penalizes large fluctuations around its mean value. Within the framework of the replica trick, we show that disorder averaging produces a nontrivial correlation with alternating sign between replicas, maximized only close the boundary of each local domain and along certain directions. We show that for the low-energy moire bands, exactly the same correlation can be generated in a dual model where fermions are coupled to non-Hermitian disorder, which can evade Anderson localization dynamically. This duality provides a new perspective to investigate twist-angle disorder in moire systems, and unveils some of the essential differences between twist-angle disorder and conventional disorder.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一种莫尔异质双层系统模型，其中扭转角仅在有限范围内保持均匀和明确定义，在更大距离处随机变形。通过复制技巧，作者证明无序平均会产生复制体间交替符号的非平凡关联，仅在局部域边界附近和特定方向最大化。更重要的是，对于低能莫尔带，这种关联可以在费米子耦合非厄米无序的对偶模型中精确复现，从而提供了研究扭转角无序的新视角，并揭示了其与传统无序的本质区别。
AI.motivation: 扭转角无序在莫尔系统中普遍存在，但过去的研究大多假设扭转角在全局范围内均匀一致。作者希望理解扭转角在空间上随机波动时对莫尔电子结构的影响，并探究这种无序与传统安德森无序在物理本质上的区别。
AI.method: 建立了扭转角在有限范围内均匀、更大距离随机变形的莫尔异质双层模型；采用复制技巧(Replica Trick)处理无序平均；推导出复制体间交替符号的非平凡关联；构造了等价的对偶模型，将费米子耦合到非厄米无序中，从而动态规避安德森局域化。
AI.result: 证明无序平均产生复制体间交替符号的关联，且该关联仅在局部域边界附近和特定方向最大化；对低能莫尔带，可通过对偶的非厄米无序模型精确重现该关联，该模型可动态规避安德森局域化。
AI.conclusion: 该对偶性为研究莫尔系统中的扭转角无序提供了新视角，揭示了扭转角无序与传统无序（如安德森无序）之间存在本质差异——前者可通过非厄米机制规避局域化。

title: Energy landscape and dissipation of sliding magnetic rotor arrays
summary: Magnetically coupled damped rotational degrees of freedom can give rise to tribological loss when excited by a relative sliding motion, linking friction to the dynamics of magnetic moments. We analytically investigate such magnetic friction by studying a recently introduced simplified model for a rigid magnetic rotor array sliding over a commensurate magnetic substrate. Here, the array rotors can rotate about an axis perpendicular to the sliding direction and are damped by microscopic shaft friction, while the substrate magnets have a fixed in-plane orientation. The simplified model reduces the collective rotor dynamics of this setup to a set of coupled nonlinear differential equations, which can be studied by the corresponding energy landscape in the quasi-static regime. We find that the parameter plane spanned by layer separation and time can be divided into distinct chambers, in which the structure of the energy landscape remains invariant. Using these chambers, we identify the layer separation intervals corresponding to different dynamical states and recover the emergence of a regime where the moment alignment alternates globally while exhibiting peak dissipation. Additionally, we derive the leading nontrivial orders of the collective magnetic friction in the regimes of small and large gaps between the array and the substrate. For the alternating regime, we find that friction can be computed by tracking energy jumps from unstable to stable critical points at the chamber boundaries. These results provide an analytical foundation for the observed dynamics and dissipation in sliding rotor arrays. Because the simplified model is scale-free, our conclusions transfer across a broad range of microscopic and macroscopic length scales.

AI.tldr: 本文通过解析方法研究了一种简化的刚性磁转子阵列在磁性基底上滑动时的磁摩擦现象。该模型将集体转子动力学简化为耦合非线性微分方程组，利用准静态能量景观将层间距-时间参数平面划分为不同"chambers"，从而识别不同动力学状态，并推导出小间隙和大间隙下的摩擦主导项，为滑动转子阵列的动力学与耗散提供了解析基础。
AI.motivation: 磁耦合的阻尼转动自由度在相对滑动中可激发摩擦损耗，将摩擦与磁矩动力学联系起来。然而，这类磁摩擦的机理尚缺乏系统的解析理解，因此需要一个简化的模型来揭示其集体动力学与耗散的规律。
AI.method: 采用先前提出的刚性磁转子阵列在相称磁性基底上滑动的简化模型。转子可绕垂直于滑动方向的轴旋转，并受微观轴摩擦阻尼；基底磁矩具有固定的面内取向。该模型将集体转子动力学约化为耦合非线性微分方程组，通过准静态能量景观进行研究，将参数平面（层间距×时间）划分为结构不变的chambers，并在小/大间隙极限下推导摩擦的主导非平凡阶项。
AI.result: 发现参数平面可划分为不同chambers，其中能量景观结构保持不变。据此确定了对应不同动力学状态的层间距区间，并恢复了全局交替磁矩排列且伴随峰值耗散的机制。在交替状态下，摩擦可通过追踪chamber边界处从不稳定到稳定临界点的能量跳跃来计算，并推导出小/大间隙下的摩擦主导阶。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果为滑动转子阵列中观察到的动力学和耗散提供了解析基础。由于简化模型具有尺度无关性，结论可跨越微观至宏观的广泛长度尺度进行推广。

title: Chiral Tubular Magnonic Crystals with Periodic Dzyaloshinskii--Moriya Interaction
summary: We introduce a chiral tubular magnonic crystal formed by a ferromagnetic nanotube with a periodically modulated interfacial Dzyaloshinskii--Moriya interaction (DMI). Using a plane-wave formalism adapted to the cylindrical geometry, we calculate the spin-wave band structure including exchange, nonlocal dipolar coupling, and interfacial DMI. We show that the tubular geometry qualitatively modifies the role of periodic DMI compared with planar chiral magnonic crystals. Besides producing the usual nonreciprocal frequency shift, curvature converts part of the interfacial DMI into an effective anisotropy-like internal field. This creates a sign-dependent frequency landscape along the tube, so that DMI-covered regions can act either as potential wells or barriers for the lowest-frequency modes. As a result, flat and weakly dispersive bands appear in both Damon--Eshbach-like and backward-volume-like configurations, with the latter having no direct counterpart in planar systems. Our results identify periodically engineered DMI in nanotubes as a route for controlling nonreciprocal spin waves, localized modes, and flat magnonic bands in curved architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种手性管状磁子晶体，由具有周期性调制的界面Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用（DMI）的铁磁纳米管构成。研究发现管状几何结构将部分界面DMI转化为类似各向异性的有效内场，从而产生与平面系统截然不同的自旋波带结构，包括平坦弱色散带和DMI区域作为势阱或势垒的现象。
AI.motivation: 探索弯曲几何（纳米管）中周期性DMI对自旋波传播的调控作用，超越平面手性磁子晶体的已知行为，为在曲面架构中控制非互易自旋波和局域模式提供新途径。
AI.method: 采用适配圆柱几何的平面波形式体系，计算包含交换作用、非局域偶极耦合和界面DMI的自旋波能带结构；系统比较管状与平面几何下周期性DMI的物理效应差异。
AI.result: 管状几何中曲率将部分界面DMI转化为类似各向异性的有效内场，产生依赖于DMI符号的频率景观；DMI覆盖区域可作为最低频模式的势阱或势垒；在Damon-Eshbach型和后退体积型两类构型中均出现平坦弱色散带，其中后者在平面系统中没有直接对应物。
AI.conclusion: 周期性工程化DMI的纳米管为在弯曲架构中控制非互易自旋波、局域模式和平坦磁子带提供了一条可行路线，拓展了磁子晶体在曲面平台上的设计空间。

title: Topological pair density waves in kagome superconductors
summary: The pair density wave (PDW) is an unconventional superconducting state exhibiting periodic pairing modulations due to pairing with finite momentum Q. In two dimensions, multiple Q components of the PDW can have a non-trivial relative phase, breaking time-reversal symmetry and resulting in a topological electronic structure. Here we review progress on exploring such topological PDWs (TPDWs) and discuss their potential realization in kagome superconductors. We first introduce the concept of a TPDW starting from the Fulde-Ferrell-Larkin-Ovchinnikov (FFLO) state and examine the challenges toward its realization. We then discuss the possibility of a TPDW in the kagome lattice, which intertwines with chiral superconductivity and loop currents, thus connecting to models describing the quantum anomalous Hall effect. Furthermore, we review the experimental signatures of a TPDW in AV3Sb5 (A = Cs, Rb, K) superconductors and highlight related quantum effects, including switchable chiral pairing modulations, Bogoliubov Fermi states, the superconducting diode effect, and the anomalous thermal Hall effect. Finally, we project the future research opportunities of this correlated topological quantum phase and discuss its broad implications for finite-momentum pairing, topological matter, and chiral superconductivity.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了拓扑配对密度波（TPDW）这一非常规超导态的研究进展，聚焦其二维系统中的实现、在kagome超导体中的潜在存在，以及AV3Sb5家族中的实验证据和相关量子效应。
AI.motivation: PDW是一种具有有限动量Q配对、产生周期性配对调制的非常规超导态。二维系统中多个Q分量可具有非平凡相对相位，打破时间反演对称性并形成拓扑电子结构。作者旨在系统梳理这一新兴领域的研究进展，探讨其物理机制与实验实现前景。
AI.method: 本文采用综述方法，首先从FFLO态出发引入TPDW概念并分析其实现挑战；随后讨论kagome晶格中TPDW的可能性，联系手性超导和环路电流；进而回顾AV3Sb5超导体中TPDW的实验特征（可切换手性配对调制、Bogoliubov费米态、超导二极管效应、异常热霍尔效应）；最后展望未来研究方向。
AI.result: 综述指出kagome超导体（尤其是AV3Sb5家族）是有望实现TPDW的平台，其与手性超导和环路电流交织，已观察到多种拓扑量子效应，包括可切换手性配对调制、Bogoliubov费米态、超导二极管效应和异常热霍尔效应等。
AI.conclusion: TPDW代表有限动量配对、拓扑物质和手性超导交汇处的重要关联拓扑量子相。未来研究有望在kagome超导体中进一步阐明其物理机制，并拓展到其他潜在材料体系。

title: Branching stochastic mechanics. I. Clustering and connected correlations within a branching-process representation of the Schrödinger equation
summary: Can finite-range correlations hide in the statistics of an extended quantum state? The Schrödinger-Nagasawa transform represents the wave function by positive forward and backward diffusion fields whose product is the Born density. We promote them to branching superprocesses, \(Φ_F\) and \(Φ_B\): diffusion samples stochastic paths, whereas Bohm/Fisher-controlled branching generates genealogies of alternative continuations. With rates evaluated on the prescribed Born density, their means reproduce Schrödinger dynamics exactly. The connected sector exhibits supercritical, critical, and subcritical clustering in confinement and has critical dimension \(d_c=2\) in free space. Stationary eigenmodes remain extended; subcritical clusters acquire the reduced de~Broglie scale. We then let the branching rate respond to the fluctuating product \(Φ_FΦ_B\). In the reciprocal basis, the fields equal a smooth reference \(R\) plus centered fluctuations \(ψ_F,ψ_B\), defining the signed kernel \(C_{\rm FB}(x,y)=\mathbb E_ω[ψ_F(x)ψ_B(y)]\). On the anticorrelated branch, \(ρ_{\rm BSM}(x)=-C_{\rm FB}(x,x)\) is the positive paired density. Stationary recovery requires its diagonal to match the Born profile, while off-diagonal decay defines the correlation range. The pair equation splits into collective and relative sectors: spectral cancellation selects the Born collective mode, while suppression of the leading density fluctuation selects the anticorrelated source channel. With relative diffusivity \(D_{\rm eff}\) and positive relaxation rate \(μ_{\rm FB}\), correlations have screening length \(ξ_{\rm FB}=\sqrt{D_{\rm eff}/μ_{\rm FB}}\). Thus an extended Born density and a finite correlation range can coexist in one stochastic kernel, suggesting particle-like organization.

AI.tldr: 本文通过Schrödinger-Nagasawa变换将波函数表示为正前向与后向扩散场的乘积，并将其提升为分支超过程Φ_F和Φ_B。在Born密度上评估的速率下，它们的均值精确再现Schrödinger动力学。作者进一步让分支速率响应于波动的乘积Φ_FΦ_B，定义符号核C_FB(x,y)，在反相关分支上得到正的配对密度ρ_BSM。通过谱消去选择Born集体模式，反相关源通道抑制主导密度涨落，相关长度ξ_FB=√(D_eff/μ_FB)与扩展的Born密度可共存于同一随机核中，暗示粒子状组织。
AI.motivation: 探索有限范围关联是否能隐藏在扩展量子态的统计中，旨在揭示波函数统计层面可能存在的粒子状组织机制，弥合量子力学与随机过程之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: 将Schrödinger-Nagasawa变换中的正/反向前向与后向扩散场提升为分支超过程；利用Bohm/Fisher控制的分支生成替代延续的谱系；分析连接扇区的超临界/临界/次临界聚类及临界维度d_c=2；随后让分支速率响应波动乘积Φ_FΦ_B，在互反基中定义符号核C_FB，推导配对密度与关联长度。
AI.result: 扩展态中可存在有限范围关联：连接扇区在自由空间中具有临界维度d_c=2，次临界团簇获得约化de Broglie尺度；配对方程分解为集体和相对扇区，谱消去选择Born集体模式，反相关源通道抑制主导密度涨落；关联具有屏蔽长度ξ_FB=√(D_eff/μ_FB)，扩展的Born密度与有限关联范围可共存。
AI.conclusion: 扩展Born密度与有限关联范围可以共存于一个随机核中，暗示量子态中可以出现粒子状组织——这为理解量子-经典过渡以及量子涨落的统计结构提供了新的随机过程框架。

title: Accelerated Quantum-Assisted Selected Configuration Interaction via Fast-Annealing-Based Determinant Selection
summary: Full configuration interaction (FCI) provides exact electronic structure within a given atomic basis, but its computational cost grows exponentially with the number of spin orbitals. Selected configuration interaction (SCI) methods alleviate this limitation by retaining only the most important Slater determinants. However, the repeated identification of important determinants remains a major computational bottleneck. We present a quantum assisted selected configuration interaction (QASCI) method that combines SCI with graph based block diagonalization (GBBD) of FCI Hamiltonian. The GBBD method partitions FCI Hamiltonian into independent blocks, within which determinant selection problem is formulated as a quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) problem. The QUBO problems for selecting determinants to construct SCI space are iteratively solved using a fast annealing approach. We benchmark method on H8-H18 hydrogen chains and Li2S in STO3G basis. For Hn chains, chemical accuracy is achieved while retaining only a small fraction of Slater determinants, and this fraction decreases with increasing n, despite the exponential growth of the FCI Hilbert space. For Li2S, QASCI results remain within chemical accuracy while retaining substantially fewer determinants than the full FCI space. We apply QASCI to N2 using the 631G basis, considering both active orbital and full orbital treatments. The full orbital QASCI calculation, using 50000 determinants, yields a lower ground state energy than an FCI calculation within an active space comprising 12 spin orbitals and 12 electrons. These results demonstrate that the combination of QASCI and the GBBD approach can substantially reduce computational cost of determinant selection while maintaining the accuracy of FCI based electronic structure calculations, thereby enabling accurate calculations in larger orbital spaces.

AI.tldr: 本文提出QASCI方法，结合量子辅助技术与图基块对角化（GBBD）来加速选择组态相互作用（SCI）中的行列式选择过程。通过将FCI哈密顿量划分为独立块，并将行列式选择问题转化为QUBO问题后用快速退火求解，在Hn链、Li2S和N2等体系中以极少行列式达到化学精度。
AI.motivation: FCI计算成本随自旋轨道数指数增长，SCI方法虽只保留重要Slater行列式，但重复识别重要行列式本身是主要计算瓶颈。作者希望利用量子计算辅助加速行列式选择，突破这一瓶颈。
AI.method: QASCI方法包含三个核心步骤：(1) 使用GBBD将FCI哈密顿量划分为独立的块；(2) 在每个块内将行列式选择问题建模为QUBO（二次无约束二值优化）问题；(3) 通过快速退火（fast annealing）方法迭代求解QUBO，从而构造SCI空间。
AI.result: 在H8-H18氢链和Li2S（STO-3G基组）上，QASCI以少量Slater行列式即可达到化学精度；且Hn链中所需行列式比例随n增大而下降。在N2（631G基组）全轨道计算中，仅用50000个行列式就获得比12自旋轨道12电子的活性空间FCI更低的基态能量。
AI.conclusion: QASCI结合GBBD能大幅降低行列式选择的计算成本，同时保持FCI基电子结构计算的精度，使得在更大轨道空间中进行精确计算成为可能。

title: Real-space manifestation of ferroic multipoles in altermagnetic MnF$_2$
summary: Altermagnets are unconventional spin split magnets arising from the zero spin-orbit coupled limit. They host a magnetic multipolar order parameter yet direct real-space observation of these multipoles has remained elusive.
