Here we use polarized-neutron diffraction to reconstruct the three-dimensional magnetization density of the prototypical altermagnet MnF$_2$. By exploiting symmetry-selective magnetic reflections, we separate the dominant spherical Mn$^{2+}$ contribution from the much weaker anisotropic Mn magnetization and the covalent spin polarization of the fluorine ligands. The reconstructed spin density reveals a finite fluorine ion moment together with an anisotropic Mn magnetization consistent with the symmetry-allowed altermagnetic rank-5 magnetic multipole $O_{52}$(magnetic triacontadipole). These results provide direct real-space evidence of ferroic multipolar order in an altermagnet and establish polarized-neutron diffraction as a powerful probe of hidden magnetic multipoles in quantum materials.

AI.tldr: 本文使用偏振中子衍射技术，首次在实空间中直接观测到了交错磁体（altermagnet）MnF₂中的磁性多极子序，重建了三维磁化密度，证实了秩-5磁性多极子O₅₂（磁性三十二极子）的存在，为量子材料中隐藏磁性多极子的探测建立了新的研究范式。
AI.motivation: 交错磁体（altermagnets）是一种源于零自旋轨道耦合极限的非传统自旋劈裂磁体，其拥有磁性多极子序参量，但长期以来缺乏实空间直接观测手段来证实这些多极子的存在。
AI.method: 利用偏振中子衍射技术，通过对称选择性磁反射，分离出占主导的球形Mn²⁺贡献、较弱的各向异性Mn磁化以及氟配体的共价自旋极化，从而重建三维磁化密度。
AI.result: 重建的自旋密度显示：存在有限的氟离子磁矩，同时Mn的各向异性磁化与交错磁体对称性允许的秩-5磁性多极子O₅₂（磁性三十二极子）相一致。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了交错磁体中铁性多极子序的直接实空间证据，并确立了偏振中子衍射作为探测量子材料中隐藏磁性多极子的有力工具。

title: Giant staggered Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya vectors emerged in synthetic antiferromagnets with spatially alternating stress
summary: Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya (DM) interaction is a source of chiral magnetic physics, and it manifests microstructural symmetry which could link to exotic magnetic and electronic properties such as altermagnetism. For a new paradigm in magnetism and spintronics, it is crucial to have control on the DM interaction as well as ordering of the DM vectors which characterize the DM interaction. Here, we report on a strong interlayer DM interaction emerged in Co/Ru magnetic superlattices whose structural symmetry is unambiguously broken by alternating mechanical strains developed using the peculiar technique of our stress mechanism. Moreover, theoretical analyses reveal that our magnetic superlattices host a staggered order of the DM vectors. Our results indicate that the spatially varying strains with our breakthrough technique are quite effective in breaking the symmetry of the system and prove that it can control the DM interaction strength as well as the DM vector order.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了通过特殊的应力机制在Co/Ru磁性超晶格中诱导出强层间Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya（DM）相互作用，并通过空间变化的应变打破结构对称性，实现了对DM相互作用强度及DM矢量序的控制。
AI.motivation: DM相互作用是手性磁物理的源头，且与微观结构对称性相关，可能联系到如交变磁性等奇异磁性和电子性质。为推进磁学和自旋电子学的新范式，亟需实现对DM相互作用强度及其矢量有序排列的控制。
AI.method: 采用特殊的应力机制技术在Co/Ru磁性超晶格中施加交替机械应变，明确打破结构对称性，从而产生强层间DM相互作用；并结合理论分析验证DM矢量的交错有序排列。
AI.result: 实验证实Co/Ru超晶格中产生了强层间DM相互作用，理论分析揭示DM矢量呈现交错有序排列，证明空间变化的应变能有效打破系统对称性并控制DM相互作用强度及DM矢量序。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的应力技术通过空间变化应变能有效控制DM相互作用的强度与DM矢量序，为磁性和自旋电子学的新范式提供了重要手段。

title: Coherent phononic frequency combs in ferroelectric CMOS oxides
summary: Modern electronic systems require tens of clock and carrier frequencies, each synthesized by a dedicated phase-locked loop from a shared reference, imposing routing, power and synchronization burdens that grow with every domain. Optical frequency combs solved this problem in photonics, whereas electronics has lacked an equivalent source in its native radiofrequency domain. Here we report broadband phononic frequency combs in ferroelectric hafnia-zirconia nanoelectromechanical resonators built from complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor (CMOS) oxides. Lithographically defined detuning of a 2:1 internal resonance selects the generation mechanism: two-tone-seeded wave mixing yields more than 170 lines distributed over two octaves, with mutual coherence verified for representative pump and generated lines, whereas an autonomous Hopf route yields hierarchical combs of more than 200 lines through torus and period-doubling dynamics, in agreement with slow-flow bifurcation theory. Geometric scaling extends comb generation across 0.44 GHz to 2.1 GHz. Heterodyne measurements, analyzed using the modified Allan deviation (MDEV), establish a two-timescale law. The mechanism governs short-term stability: seeded combs inherit the white-phase-noise scaling of their pumps, whereas autonomous combs acquire the phase diffusion of a free-running oscillator, with the one-second MDEV increasing from 1e-11 to 1e-8. The material governs long-term stability: in air and without active thermal control, the temperature-compensated stack suppresses the random-walk drift that dominates uncompensated resonators. These results establish mechanism- and material-level design rules for operating a single resonator as chip-scale frequency infrastructure, from multi-clock generation to radiofrequency parallel processing.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了基于铁电铪锆氧化物纳米机电谐振器的宽带声子频率梳，通过光刻定义的2:1内共振失谐选择产生机制，可实现170-200多条梳线，覆盖0.44 GHz到2.1 GHz，并建立了机制级和材料级的设计规则，为芯片级频率基础设施提供了新方案。
AI.motivation: 现代电子系统需要数十个时钟和载波频率，每个频率需由专用锁相环从共享参考合成，带来路由、功耗和同步负担。光子学中光频梳解决了这一问题，但电子学在其原生射频域缺少等效源。因此需要一种能在射频域产生宽带频率梳的电子学方案。
AI.method: 采用CMOS氧化物（铁电铪锆氧化物）构建纳米机电谐振器，通过光刻定义的2:1内共振失谐选择两种产生机制：(1)双音注入波混频产生170多条分布于两个倍频程的梳线；(2)自主Hopf路径经环面与倍频动力学产生200多条层次梳线。结合慢流分岔理论分析，并通过几何缩放实现0.44-2.1 GHz的梳生成。使用修正Allan方差（MDEV）对外差测量进行分析。
AI.result: 实现了超过170条（波混频）和200条（自主Hopf）梳线的宽带声子频率梳，覆盖两个倍频程。建立了双时间尺度定律：短程稳定性由机制决定（种子梳继承泵浦的白相位噪声缩放，自主梳表现为自由振荡器的相位扩散，1秒MDEV从1e-11退化到1e-8）；长程稳定性由材料决定（温度补偿堆叠抑制随机游走漂移）。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果建立了机制级和材料级的设计规则，使得单个谐振器可作为芯片级频率基础设施运行，用于多时钟生成到射频并行处理等多种应用，弥补了电子学在射频域缺少等效于光频梳的缺憾。

title: Controlling Intertwined Electronic Orders in FeSe with Exfoliation
summary: Controlling intertwined electronic orders in two-dimensional superconductors offers an effective route to answering fundamental questions and engineering new quantum devices. However, tuning the balance between competing orders typically requires complex chemistry, strain, or interface engineering. Here, we show that a pristine alternative is the dimensional reduction of the unconventional superconductor FeSe. Exfoliation suppresses the bulk electronic nematic response and switches the superconducting symmetry from bulk s-wave to d-wave-dominant. Transport, electron microscopy, and Raman spectroscopy establish the substantial weakening of nematic order in thin flakes. To probe superconductivity, we perform angle-dependent Andreev reflection spectroscopy on pristine crystal edges. As the junction's orientation is rotated, the spectra evolve from zero-energy bound states to coherence peaks. The injection angle, field, and temperature dependence, along with theoretical modeling, confirm that exfoliation switches the superconducting symmetry. Our results suggest a versatile superconducting platform for engineering quantum orders and provide fresh insights into the underlying pairing mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本文发现通过机械剥离将非常规超导体FeSe降维至薄片，可抑制其电子向列序并将超导对称性从体相s波转变为d波主导，为调控量子序提供了无需化学或应变工程的便捷途径。
AI.motivation: 在二维超导体中调控相互竞争的电子序对于回答基础物理问题和设计新型量子器件至关重要，但传统调控手段（化学掺杂、应变、界面工程）复杂且受限，亟需更简洁的原生调控策略。
AI.method: 通过机械剥离FeSe获得薄片实现维度降维，利用输运测量、电子显微镜和拉曼光谱表征向列序的减弱；采用角度依赖的Andreev反射谱学在原始晶体边缘探测超导对称性变化，并结合注入角、磁场和温度依赖性及理论建模进行验证。
AI.result: 剥离后的FeSe薄片中体相电子向列响应被显著抑制，超导对称性从s波转变为d波主导。Andreev反射谱随结取向旋转从零能束缚态演化为相干峰，明确证实了超导对称性的切换。
AI.conclusion: 维度降维可作为调控超导体电子序的有效原生途径，为工程化量子序提供了多功能平台，并为理解非常规超导配对机制提供了新见解。

title: Asymmetry-controlled resonant transport in a Brownian flashing ratchet
summary: We investigate directed transport in a one-dimensional Brownian flashing ratchet with a piecewise-linear asymmetric periodic potential. Numerical solutions of the Fokker--Planck equation and Brownian dynamics simulations reveal a nonmonotonic dependence of the stationary current on the switching frequency, with a resonant maximum whose position depends on the potential asymmetry $δ$ and barrier height $Δ$. For moderate asymmetry, $|δ|<0.5$, the current obeys a scaling form that separates the dependence on the potential parameters from a common frequency dependence, resulting in a data collapse upon appropriate scaling of the current and frequency. The current amplitude varies linearly with $δ$, while the resonance frequency follows $ν(δ,Δ)=ν_0(Δ)/ [1-b_0\, δ^2]$. We interpret the resulting $(1-δ^2)^{-1}$ scaling in terms of coupled relaxation along the two branches of the asymmetric potential, which provides a physical basis for the observed dependence of the resonant frequency on the potential asymmetry.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一维布朗闪烁棘轮中的定向输运现象，发现稳态电流随开关频率呈非单调变化并存在共振极大值，该共振位置依赖于势不对称性和势垒高度。对于中等不对称性（|δ|<0.5），电流服从标度形式，实现了数据塌缩；电流振幅随δ线性变化，共振频率遵循ν(δ,Δ)=ν0(Δ)/[1-b0δ²]的关系，该(1-δ²)⁻¹标度可解释为不对称势两分支间的耦合弛豫。
AI.motivation: 理解闪烁棘轮中势能不对称性如何影响定向输运的共振行为，以及揭示共振频率与势不对称性之间的定量关系及其背后的物理机制。
AI.method: 采用Fokker-Planck方程的数值求解和布朗动力学模拟两种方法，研究分段线性不对称周期势下的布朗闪烁棘轮；通过标度分析实现数据塌缩，并基于两分支耦合弛豫的物理图像解释共振频率的标度行为。
AI.result: 发现电流对开关频率呈非单调依赖，存在共振最大值；中等不对称性下电流满足标度形式，电流振幅与δ呈线性关系，共振频率满足ν(δ,Δ)=ν0(Δ)/[1-b0δ²]。
AI.conclusion: 不对称势的两分支耦合弛豫为共振频率对势不对称性的依赖提供了物理解释，即(1-δ²)⁻¹的标度规律。

title: Frequency-resolved ultrafast electron diffraction: visualizing vibrational dynamics in frequency- and real-space
summary: Ultrafast electron diffraction (UED) provides direct information on changes in molecular structure following photoexcitation, but identifying the individual vibrational motions contributing to these dynamics remains challenging. Here, we introduce frequency-resolved UED, where Fourier transformation of the time-dependent difference pair distribution function ($Δ$PDF) gives a two-dimensional frequency-distance representation of the structural dynamics. We apply this approach to allene and 1,2-butadiene following photoexcitation to the $S_1(ππ^*)$ state at 200 nm, using electron scattering signals simulated from previously-published ab initio multiple spawning trajectories (S. P. Neville et al., J. Chem. Phys., 2016, 144, 014305). We identify C=C stretching and CCC bending motions and the internuclear distances over which they contribute, and separate overlapping CH$_2$ vibrational motions. By changing the pump-probe delay range used for the Fourier transform, we identify when specific frequency components contribute during the excited-state dynamics. Methyl substitution reduces the C=C stretching and CCC bending frequencies and introduces an additional frequency component in 1,2-butadiene during the first 90 fs. We further show the importance of sub-20-fs, and ultimately few-femtosecond, temporal resolution for retrieving these frequency components. Frequency-resolved UED therefore provides the vibrational frequencies, internuclear distances, and reaction times associated with photoinduced structural dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出频率分辨的超快电子衍射（frequency-resolved UED）方法，通过对时间依赖的差分对分布函数（ΔPDF）进行傅里叶变换，得到二维的频率-距离结构动力学表示，从而能够识别光激发后分子结构动力学中各个振动模式及其贡献的核间距。
AI.motivation: 超快电子衍射（UED）能提供光激发后分子结构变化的直接信息，但识别驱动这些动力学的单个振动运动仍然具有挑战性，需要新方法将结构动力学与特定振动模式联系起来。
AI.method: 提出频率分辨UED方法：对时间分辨的差分对分布函数进行傅里叶变换，生成二维频率-距离图谱；将该方法应用于丙二烯（allene）和1,2-丁二烯（1,2-butadiene）在200 nm激发到S₁(ππ*)态后的光激发动力学，基于已发表的从头算多重产生（AIMS）轨迹模拟电子散射信号进行分析。
AI.result: 成功识别了C=C伸缩和CCC弯曲振动及其贡献的核间距范围，并能分离重叠的CH₂振动运动；通过改变泵浦-探测延迟范围可确定各频率分量在激发态动力学中出现的时间窗口；发现甲基取代降低了C=C伸缩和CCC弯曲频率，并在1,2-丁二烯前90 fs内引入了额外频率分量；同时证明了亚20飞秒（乃至几飞秒）时间分辨率对提取这些频率分量的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 频率分辨UED能够提供与光致结构动力学相关的振动频率、核间距和反应时间信息，是一种强大的分析工具，可用于深入理解光激发后的分子结构变化机制。

title: Electronic phase separation and emergence of a nondimerized insulating phase in VO$_2$ $(110)_{\mathit{R}}$ ultrathin films
comment: 30 pages (incl. 8-page Supplement); 4 figures in the main text and 5 in the Supplement. Contact author: Daisuke Shiga
summary: Using in situ photoemission spectroscopy and x-ray absorption spectroscopy, we investigated the thickness dependence of the electronic structure and V-V dimerization in VO$_2$/TiO$_2$ (110) ultrathin films, in which the one-dimensional V-V chains along the $c_{\mathit{R}}$ axis lie in the film plane. In VO$_2$ $(110)_{\mathit{R}}$ films, the reduction in dimensionality along the surface-normal direction is not expected to impose a geometric constraint on V-V dimerization, unlike in VO$_2$ $(001)_{\mathit{R}}$ films. Nevertheless, the characteristic spectral changes associated with the temperature-driven metal-insulator transition observed in thick films persist down to 1.5 nm, whereas at 1 nm an insulating electronic phase is observed without V-V dimerization. This behavior is highly similar to that reported for VO$_2$ $(001)_{\mathit{R}}$, suggesting that the enhancement of Mott instability resulting from reduced dimensionality is a common and essential driving force for the emergence of the nondimerized insulating phase in VO$_2$ ultrathin films. Meanwhile, unlike in VO$_2$ $(001)_{\mathit{R}}$, the nondimerized insulating phase in VO$_2$ $(110)_{\mathit{R}}$ coexists with the phase exhibiting the temperature-driven metal-insulator transition. Its fraction increases exponentially with decreasing thickness and becomes dominant at 1 nm. The corresponding effective critical thickness is estimated to be 2.2 nm. These results imply that the geometric orientation of the V-V chains dictates the spatial evolution of electronic phase separation via strain-mediated phase competition.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用原位光电子能谱和X射线吸收谱，系统研究了VO₂/TiO₂(110)超薄膜中电子结构和V-V二聚化的厚度依赖性。发现1.5 nm以上的薄膜仍保持厚膜的温度驱动金属-绝缘体转变特征，而1 nm时出现无V-V二聚化的绝缘电子相。该无二聚化绝缘相与转变相共存，其比例随厚度减薄呈指数增加，有效临界厚度约为2.2 nm，表明V-V链的几何取向通过应变介导的相竞争主导电子相分离的空间演化。
AI.motivation: 研究超薄膜中维度降低对VO₂金属-绝缘体转变的影响，特别关注V-V二聚化与Mott不稳定性之间的竞争关系，以及V-V链几何取向如何影响电子相分离行为。此前已有VO₂(001)ₚₒₛ的研究，但(110)取向能解耦几何约束与维度效应，从而阐明维度降低的本质作用。
AI.method: 采用原位光电子能谱（PES）和X射线吸收谱（XAS），对VO₂/TiO₂(110)超薄膜进行了厚度依赖的电子结构和V-V二聚化表征。对比了不同厚度薄膜（1 nm至厚膜）的光谱特征随温度的变化，并与VO₂(001)ₚₒₛ薄膜的结果进行比较分析。
AI.result: 在VO₂(110)ₚₒₛ薄膜中，(1)厚度降至1.5 nm仍能观察到与厚膜相似的温度驱动金属-绝缘体转变的光谱特征；(2)1 nm时出现无V-V二聚化的绝缘电子相；(3)该无二聚化绝缘相与具有温度驱动MIT的相共存，其比例随厚度减薄呈指数增加，并在1 nm时成为主导相；(4)有效临界厚度约为2.2 nm。
AI.conclusion: 维度降低引起的Mott不稳定性增强是VO₂超薄膜中无二聚化绝缘相出现的共同且本质的驱动力，与V-V链的几何取向无关。然而，V-V链的几何取向通过应变介导的相竞争，决定了电子相分离的空间演化模式：(110)ₚₒₛ中两相共存并随厚度改变占比，而(001)ₚₒₛ中表现出不同的相行为。

title: Symmetry-Preserving Phase Transitions in $AM_2$Al$_9$ Materials under Pressure
summary: External parameters such as temperature, pressure, and chemical doping can induce structural phase transitions in materials. Although such transitions usually involve a change in symmetry, an uncommon exception is the isostructural phase transition, which is first order yet preserves the symmetry of the parent structure. Using first-principles calculations, we show that $AM_2$Al$_9$ compounds ($A$ = Ba, Ca, Sr, or Eu; $M$ = Fe, Co, or Ni) undergo pressure-induced isostructural phase transitions. At the transition pressure, these systems exhibit a pronounced volume collapse while retaining the same crystal symmetry and space group ($P6/mmm$). Bonding analysis based on the integrated crystal orbital Hamilton population (ICOHP) shows that the transition is driven by a redistribution of bonding character between intralayer and interlayer atomic bonds. Because isostructural transitions are rare in single crystals, $AM_2$Al$_9$ provides a promising platform for investigating critical phenomena under pressure and for deepening our understanding of symmetry-preserving structural transitions.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理计算发现AM₂Al₉化合物（A = Ba, Ca, Sr, Eu；M = Fe, Co, Ni）在压力下会发生同构相变，即保持空间群P6/mmm对称性不变但体积突然塌缩的一级相变。ICOHP键合分析表明该相变由层内与层间原子键的成键特征重分布所驱动。
AI.motivation: 同构相变在材料中极为罕见，它是一级相变却不改变母体结构的对称性，这种特殊的相变类型对理解对称性保持的结构转变具有重要意义，但目前缺乏合适的研究平台。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations）研究AM₂Al₉化合物的压力诱导相变，并通过积分晶体轨道哈密顿布居数（ICOHP）进行键合分析。
AI.result: AM₂Al₉化合物在特定转变压力下发生同构相变，表现为显著的体积塌缩，同时保持P6/mmm空间群对称性不变。ICOHP分析揭示了相变机制为层内和层间原子键之间成键特征的重新分配。
AI.conclusion: AM₂Al₉体系为研究压力下的临界现象以及深化对对称性保持结构转变的理解提供了有前景的材料平台。

title: Surface-mediated frequency aging beyond quality-factor saturation in an AlScN-on-silicon resonator
summary: Vacuum package integrity in micro- and nanoelectromechanical resonators is commonly assessed through the quality factor Q, although Q probes residual-gas damping rather than the surface-state evolution that can govern frequency aging. Here, we disentangle the pressure responses of Q and the resonance frequency f0 in a 64.21 MHz Al0.7Sc0.3N-on-silicon cross-sectional Lamé-mode resonator between 0.01 to 760 Torr. Measurements at 25 °C and at the 68.8°C frequency turnover, where first-order thermal sensitivity is suppressed, reveal widely separated equilibration timescales. Following each pressure step, Q reaches a reversible, history-independent steady value on the pressure-control timescale and approaches a fitted pressure-independent ceiling of 8.5e4 below approximately 1 Torr. By contrast, f0 responds measurably down to 1e-5 Torr and remains history-dependent, relaxing for hours at fixed pressure. The transients follow stretched-exponential kinetics, consistent with a broad distribution of surface relaxation rates, and individual pressure steps produce fractional frequency shifts as large as 1.9 ppm. Ten-hour phase-locked measurements show a common short-term time-deviation floor near 1e-10 s from 0.01 to 100 Torr, whereas residual deterministic relaxation dominates at long averaging times; at 760 Torr, gas damping degrades short-term tracking through the reduced Q. These results establish gas-damping equilibrium and frequency equilibrium as distinct states. Quality-factor saturation alone is therefore insufficient to qualify vacuum packaging for precision mechanical frequency references; package specifications must also constrain surface-mediated frequency aging.

AI.tldr: 本文通过解耦64.21 MHz Al0.7Sc0.3N-on-silicon谐振器中品质因数Q和共振频率f0对压力的响应，发现Q和频率平衡是两种不同的状态。Q在约1 Torr以下达到可逆的饱和值（8.5e4），而f0在低至1e-5 Torr仍可响应且具有历史依赖性，呈现数小时的拉伸指数弛豫动力学，单个压力步进可产生高达1.9 ppm的频移。因此仅凭Q饱和不足以验证真空封装的可靠性，必须额外约束表面介导的频率老化。
AI.motivation: 真空封装完整性通常通过Q来评估，但Q检测的是残余气体阻尼，而非决定频率老化的表面态演变。作者旨在证明Q平衡与频率平衡是两种独立状态，并揭示仅依赖Q饱和来评估封装质量可能不够充分。
AI.method: 在0.01至760 Torr压力范围内，对64.21 MHz Al0.7Sc0.3N硅基横截面Lamé模式谐振器进行测量；在25°C和68.8°C频率转折点（一阶热灵敏度被抑制处）分别测试Q和f0的压力响应；使用相位锁定测量、拉伸指数动力学拟合和时域偏差分析来表征瞬态行为和短期稳定性。
AI.result: Q在压力步进后可逆地达到历史无关的稳态值，在低于约1 Torr时逼近8.5e4的无压力依赖上限；f0在低至1e-5 Torr仍有可测响应，历史依赖且需数小时弛豫，遵循拉伸指数动力学。单个压力步进产生高达1.9 ppm的分数频移；10小时相位锁定测量显示短期时域偏差下限约1e-10 s，但残余确定性弛豫主导长平均时间。
AI.conclusion: 气体阻尼平衡与频率平衡是截然不同的状态，Q饱和不能作为真空封装充分性的唯一判据。精密机械频率参考的封装规范还必须约束表面介导的频率老化效应。

title: Competition between on-site and off-site pairing phases and surface spectra in superconducting wallpaper fermion systems
summary: We theoretically investigate the competition between on-site and off-site pairings in superconducting topological crystalline insulators hosting wallpaper fermions, a class of surface states protected by nonsymmorphic symmetries. In-plane nearest-neighbor pair hopping stabilizes the $\mathrm{A_{1u}}$ phase, while off-site pairing channels yield additional dominant phases with $\mathrm{B_{2u}}$ and $\mathrm{E_u}$ representations. We further show that the $\mathrm{B_{2u}}$ pairing state supports the hybridization between wallpaper-fermion spectra themselves, whereas a representative time-reversal-invariant nematic $\mathrm{E_u}$ state exhibits spectral hybridization between wallpaper fermion and double Majorana Kramers pairs, yielding twisted surface energy spectra. These results demonstrate that the twisted dispersions arising from hybridization phenomena persist in the presence of off-site pairing interactions.

AI.tldr: 本文从理论上研究了拓扑晶体绝缘体中壁纸费米子（wallpaper fermions）表面的在位与离位配对竞争，发现面内最近邻配对稳定A1u相，而离位配对通道产生B2u和Eu优势相。B2u态支持壁纸费米子谱间的杂化，而Eu态则展示壁纸费米子与双重马约拉纳Kramers对之间的谱杂化，产生扭曲的表面能谱。
AI.motivation: 探究拓扑晶体绝缘体表面态（壁纸费米子）在不同配对通道竞争下的超导相变行为，特别是离位配对相互作用对表面能谱杂化现象的影响。
AI.method: 理论分析：对非对称空间群保护的表面态（壁纸费米子）进行在位与离位配对通道的系统研究，分析各配对通道（A1u、B2u、Eu）所对应的超导相稳定性及能谱杂化行为。
AI.result: 面内最近邻配对稳定A1u相；离位配对产生B2u和Eu优势相。B2u配对态导致壁纸费米子谱间杂化，而时间反演不变的向列Eu态导致壁纸费米子与双重马约拉纳Kramers对之间的谱杂化，产生扭曲的表面能谱。
AI.conclusion: 由杂化现象产生的扭曲色散在离位配对相互作用存在时依然保持，表明该类杂化效应具有鲁棒性。

title: Cesium Clustering and Fluoroberyllate Network Disruption in FLiBe: A Total Scattering and Molecular Dynamics Study
summary: Several next-generation fission reactor designs employ molten salts such as FLiBe (2LiF-BeF$_2$), with some concepts using fuel dissolved directly in the salt. During operation, fission products such as cesium will accumulate in the salt mixture, potentially leading to an evolution of the thermophysical properties underpinned by the atomic structure. To understand the structural perturbations in FLiBe with 5 mol% CsF, we conducted X-ray and neutron diffraction measurements, refined empirical potential structure refinement (EPSR) models against the experimental data, and compared the resulting structure with neural network molecular dynamics (NNMD) simulations. Comparisons of the EPSR and NNMD structures distinguishes features constrained by the scattering data from those that remain model dependent. The new Cs-bearing correlations account for the changes in the total structure factor and pair-distribution function, while the FLiBe correlations remain minimally altered. We find that Cs slightly disrupts the intermediate-range fluoroberyllate network, increasing the fraction of free fluorine ions, while the local coordination remains largely unchanged. The Cs ions within FLiBe cluster extensively, with BeF$_4^{2-}$ tetrahedra bridging neighboring cesium environments. In contrast to the minor structural perturbations in the liquid, the addition of 5 mol% CsF suppressed the formation of the crystalline Li2BeF4 phase at room temperature, with the phase appearing only above 180C upon heating. These experimentally constrained structural features provide a benchmark for atomistic models used to predict the behavior and properties of fission-product-containing FLiBe.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过X射线和中子衍射实验，结合经验势结构精修（EPSR）和神经网络分子动力学（NNMD）模拟，系统地研究了含5 mol% CsF的FLiBe熔盐的原子结构。研究发现Cs仅轻微扰动氟铍酸盐中间程网络，增加自由氟离子比例，但局部配位基本不变；Cs离子在FLiBe中广泛聚集，BeF4²⁻四面体桥接相邻Cs环境。值得注意的是，5 mol% CsF的添加抑制了室温下结晶Li2BeF4相的形成，该相仅在加热至180°C以上才出现。
AI.motivation: 下一代裂变反应堆设计中采用FLiBe等熔盐，部分概念将燃料直接溶解在盐中。运行期间裂变产物（如铯）会在盐混合物中积累，可能导致由原子结构支撑的热物理性质发生变化。理解这种结构扰动对于预测含裂变产物熔盐的行为至关重要，但目前缺乏对Cs掺杂FLiBe结构的全面实验约束研究。
AI.method: 结合X射线和中子衍射实验测量获取结构数据，使用经验势结构精修（EPSR）方法对实验数据进行模型精修，并与神经网络分子动力学（NNMD）模拟结果进行对比，以区分受散射数据约束的结构特征与模型依赖的特征。通过EPSR与NNMD的结构对比来全面表征Cs引入后的结构变化。
AI.result: 新的Cs相关关联解释了总结构因子和偏分布函数的变化，而FLiBe相关关联几乎不变。Cs略微破坏了氟铍酸盐中间程网络，增加了自由氟离子比例，但局部配位基本不变。Cs离子在FLiBe中广泛聚集，BeF4²⁻四面体桥接相邻Cs环境。添加5 mol% CsF抑制了室温下结晶Li2BeF4相的形成，该相仅在加热至180°C以上出现。
AI.conclusion: 这些实验约束的结构特征为预测含裂变产物FLiBe行为的原子模型提供了基准。研究明确了散射数据强约束的结构特征与模型依赖特征之间的区别，对下一代熔盐反应堆中燃料盐的结构-性能关系的理解具有重要意义。

title: Evolving charge order in the CDW state of AV$_3$Sb$_5$ metals
summary: AV$_3$Sb$_5$ kagome metals are characterized by intertwined electronic and structural orders, which motivated extensive studies in recent years. Yet the details of the electronic state preceding the superconducting phase remain poorly understood. Here we extend our previous investigation [Phys. Rev. Research 7, L032046 (2025)] of RbV$_3$Sb$_5$ using avoided level crossing (ALC) muon-spin spectroscopy to the $A$ = Cs and K systems. Consistent with our previous study, we identify a second transition whose origin cannot be attributed solely to an internal magnetic field, indicating the involvement of an additional electronic mechanism that subtly modifies the charge distribution within the V plane. In particular, the ALC results point towards an additional charge modulation taking place within the charge density wave (CDW) phase and occurring at $T^{*}<T_{CDW}$ for $A$ = Cs and Rb, or in the vicinity of $T_{CDW}$ for $A$ = K.

AI.tldr: 该研究将avoided level crossing (ALC) μ子自旋谱学方法从RbV₃Sb₅扩展到CsV₃Sb₅和KV₃Sb₅ kagome金属，发现这些体系中存在一个无法仅归因于内磁场效应的第二相变，表明在CDW相内部存在额外的电荷调制机制。
AI.motivation: AV₃Sb₅ kagome金属中电子与结构有序相互交织，但超导相之前的电子态细节仍不清楚。作者希望通过系统研究不同A位元素（Cs和K），并与之前Rb体系的研究对比，深入理解CDW相中的额外电子机制。
AI.method: 采用avoided level crossing (ALC) μ子自旋谱学技术，对CsV₃Sb₅和KV₃Sb₅进行测量，并与此前RbV₃Sb₅的研究结果进行对比分析。
AI.result: 在A = Cs和K体系中均确认存在第二个转变，该转变不能仅由内部磁场解释，暗示存在额外的电子机制微妙地改变了V平面内的电荷分布。ALC结果指向CDW相内部存在额外的电荷调制，对Cs和Rb发生在T*<T_CDW处，对K发生在接近T_CDW处。
AI.conclusion: kagome金属AV₃Sb₅系列体系中普遍存在一种超出单纯磁性起源的额外电子转变，该转变涉及CDW相内的电荷分布修改，且其温度位置随A位元素不同而变化，揭示了该材料家族中更丰富的电子有序图景。

title: Orbital occupation selects structural dimensionality in binary transition-metal oxides
summary: Orbital-lattice coupling in transition-metal oxides is usually discussed within a given bonding framework, where orbital occupation is intertwined with local coordination, strain, or symmetry breaking. Here, we show that orbital occupation can also select the bonding framework itself, thereby determining structural dimensionality. Using first-principles calculations, we identify CrO as a prototype in which the single active $3d\,e_g$ electron of high-spin Cr$^{2+}$ gives rise to two competing orbital-structure states. The $d_{x^2-y^2}$ occupation favors a three-dimensionally connected covalent phase, whereas the $d_{z^2}$ occupation stabilizes a weakly coupled layered phase. Constrained-occupation calculations show that increasing the $d_{z^2}$ filling continuously contracts the in-plane lattice while expanding the structure along the layer normal. The two phases exhibit distinct magnetic ground states and ferroelastic responses. Moreover, the layered phase is robust against exchange-correlation functional and on-site ($U$) variations, remains dynamically stable down to the monolayer limit, and has a low exfoliation energy of 46 meV/Angstrom^2. Extending the analysis across related $3d$ binary oxides reveals a filling-dependence relation between accessible orbital filling and the preference for 2D or 3D connected bonding motifs, providing a microscopic basis for exploring low-dimensional oxide materials.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理计算发现，过渡金属氧化物中轨道占据本身可以决定键合框架的选择，从而确定结构维度。以CrO为原型，高自旋Cr²⁺的单个3d e_g电子在d_{x²-y²}和d_{z²}两种占据下分别偏好三维共价相和弱耦合层状相，并系统揭示了轨道占据与结构维度之间的填充依赖关系。
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为轨道-晶格耦合通常发生在给定的键合框架内，即轨道占据与配位环境、应变或对称性破缺相互交织，但轨道占据是否能够反过来主动选择键合框架本身（从而决定结构维度）这一问题尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算，以CrO为研究对象，通过受约束占据计算系统研究d_{z²}填充分数对晶格参数的影响；并通过交换关联泛函和U值变化测试层状相的稳健性，同时计算单层动态稳定性和剥离能，最后将分析扩展到相关3d二元氧化物以揭示普遍规律。
AI.result: 发现d_{x²-y²}占据稳定三维连通共价相，d_{z²}占据稳定弱耦合层状相；增加d_{z²}填充连续收缩面内晶格并沿层法向扩张。层状相在不同泛函和U值下稳健，单层极限仍动态稳定，剥离能低至46 meV/Å²。扩展分析揭示了轨道填充与2D/3D键合偏好之间的普遍关系。两种相还表现出不同的磁基态和铁弹响应。
AI.conclusion: 轨道占据不仅是键合框架内的自由度，还可以主动选择键合框架，从而决定材料的结构维度。这一发现为设计低维氧化物材料提供了微观基础，建立了轨道填充与结构维度偏好之间的系统性关联。

title: Fractional Impurity Entropy from Potential Scattering in a Free Electron Gas
summary: Fractional changes in entropy are often associated with strong electron correlations or non-Abelian anyons in topological systems. We show that neither condition is necessary -- a system of free electrons on a ring scattering off a repulsive point-like impurity undergoes a $k_B\ln\sqrt 2$ entropy change as the impurity strength is increased. This effect arises from a shift of allowed single-particle momenta from integer quantization to half-integer quantization, induced by the impurity. We show that this fractional entropy change is universal across a broad class of single-particle dispersions, demonstrating that such signatures can arise without strong correlations or topological order.

AI.tldr: 本文证明自由电子环上加入一个排斥性点状杂质即可产生 k_B ln√2 的分数熵变，无需强电子关联或非阿贝尔任意子。该效应源于杂质将允许的单粒子动量从整数量子化转变为半整数量子化，且对多种单粒子色散关系具有普适性。
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为分数熵变通常与强电子关联或拓扑系统中的非阿贝尔任意子相关。作者旨在证明这一条件并非必要，从而挑战现有认知，指出更简单的自由电子系统也能产生类似信号。
AI.method: 考虑一个自由电子环上存在排斥性点状杂质，分析杂质强度增加时系统单粒子动量量子化条件的变化（从整数到半整数），并推导相应的熵变。进一步检验该效应在不同单粒子色散关系下的普适性。
AI.result: 系统在杂质强度增加时发生 k_B ln√2 的熵变，该熵变源于动量量子化从整数向半整数的转变，且此普适分数熵变在广泛的单粒子色散关系中均成立。
AI.conclusion: 分数熵变并非强关联或拓扑序的独特标志，简单自由电子系统在点状杂质作用下即可产生此类信号，这提醒实验解释需更谨慎。

title: Magnetic contacts on freestanding superconducting LaAlO$_3$/SrTiO$_3$ micromembranes
summary: The superconducting two-dimensional electron gas (2DEG) at the LaAlO$_3$/SrTiO$_3$ (LAO-STO) interface is a promising platform for superconducting spintronics, however, integrating ferromagnetic contacts with the superconducting 2DEG remains challenging. Here, we realize superconducting LAO-STO micromembrane devices contacted by ferromagnetic nickel contacts through a side-contact geometry. Low-temperature transport measurements demonstrate that superconductivity is preserved in the presence of the ferromagnetic contacts. We show that the superconducting state is strongly influenced by the magnetic history of the nickel contacts, which generates a tunable effective magnetic field in the 2DEG. Through an effective field model, the magnetization of the contacts can be inferred from the maximum superconducting response. Our results establish ferromagnetically contacted LAO-STO as a platform for future investigations of spin injection into oxide superconductors and provide a route towards superconducting spintronic devices based on complex oxide interfaces.

AI.tldr: 本文在LaAlO3/SrTiO3（LAO-STO）界面超导二维电子气上，通过侧接触几何结构成功集成了铁磁性镍接触，实现了超导与铁磁材料的共存，并通过有效磁场模型从超导响应推断出接触的磁化强度，为氧化物超导自旋电子学提供了新平台。
AI.motivation: LAO-STO界面的超导二维电子气是超导自旋电子学的有前景平台，但将铁磁接触与超导二维电子气集成一直具有挑战性，这是阻碍自旋注入研究的关键瓶颈。
AI.method: 采用侧接触几何结构，将铁磁性镍接触与超导LAO-STO微膜器件集成；通过低温输运测量表征超导性；提出有效磁场模型，从最大超导响应推断镍接触的磁化状态。
AI.result: 在存在铁磁接触的情况下超导性得以保持；镍接触的磁历史会通过产生可调有效磁场强烈影响超导态；通过有效磁场模型可从超导响应推断出接触的磁化强度。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了铁磁接触LAO-STO作为研究向氧化物超导体自旋注入的新平台，为基于复杂氧化物界面的超导自旋电子器件提供了可行路线。

title: d'Q = TdS for Infinitesimal Irreversible Processes: On the Differential Form of the Clausius Inequality
summary: Conventionally, the differential form of the Clausius inequality is adopted for infinitesimal irreversible processes. We show that the correct first-order form for infinitesimal quasi-static irreversible processes is the equality d'Q=TdS rather than d'Q < TdS. This provides a purely thermodynamic proof that internal entropy production is second-order or higher and confirms that entropy remains a well-defined state quantity even when quasi-static irreversible processes are included, without resorting to the Boltzmann relation.

AI.tldr: 本文指出，对于无限小准静态不可逆过程，Clausius不等式的正确一阶形式应为等式d'Q=TdS而非不等式d'Q<TdS，从而证明内熵产生是二阶或更高阶的小量，并确认即使在包含准静态不可逆过程的情况下熵仍是良定义的状态量。
AI.motivation: 传统上，Clausius不等式以微分形式d'Q<TdS应用于无限小不可逆过程，但作者认为对于无限小准静态不可逆过程，正确的形式应是一阶等式。这一修正无需借助Boltzmann关系即可纯粹地从热力学角度证明熵的定义一致性。
AI.method: 通过严格的热力学分析，重新审视无限小准静态不可逆过程中Clausius不等式的微分形式，指出一阶项应满足等式关系d'Q=TdS，而熵产生项属于二阶或更高阶的小量。
AI.result: 证明了无限小准静态不可逆过程中热交换的一阶形式应为d'Q=TdS，内部熵产生为二阶或更高阶量，熵仍然是良定义的状态函数。
AI.conclusion: 该结果为热力学基本理论的严谨性提供了重要的修正，表明无需借助统计力学（Boltzmann关系）即可在唯象热力学框架内保证熵作为状态量的合理性。

title: Crystal electric field excitations and an effective-spin-$1/2$ ground doublet in the hyperkagome magnet Yb$_3$Sc$_2$Ga$_3$O$_{12}$
summary: We use inelastic neutron scattering (INS) to determine the crystal electric field (CEF) excitations of Yb$^{3+}$ in the rare-earth hyperkagome magnet Yb$_3$Sc$_2$Ga$_3$O$_{12}$. Three nearly dispersionless magnetic excitations are observed near 58, 68, and 74~meV, corresponding to transitions from the ground-state Kramers doublet to the three excited doublets of the $J=7/2$ multiplet. A Stevens-operator analysis constrained by the local $222$ ($D_2$) symmetry reproduces the excitation energies and spectral weights and yields an Ising-type ground-state $g$ tensor. The first excited doublet lies approximately 58~meV above the ground state, establishing a well-isolated effective $J_{\mathrm{eff}}=1/2$ degree of freedom over the low-temperature regime relevant to collective magnetism. Notably, the directly measured CEF spectrum substantially revises the level scheme previously inferred from bulk measurements, while preserving the essential low-energy pseudospin description. Two independent fitting protocols give consistent excitation energies, ground-doublet wave functions, and $g$ tensors, despite the nonuniqueness of the individual CEF parameters. The resulting single-ion model also reproduces the characteristic susceptibility, magnetization, and field evolution of the Schottky anomaly in specific heat. These results establish the microscopic single-ion basis needed to construct an effective exchange Hamiltonian and to interpret future measurements of low-energy collective excitations in Yb$_3$Sc$_2$Ga$_3$O$_{12}$.

AI.tldr: 本文利用非弹性中子散射（INS）直接测量了稀土hyperkagome磁体Yb₃Sc₂Ga₃O₁₂中Yb³⁺的晶体电场（CEF）激发，发现三个近无色散的磁激发（约58、68、74 meV），通过Stevens算符分析建立了单离子模型，证实了有效J_eff=1/2自由度，并修正了此前基于体测量推断的能级方案。
AI.motivation: hyperkagome晶格磁体中，单离子晶体电场（CEF）能级是理解集体磁性的微观基础。此前对Yb₃Sc₂Ga₃O₁₂的能级方案仅通过体测量（磁化率、比热等）间接推断，缺乏直接的微观谱学证据，需要高精度的INS实验来直接测定CEF激发谱。
AI.method: 采用非弹性中子散射（INS）直接测量Yb³⁺的CEF激发；利用局部D₂（222）对称性约束的Stevens算符分析拟合激发能量和谱权重；采用两种独立的拟合方案交叉验证；结合磁化率、磁化和比热Schottky异常等体测量的验证。
AI.result: 观测到三个近无色散磁激发（58、68、74 meV），对应J=7/2多重态中从基态Kramers二重态到三个激发二重态的跃迁；得到Ising型基态g张量；第一激发态位于约58 meV以上，确认了低温区良好隔离的有效J_eff=1/2自由度；直接测量的CEF谱显著修正了此前体测量推断的能级方案，但保持了低能赝自旋描述。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了Yb₃Sc₂Ga₃O₁₂的微观单离子模型基础，为构建有效交换哈密顿量以及解释未来低能集体激发的测量提供了关键输入，对理解hyperkagome几何阻挫磁体的量子磁性具有重要意义。

title: Can a Spin Liquid State Persist as the Ground State in the Presence of Competing Interactions and Disorder?
summary: In this report, we have shown that, in an otherwise geometrically frustrated lattice, the underlying interactions compete to stabilize different magnetic phases. In conjunction with fluctuations, these interactions may lead to the formation of unusual ordered phases, providing a pathway for understanding the fluctuation-driven order-by-disorder phenomenon. This competition is further modified by the presence of inherent structural disorder in a frustrated two-dimensional lattice. Furthermore, due to the local nature of the additional structural disorder, the majority of the samples evolve toward glassy dynamics, which can not only mimic spin-liquid-like behavior but also make it difficult to identify genuine spin-liquid candidates experimentally.

AI.tldr: 本文报告了在几何阻挫晶格中，底层相互作用竞争会稳定不同的磁相，结合涨落可形成非常规有序相，为理解涨落驱动的序-by-无序现象提供了途径。此外，固有的结构无序会进一步改变这种竞争，导致多数样品演变为玻璃态动力学，这不仅可能模仿自旋液体行为，也使得在实验中难以识别真正的自旋液体候选材料。
AI.motivation: 理解几何阻挫晶格中相互作用竞争与结构无序如何共同影响磁相的形成，特别是区分玻璃态动力学与真实自旋液体的困难。
AI.method: 通过分析几何阻挫二维晶格中的相互作用竞争、涨落效应以及固有结构无序对磁有序的影响，揭示从有序相到玻璃态演化的物理机制。
AI.result: 相互作用竞争在涨落辅助下可导致非常规有序相（序-by-无序现象）；结构无序使大多数样品趋向玻璃态动力学，这类动力学可能模仿自旋液体行为。
AI.conclusion: 结构无序导致的玻璃态行为会对实验上识别真实自旋液体候选材料构成严重干扰，需谨慎区分这两种现象。

title: Probing spin order via magnon transmission across quantum Hall ferromagnet heterojunctions
summary: Two-dimensional material platforms now host a remarkable array of exotic correlated phases, from unconventional superconductivity to fractional Chern insulators. Probing magnetic order in these systems is essential for understanding their underlying physics, yet dilute spin densities render conventional magnetic probes ineffective. Spin waves, or magnons, in quantum Hall ferromagnets (QHFM) have proven effective for probing the magnetic order in various symmetry-broken quantum Hall (QH) phases in graphene systems, but previous works have been limited to homojunction configurations within a single material. Here, we demonstrate magnon transmission across a monolayer-bilayer graphene quantum Hall ferromagnet heterojunction - the first magnon transmission across quantum Hall ferromagnet heterojunctions, using one material as a magnon source to probe magnetic order in a distinct material. Generating magnons in monolayer graphene (MLG) at $ν$ = 1, we detect their transmission through bilayer graphene (BLG) via nonlocal voltage measurements, revealing spin order in BLG symmetry-broken quantum Hall states. The transmission exhibits hallmark magnon signatures: a sharp onset at the Zeeman energy and systematic variation with Landau level filling, including suppression at $ν$ = 4 and 8 where spin polarization vanishes. Our findings establish heterojunction magnon transmission as a powerful, modular probe of magnetic order, opening new avenues for investigating exotic quantum states across the rapidly expanding family of two-dimensional materials.

AI.tldr: 本文首次实现了跨单层-双层石墨烯量子霍尔铁磁异质结的自旋波（磁振子）传输，利用单层石墨烯作为磁振子源来探测双层石墨烯中的磁有序，填补了以往只能在同一材料内进行同质结探测的空白。
AI.motivation: 二维材料平台涌现出各种奇异关联相（如非常规超导、分数量子霍尔绝缘体），探测其中的磁序对理解其底层物理至关重要，但稀薄的自旋密度使传统磁性探针失效。此前磁振子探测仅限于单一材料内的同质结结构，无法在不同材料间进行磁序探测。
AI.method: 在单层石墨烯的ν=1态产生磁振子，通过非局域电压测量检测磁振子穿过双层石墨烯的传输，以此揭示双层石墨烯对称性破缺量子霍尔态中的自旋有序。通过观察磁振子在Zeeman能量处的尖锐起始信号以及随朗道能级填充因子的系统变化（包括在自旋极化消失的ν=4和8处被抑制）来表征传输特性。
AI.result: 成功观测到磁振子跨异质结传输的典型特征信号：在Zeeman能量处出现尖锐起始，并随朗道能级填充因子系统变化，在ν=4和8处（自旋极化消失处）传输被抑制，证明双层石墨烯中存在自旋有序。
AI.conclusion: 异质结磁振子传输作为一种强大且模块化的磁序探测工具被建立，为在快速扩展的二维材料家族中研究奇异量子态开辟了新途径。

title: Interplay of Excitonic Charge Density Wave and Superconductivity in Transition Metal Dichalcogenides
summary: Motivated by the unique characteristics of the phase diagram of 1T-TiSe2, we investigated the complex interplay of excitonic charge density wave (CDW) and superconductivity (SC) on a two-dimensional triangular lattice, each site accommodating two orbitals. In response to various tuning parameters, such as intercalation, pressure, substitution, and gating, these materials exhibit a generic and gradual waning of CDW, followed by the emergence of SC. Intriguingly, the nature of CDW changes from commensurate to incommensurate with the appearance of SC. Setting up a minimal model based on observed excitonic CDW and electron and hole pockets in the Fermi surface, and analyzing it within a simple mean-field framework, we can comprehend some salient experimental features. We also found that the qualitative phase diagram remains insensitive to details of the band structure. These results offer crucial insights into the nature of the interplay between CDW and SC in transition-metal dichalcogenides.

AI.tldr: 本文基于1T-TiSe2相图的独特特征，在二维三角晶格上（每个格点含两个轨道）研究了激子电荷密度波（CDW）与超导（SC）之间的复杂相互作用。通过建立基于观测到的激子CDW及费米面上电子和空穴口袋的最小模型，并在简单平均场框架下分析，解释了插层、压力、取代和门控等调谐参数下CDW逐渐减弱、SC出现的实验特征，以及CDW从公度到非公度的转变。
AI.motivation: 揭示过渡金属二硫化物中电荷密度波与超导之间相互作用的本质，特别关注1T-TiSe2这类材料中CDW逐渐减弱并伴随SC出现的独特相图特征。
AI.method: 在二维三角晶格上建立每个位点含两个轨道的最小模型，基于实验观测的激子CDW和费米面上的电子/空穴口袋，采用平均场理论框架进行分析，并检验结果对能带结构细节的敏感性。
AI.result: 该模型能够解释若干关键的实验特征，包括CDW在SC出现时从公度转变为非公度的现象；同时发现定性相图对能带结构的细节不敏感。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果为理解过渡金属二硫化物中CDW与SC相互作用的本质提供了关键见解，表明该最小模型能捕捉实验中的主要特征，且具有鲁棒性。

title: Time-delayed feedback turns Arrhenius escape logarithmic
summary: Thermal escape is governed by the Arrhenius law, where the mean escape time scales exponentially with the barrier height. We show that the non-Markovianity induced by time-delayed feedback in the confining force removes this exponential scaling. Beyond a threshold set by the curvature of the minimum, the delay destabilizes the well, and the thermal noise seeds an instability that is subsequently amplified deterministically to the boundary leading to \textit{slingshot} escape trajectories. The escape time becomes logarithmic in the barrier, its fluctuations follow a Gumbel law, and an optimal delay enables escape faster than free diffusion. Our results propose time delay as a tunable and experimentally feasible control parameter for accelerating activated processes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究表明，由时间延迟反馈导致的非马尔可夫性可消除热逃逸的Arrhenius指数标度。超过由势阱曲率设定的阈值后，延迟使势阱失稳，热噪声触发的不稳定性被确定性放大形成"弹弓"式逃逸轨迹，逃逸时间变为势垒的对数函数，其涨落服从Gumbel分布，且存在最优延迟使逃逸快于自由扩散。
AI.motivation: 传统热逃逸遵循Arrhenius定律，逃逸时间随势垒高度呈指数增长，这限制了激活过程的效率。作者探索通过时间延迟反馈这一非马尔可夫机制来打破这种指数标度，从而加速激活过程。
AI.method: 研究时间延迟反馈对束缚力（约束势）中粒子热逃逸的影响。当延迟超出由势阱曲率决定的阈值时，势阱失稳；热噪声作为种子触发不稳定性，随后被确定性机制放大直至粒子到达边界，形成"弹弓"式逃逸轨迹。
AI.result: (1) 逃逸时间从指数标度变为势垒的对数函数；(2) 逃逸时间的涨落服从Gumbel极值分布；(3) 存在最优延迟使得逃逸比自由扩散更快；(4) 时间延迟可作为可调的控制参数来加速激活过程。
AI.conclusion: 时间延迟为加速激活过程提供了一种可调且实验上可行的控制参数，打破了传统Arrhenius指数逃逸定律的限制，具有潜在的实际应用价值。

title: Chemically Resolved Topological Coordinates Link Structural Dynamics and Configurational Thermodynamics
comment: Corresponding authors: Ayush Kumar Pandey and Abhishek Tewari
summary: Atomic coordinates specify a structure, but they do not reveal how chemical connectivity across several length scales relates to atomic motion and configurational energy ordering. We formulate chemically directed persistent homology at four resolutions---complete networks, individual sites, spatial fields, and substitutional arrangements---while retaining the chemical identity and length scale of each connectivity feature. In \textit{ab initio} molecular dynamics (AIMD) trajectories of $δ$- and $γ$-CsPbI$_3$ at five temperatures spanning 500--700 K, the corner-sharing $γ$ network has a lower Pb--I restoring stiffness and permits larger iodide excursions, yet iodide positional correlations decay 2.27 times more slowly and Pb-network topology retains memory 1.63 times longer than in the edge-sharing $δ$ phase. Local softness and loss of network memory are therefore distinct. At individual sites, rare $γ$-phase Pb environments with a $δ$-like Cs-cage connectivity precede 0.17 $\mathring{\mathrm{A}}$ greater Pb displacement over the subsequent 0.5 ps. The same Pb-network coordinate resolves disruption of corner-sharing connectivity across a 2560-atom $δ|γ$ boundary. In substituted CsPbI$_3$, compact dopant arrangements undergo greater cooperative host relaxation and lie lower in density-functional-theory (DFT) energy than dispersed arrangements of the same composition. SchNet and Allegro model families with comparable energy errors encode opposite ordering along this coordinate, and 61 of 247 supplied models with errors below 1 meV atom$^{-1}$ on separate test structures reverse the DFT relation. Because relative configurational energies set Boltzmann populations, chemical network topology links structure to physical response and tests whether learned energy models preserve DFT configurational ordering even when their average errors are small.

AI.tldr: 本文提出化学定向持久同调（chemically directed persistent homology）方法，在四个分辨率（完整网络、单个位点、空间场、取代排列）下分析化学连通性，并应用于CsPbI₃的AIMD轨迹和取代体系。研究发现γ相虽然局部更软、碘位移更大，但网络记忆保持时间更长；δ|γ界面连通性破坏可被检测；取代掺杂时紧凑排列能量更低。作者进一步用该坐标检验247个机器学习势模型，发现61个误差低于1 meV/atom的模型仍反转了DFT的构型能量排序。
AI.motivation: 原子坐标只描述结构，无法揭示跨多个长度尺度的化学连通性如何与原子运动及构型能量排序相关联。需要一个能同时保留化学身份和长度尺度的拓扑工具来连接结构、物理响应和能量排序。
AI.method: 提出化学定向持久同调方法，在四个分辨率下（完整网络、单个位点、空间场、取代排列）构建化学连通性描述符。应用于CsPbI₃的AIMD轨迹（δ和γ相，5个温度，500-700 K），以及δ|γ界面（2560原子）和取代掺杂体系，并用该坐标检验247个机器学习势模型。
AI.result: γ相Pb-I恢复刚度更低、碘位移更大，但碘位置相关衰减慢2.27倍、Pb网络记忆保持长1.63倍。稀有γ相Pb环境若具有δ-like Cs笼连通性，则后续Pb位移增大0.17Å。该坐标可检测δ|γ界面连通性破坏。紧凑掺杂排列的宿主弛豫更大且DFT能量更低。61/247个低误差模型反转DFT能量排序。
AI.conclusion: 化学网络拓扑将结构连接到物理响应，并可作为检验机器学习势是否保持DFT构型能量排序的标准——即使平均误差很小，模型也可能反转相对能量的Boltzmann权重排序。

title: Experimental observation of decoupled spin subsystems in decorated square kagomé lattice magnets of the nabokoite family
summary: The square kagomé lattice (SKL) offers a model platform for investigating geometric frustration in 2D systems. Nabokoite-family compounds \nabok{A}{X} (A=Na, K, Cs, Rb and X=Cl, Br) extend this physics to a 3D network, where 2D SKL layers are decorated by interlayer spins. Using electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR), we demonstrate a dramatic splitting of this complex exchange network into two virtually decoupled spin subsystems: absolute calibration of the electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR) absorption reveals that only a fraction of all copper spins in nabokoites is EPR-active and this fraction of the spins orders at the Néel point. Comparison of the EPR absorption and static susceptibility indicates that contribution of the EPR-silent spin subsystem to total magnetic susceptibility decreases on cooling. This direct observation of coexisting magnetic order and possible spin-liquid dynamics within a single compound challenges conventional models of unified exchange networks in decorated frustrated lattices.

AI.tldr: 通过电子顺磁共振(EPR)技术，该研究揭示了Nabokoite家族化合物中复杂交换网络分裂为两个几乎解耦的自旋子系统：只有部分铜自旋具有EPR活性并在Néel点发生磁有序，而另一部分EPR沉默的自旋子系统可能表现出自旋液体动力学。这一发现挑战了装饰性阻挫晶格中统一交换网络的传统模型。
AI.motivation: 方形Kagomé晶格(SKL)是研究二维几何阻挫的理想平台，而Nabokoite家族化合物将其扩展至三维网络，其中二维SKL层由层间自旋修饰。该研究旨在理解这种扩展结构中的磁性行为，特别是交换网络如何被分离为不同子系统。
AI.method: 采用电子顺磁共振(EPR)技术，通过对EPR吸收进行绝对校准，定量分析了Nabokoite化合物中的自旋响应；同时将EPR吸收与静态磁化率进行比较，以区分不同自旋子系统的贡献。
AI.result: 研究发现仅有一小部分铜自旋具有EPR活性，且这部分自旋在Néel点发生有序化。EPR沉默的自旋子系统对总磁化率的贡献随温度降低而减小，表明两个子系统几乎完全解耦。在同一化合物中同时观察到磁有序和可能的自旋液体动力学共存。
AI.conclusion: 该研究首次直接观察到在一个化合物中磁有序与自旋液体动态共存的现象，表明装饰性阻挫晶格中的交换网络可以分裂为独立的自旋子系统，这对传统的统一交换网络模型提出了挑战，为理解复杂几何阻挫系统提供了新的视角。

title: Directional commensurability stabilizes structural superlubricity in patterned mesoscale interfaces
summary: Structural superlubricity, arising from lattice incommensurability, offers a promising route to eliminate friction and associated energy losses in mechanical systems. In real-world systems, roughness and wear currently pose severe limitations on its robustness and especially the contact size. Here, we consider patterned surfaces as a possible route to overcome some of these limitations. We show that the simplest choice of patterning, contacts made up of two incommensurate triangular-triangular patterns, fails at elevated loads because of the small number of load-bearing contacts, causing the maximum local contact pressure to exceed the strength of the superlubric coating. We introduce a square-triangular patterned interface that increases the number of load-bearing contacts and organizes them into continuous contact lines. When sliding along specific directions relative to these lines, superlubricity is maintained at significantly higher loads by reducing pressure-induced coating failure while also remaining somewhat tolerant to surface imperfections. These findings establish a mechanism for stabilizing structural superlubricity against coating failure and a design principle for engineering low-friction interfaces with enhanced load-bearing capacity and defect tolerance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了图案化表面如何提升结构超润滑的鲁棒性和承载能力。发现三角形-三角形图案接触在高压下因承载点过少而导致涂层失效，而新提出的方形-三角形图案界面能增加承载点并形成连续接触线，在特定滑动方向上显著提高承载极限并保持超润滑性，同时容忍表面缺陷。
AI.motivation: 结构超润滑虽能消除摩擦和能量损失，但真实系统中的粗糙度和磨损严重限制了其鲁棒性和接触尺寸，高压下尤其容易失效，需要寻找提升承载能力和缺陷容忍度的方案。
AI.method: 提出方形-三角形图案化接触界面，与简单的三角形-三角形图案进行对比，通过增加承载点数量并将它们组织成连续接触线的方式，分散局部接触压力。
AI.result: 三角形-三角形图案在高压下因承载点过少使局部接触压力超过涂层强度而失效；方形-三角形图案在特定滑动方向下能维持超润滑，显著承受更高载荷，减少压力诱导的涂层失效，并对表面缺陷具有一定容忍性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究建立了通过图案设计稳定结构超润滑、抵御涂层失效的机制，为工程设计高承载、抗缺陷的低摩擦界面提供了设计原则。

title: Quantitative Disentanglement of Terahertz Spin and Orbital Pumping in 3d Ferromagnetic Heterostructures
summary: Spin and orbital pumping - the injection of spin and orbital angular momentum from a driven ferromagnet into an adjacent nonmagnetic layer - are fundamental processes underlying angular-momentum generation and transport in magnetic heterostructures. Femtosecond optical excitation extends these phenomena into the ultrafast regime, where spintronic terahertz emission spectroscopy (STES) detects picosecond angular-momentum currents in a contact-free manner through spin-to-charge and orbital-to-charge conversion. Microscopic theory predicts that orbital-pumping efficiency increases from Fe to Ni across the 3d series, yet whether these predictions hold under ultrafast excitation remains unclear. A central challenge is that spin and orbital currents are generated simultaneously and contribute additively to the same terahertz emission, preventing their quantitative separation. Here, we overcome this limitation by combining STES with wedge-sample thickness control in heterostructures whose nonmagnetic layers (Ta, W, and Nb) have spin Hall and orbital Hall angles of opposite signs. The two angular-momentum channels therefore exhibit distinct emission polarities and thickness dependences, enabling their quantitative decomposition. Systematic measurements on Fe, Co, and Ni heterostructures reveal that the orbital-pumping contribution increases progressively toward Ni, reaching several tens of percent of the spin-current contribution - far exceeding theoretical predictions. Even Fe generates a non-negligible orbital current that becomes essential in the thin-nonmagnetic-layer regime. The extracted orbital diffusion lengths are consistently shorter than spin diffusion lengths and increase with decreasing spin-orbit coupling strength of the nonmagnetic layer. These results establish a quantitative framework for ultrafast spin and orbital pumping in magnetic heterostructures.

AI.tldr: 本文通过结合自旋太赫兹发射光谱（STES）与楔形样品厚度控制，利用具有相反符号自旋霍尔角和轨道霍尔角的非磁性层（Ta、W、Nb），成功实现了超快激发下旋转矩注入和轨道矩注入的定量分离。系统测量Fe、Co、Ni异质结发现，轨道泵浦贡献随Ni方向递增，可达自旋电流贡献的几十个百分点，远超理论预测，并提取了相应的轨道扩散长度。
AI.motivation: 超快激发下自旋和轨道电流同时产生并加性地贡献于同一太赫兹发射信号，导致二者无法定量分离，且微观理论预测的轨道泵浦效率随3d系列从Fe到Ni增加的是否成立尚不明确。
AI.method: 将STES与楔形样品厚度控制相结合，选用具有自旋霍尔角和轨道霍尔角符号相反的非磁性层（Ta、W、Nb），使两个角动量通道呈现不同的发射极性和厚度依赖性，从而实现定量分解，并对Fe、Co、Ni异质结进行系统性测量。
AI.result: 轨道泵浦贡献从Fe到Ni逐步增加，Fe/Co/Ni中轨道电流可达自旋电流贡献的几十个百分点，远超理论预测；即使Fe也产生不可忽略的轨道电流，在薄非磁性层区域尤为重要。轨道扩散长度始终短于自旋扩散长度，且随非磁性层自旋轨道耦合强度减弱而增加。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了超快自旋与轨道泵浦的定量分析框架，揭示了实验观测的轨道泵浦效率远超理论预期，为磁性异质结中角动量产生与输运的超快动力学研究提供了新的方法论基础。

title: Ballistic-to-Localized Dynamics as Signature of Quantum Phase Transition in Josephson Junction
summary: Using state-of-the-art numerical techniques, we investigate how quantum phase fluctuations and quasiparticle tunneling shape the behavior of a small-capacitance Josephson junction across Ohmic, sub-Ohmic, and super-Ohmic dissipation regimes. We show that increasing the Ohmic dissipation strength drives a Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless quantum phase transition at thermodynamic equilibrium. Deviations from Ohmic behavior profoundly alter this scenario: the super-Ohmic regime exhibits no phase transition, whereas the sub-Ohmic regime displays a continuous second-order transition, consistent with the universality classes of the spin-boson model. Within the Ohmic regime, real-frequency linear-response calculations reveal that the phase particle does not undergo the commonly assumed diffusive-to-localized crossover. Instead, finite resistance progressively suppresses the singular zero-frequency response, producing a ballistic-to-localized change in the dynamics. At finite frequencies, coupling to the environment generates a long-lived excitation in the charge response, which evolves into a resonance as the subgap and shunt resistances are reduced.

AI.tldr: 本文利用最先进的数值技术，研究了小电容约瑟夫森结在欧姆、次欧姆和超欧姆耗散区间的量子相位涨落与准粒子隧穿行为。研究发现欧姆耗散增强可驱动BKT量子相变，超欧姆区无相变，次欧姆区呈连续二阶相变。欧姆区中相位粒子表现为弹道-局域化转变而非扩散-局域化交叉，有限频率下环境耦合产生长寿命激发并演化为共振。
AI.motivation: 现有研究通常假设欧姆耗散下约瑟夫森结存在扩散-局域化交叉，但这一图像可能并不准确。作者希望通过精确数值方法，系统揭示不同耗散机制（欧姆、次欧姆、超欧姆）对量子相位涨落和准粒子隧穿的影响，从而修正对约瑟夫森结量子相变和动力学行为的理解。
AI.method: 采用最先进的数值技术（如实频线性响应计算），对热力学平衡态下的约瑟夫森结进行求解，分别考察欧姆、次欧姆和超欧姆三种耗散区间的量子相位涨落与准粒子隧穿行为，并通过实频响应函数分析相位粒子的动力学特征。
AI.result: 1) 欧姆耗散增强驱动BKT量子相变；2) 超欧姆区无相变，次欧姆区为连续二阶相变，符合自旋-玻色子模型的普适类；3) 欧姆区中相位粒子呈现弹道-局域化转变而非常见的扩散-局域化交叉，有限电阻抑制零频奇异响应；4) 有限频率下环境耦合产生长寿命激发，随次能隙和分流电阻降低演化为共振。
AI.conclusion: 该研究修正了此前对约瑟夫森结耗散动力学的认知，揭示了不同耗散机制下截然不同的量子相变与动力学行为，为理解约瑟夫森结在量子器件中的实际表现提供了更精确的理论框架，并证实其与自旋-玻色子模型普适类的一致性。

title: Effective Hardcore Exclusion Without Exclusion: Two-Species Pair Annihilation Revisited
summary: Reaction-diffusion systems with two species that mutually annihilate through $A+B\to\emptyset$ reactions display a slow decay of the total density $ρ$ which follows an anomalous power law in low dimensions. For hardcore particles in one dimension, this decay follows $ρ\sim t^{-1/4}$ under symmetric diffusion and $ρ\sim t^{-1/3}$ under asymmetric diffusion without relative bias between the two species. The $t^{-1/3}$ behavior, in particular, has so far been observed exclusively in systems with hardcore exclusion. Here we construct a model of particles without hardcore exclusion that reproduces this same $t^{-1/3}$ scaling. In our model, both species undergo asymmetric diffusion with a rate that depends nonlinearly on the local density, a form of transport that, in the absence of the other species, is superdiffusive and falls into the Kardar-Parisi-Zhang universality class. The scaling behavior of $t^{-1/3}$ occurs when at least one of the two species undergoes asymmetric diffusion induced by microscopic processes involving pairs of particles, while asymmetric processes involving groups of three particles lead to $t^{-1/4}$ scaling associated with symmetric diffusion. This demonstrates that the pair annihilation density decay exponent is not determined exclusively by the transport properties of the isolated particle species.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了两种互相湮灭（A+B→∅）的反应-扩散系统中粒子密度衰减的异常幂律行为。作者构建了一种不含硬核排斥的粒子模型，通过非线性密度依赖的不对称扩散过程，复现了一维系统中此前仅见于硬核排斥体系的t^{-1/3}密度衰减标度。
AI.motivation: 此前研究发现，一维硬核粒子体系中，对称扩散导致密度按t^{-1/4}衰减，而非对称扩散（两物种无相对偏差）导致t^{-1/3}衰减。但t^{-1/3}行为仅在硬核排斥体系中观察到，作者希望探究是否能在无硬核排斥的体系中实现同样的标度行为，从而揭示密度衰减指数与孤立物种输运性质之间的深层关系。
AI.method: 作者构造了一个无硬核排斥的粒子模型，其中两种物种均经历不对称扩散，且扩散速率非线性依赖于局域密度。这种输运形式在无其他物种存在时表现为超扩散，属于Kardar-Parisi-Zhang（KPZ）普适类。作者分析了涉及双粒子或三粒子微观过程的不对称扩散对密度衰减标度指数的影响。
AI.result: 研究发现：当至少一种物种经历由双粒子微观过程诱导的不对称扩散时，系统呈现t^{-1/3}的密度衰减标度，与硬核排斥体系的非对称扩散行为一致；而由三粒子过程诱导的不对称扩散则导致t^{-1/4}的标度，与对称扩散行为相同。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明了对湮灭反应中密度衰减指数并非仅由孤立物种的输运性质决定。无硬核排斥的体系也能复现t^{-1/3}行为，说明微观相互作用的细节（如参与对称破缺过程的粒子数）对标度行为有重要影响，这深化了对反应-扩散系统中异常幂律普适性的理解。

title: Collinear and noncollinear antiferromagnetic ordering in a highly frustrated decorated square kagomé lattice antiferromagnets of the nabokoite family
summary: Nabokoite family compounds ACu$_7$(TeO$_4$)(SO4)$_5$X (A=Na, K, Rb, Cs; X=Cl, Br) host frustrated 2D square kagom'{e} lattice layers decorated by additional inter-layer magnetic ions. We study magnetic order in nabokoites with multi-frequency electron spin resonance spectroscopy and thermodynamic measurement (specific heat, magnetization and dielectric permittivity). Our study reveals that the choice of the low-temperature ground state is qualitatively different in light-alkali-ion (K, Na) and heavy-alkali-ion (Rb, Cs) compounds. Heavy-alkali-ion nabokoites order in conventional collinear antiferromagnetic pattern with easy-axis anisotropy. The parameters of the ordered antiferromagnetic state are very close for all heavy-alkali-ion subfamily. Light-alkali-ion members of nabokoite family demonstrate much more complicated route to the ordered state: firstly, a ferroelectric transition at 25-90K lifts the frustration and thus pre-cooks the low-temperature ordering; secondly, an unusual noncollinear magnetic order develops via two-step phase transition with first transition temperature $T_{c1}\simeq 5-6$K and the second transition at $T_{c2}\simeq 3-4$K. Noncollinear order is evidenced by observation of characteristic non-Larmor antiferromagnetic resonance mode. Spin dynamics of light-alkali-ion nabokoites is characterized by three zero-field magnon gaps and two spin-reorientation fields, the values of magnon gaps and critical fields are quite different for different compounds. The finite-size cluster modeling of pyramidal structural block of nabokoite structure combined suggests that the critical closeness of the nabokoite exchange coupling parameters to the border-line between the different quantum ground state of pyramidal building block of nabokoite structure could be the clue to the choice of qualitatively different ordered state in light- and heavy-alkali-ion nabokoites.

AI.tldr: 本文通过多频电子自旋共振谱学和热力学测量（比热、磁化率、介电常数）研究了Nabokoite家族化合物ACu₇(TeO₄)(SO₄)₅X中的磁有序行为。研究发现轻碱金属离子（K, Na）与重碱金属离子（Rb, Cs）化合物在低温基态选择上存在本质差异：重碱金属化合物呈现传统共线反铁磁有序，而轻碱金属化合物经历铁电相变和两步相变后形成非共线磁有序。有限尺寸团簇建模表明交换耦合参数接近量子基态边界可能是这一差异的关键。
AI.motivation: Nabokoite家族化合物具有受挫的二维正方形kagomé晶格层，并伴有层间磁性离子，是研究几何受挫磁性和量子自旋行为的理想平台。理解不同碱金属离子替换对该体系低温磁有序的影响，对于揭示量子涨落与磁有序竞争的本质具有重要意义。
AI.method: 采用多频电子自旋共振光谱学和热力学测量（比热、磁化率、介电常数）系统研究不同碱金属离子（Na, K, Rb, Cs）的Nabokoite化合物。结合有限尺寸团簇建模分析金字塔形结构单元的交换耦合参数。
AI.result: 重碱金属离子（Rb, Cs）化合物呈现常规共线反铁磁有序，具有易轴各向异性，且其有序态参数在子家族内非常接近。轻碱金属离子（K, Na）化合物则经历更复杂的路径：首先在25-90K发生铁电相变解除受挫，然后通过两步相变（T_c1≈5-6K, T_c2≈3-4K）形成非共线磁有序，并观察到特征非Larmor反铁磁共振模式。轻碱金属化合物表现出三个零场磁振子能隙和两个自旋重取向场。
AI.conclusion: Nabokoite家族中轻、重碱金属离子化合物在低温磁有序上的本质差异，源于其交换耦合参数临界接近金字塔形结构单元不同量子基态之间的边界线，这为理解几何受挫磁体中量子效应与磁有序的竞争提供了重要线索。

title: Single-pulse strain-induced precessional dynamics of magnetization in Co-doped iron garnet
summary: Ultrafast control of magnetization through lattice excitation provides a route to manipulating magnetic order on short timescales, yet the role of transient strain in driving magnetization dynamics remains poorly understood. Here, single-shot pump-probe magneto-optical microscopy is used to resolve the structural and magnetic responses of cobalt-doped yttrium iron garnet to individual 5-ps mid-infrared pulses. The excitation generates a localized strain field together with an outward-propagating elastic wave. Concurrently, the magnetic contrast decreases following excitation and subsequently reverses on a timescale of approximately 1.5-2 ns before recovering to its initial state. The structural and magnetic responses exhibit closely correlated wavelength and pulse-energy dependences, indicating a common excitation pathway. Micromagnetic simulations incorporating transient strain reproduce the precessional reorientation of the magnetization within individual domains while largely preserving the labyrinthine domain morphology. These results identify transient lattice deformation as the link between single-pulse mid-infrared excitation and reversible precessional magnetization dynamics in Co-doped yttrium iron garnet.

AI.tldr: 本文通过单次泵浦-探测磁光显微镜研究钴掺杂钇铁石榴石在飞秒/皮秒中红外脉冲激发下的磁化动力学，发现瞬态应变驱动的磁化进动重取向，磁对比度在约1.5-2 ns内反转并恢复，微磁模拟证实瞬态晶格形变是连接光激发与可逆磁化动力学机制的关键。
AI.motivation: 理解通过晶格激发实现超快磁化控制中瞬态应变的角色，此前该机制在驱动磁化动力学中的作用尚未被充分理解。
AI.method: 采用单次泵浦-探测磁光显微镜，结合微磁模拟，解析钴掺杂钇铁石榴石对单个5皮秒中红外脉冲的结构与磁性响应，通过比较波长与脉冲能量的相关性确立共同激发路径。
AI.result: 激发产生了局域应变场和外向传播弹性波；磁对比度先下降后在约1.5-2 ns内反转并恢复；结构与磁性响应具有强相关波长和脉冲能量依赖；微磁模拟再现了单个磁畴内的进动重取向并保持迷宫状磁畴形貌。
AI.conclusion: 瞬态晶格形变是单脉冲中红外激发与钴掺杂钇铁石榴石中可逆进动磁化动力学之间的关键桥梁。

title: Heavy-Hole--Light-Hole Mixing and Spin--Photon Coupling in Germanium Flopping-Mode Qubits
summary: Intrinsic spin--orbit interaction in germanium provides electrically active flopping-mode qubits without requiring magnetic-field gradients to generate spin--charge hybridization. We study double quantum dots (DQDs) with a multiband Luttinger--Kohn framework that retains heavy-hole (HH) and light-hole (LH) states on equal footing. Modeling vertical confinement with a finite confinement potential along the growth direction brings selected subbands into a regime of appreciable HH--LH mixing. This admixture activates electric-dipole spin-coupling through LH--LH and LH--HH transitions, complementing the conventional HH--HH pseudospin-flip resonance. For the parameter sets considered, these additional channels can produce larger spin--photon figures of merit than the HH--HH transition. HH--LH mixing thus supplies a tunable ingredient for qubit--cavity coupling in germanium hole-spin qubits and extends the operating regimes available to circuit-QED architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了锗双量子点中基于本征自旋-轨道相互作用的flopping-mode量子比特，采用多能带Luttinger-Kohn框架同时处理重空穴（HH）和轻空穴（LH）态。研究表明有限垂直约束势能引起显著的HH-LH混合，激活了通过LH-LH和LH-HH跃迁的电偶极自旋耦合，补充了传统的HH-HH赝自旋翻转共振，且这些额外通道在某些参数下能产生比HH-HH跃迁更大的自旋-光子品质因数。
AI.motivation: 锗空穴自旋量子比特的现有研究通常只考虑重空穴通道，忽略了轻空穴的贡献。作者希望证明HH-LH混合可以作为一种可调谐的机制，扩展锗空穴自旋量子比特的qubit-cavity耦合工作范围，从而提升电路QED架构的性能。
AI.method: 采用多能带Luttinger-Kohn框架对双量子点（DQD）进行建模，将HH和LH态置于同等地位。沿生长方向用有限约束势描述垂直约束，使选定的子带进入显著的HH-LH混合区域，从而激活额外的电偶极自旋耦合通道（LH-LH和LH-HH跃迁）。
AI.result: 对于所考察的参数集，HH-LH混合激活的额外耦合通道（LH-LH和LH-HH跃迁）能够产生比传统HH-HH跃迁更大的自旋-光子品质因数，表明这些通道在qubit-cavity耦合中具有优势。
AI.conclusion: HH-LH混合为锗空穴自旋量子比特的qubit-cavity耦合提供了可调谐的额外机制，扩展了电路QED架构的可用工作范围，对实现无需磁场梯度即可进行自旋-电荷耦合的电活性flopping-mode量子比特具有重要意义。

title: Superheating Field of Extreme Type-II Superconductors Calculated from the Eliashberg Theory
summary: We calculate the superheating field $H_s$ of a type-II superconductor with a large Ginzburg-Landau parameter from the isotropic Eliashberg theory. It is shown that the temperature dependencies of $H_s(T)$ can be obtained from a thermodynamic approach for different scattering parameters $p=\hbar/2πτ_Nk_BT_c$ in a wide range of the nonmagnetic impurity scattering times $τ_N$ ranging from the clean $(p\ll 1)$ to the dirty $(p\gg 1)$ limits. Specific calculations were done for Nb and Nb$_3$Sn using their electron-phonon spectral functions extracted from tunneling measurements. We show that the ratio $H_s(T,p)/H_c(T)$ calculated from the Eliashberg theory exceeds that of the weak coupling BCS model, where $H_c$ is the thermodynamic magnetic field. We also show that, even though nonmagnetic impurities are pairbreakers in the current-carrying state, $H_s(0,p)$ for Nb$_3$Sn at $T=0$ has a maximum at $p\approx 0.2$ at which the ratio $H_s/H_c$ is about $6\%$ higher than that in the BCS clean limit.

AI.tldr: 本文利用各向同性Eliashberg理论计算了具有大Ginzburg-Landau参数的第二类超导体的过热场Hs，研究了不同非磁性杂质散射参数p(从清洁极限到脏极限)下Hs(T)的温度依赖关系，并以Nb和Nb₃Sn为例进行了具体计算。
AI.motivation: 超导体的过热场Hs是决定超导性能极限的重要物理量，理解其温度依赖性和杂质效应对实际超导材料的应用(如超导腔、超导磁体)具有重要意义，特别是需要超越弱耦合BCS模型进行更精确的理论预测。
AI.method: 采用各向同性Eliashberg理论结合热力学方法，通过电子-声子谱函数(从隧穿测量提取)计算不同散射参数p(范围从清洁到脏极限)下超导体的过热场Hs(T)，并计算Hs/Hc比值与弱耦合BCS模型进行比较。
AI.result: Eliashberg理论计算的Hs(T,p)/Hc(T)比值超过弱耦合BCS模型的预测；尽管非磁性杂质在载流状态下是破坏配对的因素，Nb₃Sn在T=0时的Hs(0,p)在p≈0.2处出现最大值，此时Hs/Hc比值比BCS清洁极限高出约6%。
AI.conclusion: Eliashberg理论能更准确地描述超导体过热场的温度依赖性和杂质散射效应，非磁性杂质在特定浓度下可增强过热场，这对优化实际超导材料的性能具有指导意义。

title: Kinetic temperatures and inertial effects in a nonequilibrium bead-spring model
summary: We investigate a nonequilibrium steady-state model consisting of two coupled beads with arbitrary masses in contact with two thermal baths at different temperatures. Using a covariance-matrix approach together with numerical simulations of the underdamped Langevin dynamics, we characterize steady-state probability distributions, heat transport, and entropy production. We show that irreversibility measures such as entropy production and heat current are invariant under an exchange of the bead masses, whereas energy-storage observables depend explicitly on the mass arrangement in a symmetrical set up. This reveals a fundamental distinction: energy observables exhibit path dependence in singular mass limits, while transport and irreversibility remain well defined. We show that kinetic temperatures provide the natural variables governing the thermodynamics of the system: their difference controls transport and entropy production, while their sum determines the mean energy via a model specific generalized equipartition relation. In the infinite-mass limit, only constitutive relations expressed in terms of kinetic temperatures remain meaningful. Thus, energy, transport, and irreversibility are unified through kinetic temperatures as the organizing variables. We also derive an effective temperature that defines an equilibrium-like canonical distribution. Finally, we analyze the notion of ergodicity and show that the time-averaged observables converge significantly faster than the ensemble averages.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一个由两个任意质量耦合珠子组成的非平衡稳态模型，该模型与两个不同温度的热浴接触。通过协方差矩阵方法和欠阻尼朗之万动力学数值模拟，作者表征了稳态概率分布、热输运和熵产生。关键发现是：不可逆性度量（熵产生和热流）在珠子质量交换下保持不变，而能量存储可观测量则明确依赖于质量排列方式。文章证明动能温度是支配系统热力学的自然变量，并统一了能量、输运和不可逆性的描述。
AI.motivation: 理解非平衡稳态系统中质量排列对热力学可观测量的影响，特别是区分哪些量（如熵产生、热流）是质量不变的，哪些量（如能量存储）依赖于质量排列，并寻找统一描述这些量的自然变量。
AI.method: 采用协方差矩阵方法结合欠阻尼朗之万动力学的数值模拟，研究两个任意质量耦合珠子与两个不同温度热浴接触的模型。系统分析了稳态概率分布、热输运、熵产生，并推导出有效温度和广义能量均分关系。
AI.result: 1) 熵产生和热流在珠子质量交换下不变，而能量储能依赖质量排列；2) 动能温度是自然热力学变量——其差值控制输运和熵产生，其和通过广义能量均分决定平均能量；3) 在无限质量极限下，仅以动能温度表达的构成关系仍有意义；4) 推导出定义类平衡正则分布的有效温度；5) 时间平均可观测量比系综平均收敛显著更快。
AI.conclusion: 论文通过动能温度统一了能量、输运和不可逆性的描述，揭示了能量可观测量在奇异质量极限下具有路径依赖性，而输运和不可逆性保持良好定义。该工作为理解非平衡稳态系统提供了新的组织性变量框架。

title: Magnetic Field-Tunable Repulsive Exciton-Exciton Interaction in the van der Waals Antiferromagnet NiPS$_3$
summary: Two ultra-narrow absorption peaks around 1.5 eV, which are widely believed to originate from a transition from a spin-orbital entangled triplet to a singlet state, in the two-dimensional van der Waals crystal NiPS$_3$, have attracted considerable attention because of their pronounced spin-dependent character. An interesting question is whether ultrahigh magnetic fields modify an interaction-driven hybridization between those two peaks. In this work we perform systematic magneto-optical measurements of NiPS$_3$ in pulsed magnetic fields of up to 178 T and observe a pronounced mutual repulsion between the two sharp exciton peaks accompanied by a redistribution of oscillator strength, while the band edge shows no detectable field-induced shift within our experimental resolution. We construct a minimal two-level interaction model and compare it semi-quantitatively with the experimental data. Our results reveal a magnetic-field-tunable exciton-exciton coupling as the dominant high-field response of NiPS$_3$, and clarify this material as a new experimental platform for exploring strongly correlated exciton physics in magnetic van der Waals insulators.

AI.tldr: 本文通过高达178 T的脉冲磁场下对二维范德华晶体NiPS₃进行系统磁光测量，观察到两个超窄激子峰之间显著的相互排斥及振子强度重新分布，并构建最小二能级相互作用模型进行半定量比较，揭示了磁场可调的激子-激子耦合是NiPS₃的主要高场响应，将其确立为研究磁性范德华绝缘体中强关联激子物理的新平台。
AI.motivation: NiPS₃中约1.5 eV处两个超窄吸收峰被认为源于自旋轨道纠缠三重态到单重态的跃迁，具有显著的spin-dependent特征。作者希望探究超高磁场是否会改变这两个峰之间由相互作用驱动的杂化。
AI.method: 在高达178 T的脉冲磁场下对NiPS₃进行系统磁光测量，观测两个激子峰的行为，并构建最小二能级相互作用模型与实验数据进行半定量比较。
AI.result: 观察到两个尖锐激子峰之间显著的相互排斥及振子强度重新分布，而带边在实验分辨率内没有可检测的场致位移。
AI.conclusion: 磁场可调的激子-激子耦合是NiPS₃的主要高场响应，该材料可作为探索磁性范德华绝缘体中强关联激子物理的新实验平台。

title: Evaluating LLM-based AI agents integrated with materials synthesis tools: the case of atomic layer deposition
comment: Invited prospective paper submitted to MRS Communications
summary: This work provides an overview of the different strategies that can be used to evaluate the performance of AI models and agents based on large language models (LLMs) for materials synthesis. After providing a brief overview of the key technologies behind the current generation of AI agents based on LLMs, we summarize the different approaches to evaluating these models in the context of materials science and in particular on materials synthesis, with a specific emphasis on scenarios in which the models are directly integrated with experimental tools. We discuss evaluation strategies spanning knowledge and reasoning benchmarks, tool-use benchmarks, and closed loop benchmarks involving the interaction with experimental systems or realistic virtual tools. We use atomic layer deposition (ALD) as a case study, emphasizing how existing approaches in the literature both build from general approaches used beyond materials science and can be generalized to other materials synthesis techniques. Finally, we provide a practical evaluation framework to evaluate LLMs in the context of materials synthesis

AI.tldr: 本文综述了基于大语言模型（LLM）的AI模型和智能体在材料合成领域中的性能评估策略，涵盖知识推理基准、工具使用基准以及闭环实验基准，并以原子层沉积（ALD）为案例，提出了一个实际的评估框架。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM驱动的AI智能体越来越多地被集成到材料合成实验中，如何系统性地评估这些模型的性能成为一个关键但尚未充分解决的问题。作者旨在填补这一空白，为材料科学社区提供全面的评估策略概述。
AI.method: 作者首先概述了基于LLM的AI智能体的关键技术，然后系统总结了三种主要的评估策略：（1）知识和推理基准；（2）工具使用基准；（3）涉及实验系统或虚拟工具的闭环基准。以原子层沉积（ALD）作为案例研究，展示了这些方法在具体材料合成技术中的应用，并提出一个实用的评估框架。
AI.result: 本文提供了一套系统化的评估策略分类，并通过ALD案例展示了如何将通用评估方法应用于特定的材料合成技术，最终提出了一个可直接用于评估LLM在材料合成场景中表现的实用框架。
AI.conclusion: 该综述建立了LLM智能体在材料合成领域的评估方法论体系，其提出的评估框架不仅适用于ALD，还可以推广到其他材料合成技术，为未来该领域的研究提供了系统性的评估指南。

title: Extreme Polarization of the Optical Gap and High-Energy Exciton Landscape in CrSBr
summary: We reveal a strongly anisotropic excitonic landscape in monolayer and bulk-like CrSBr using optical absorption spectroscopy and $GW$-Bethe-Salpeter equation $\textit{ab initio}$ calculations. The direct absorptive determination of the lowest bright optical onsets i.e. $X_0^a$ and $X_0^b$ excitons for the two in-plane polarization eigenaxes yield an in-plane optical gap anisotropy of $470 \pm 15$ meV. This is the highest observed value for any material in the near-infrared-to-visible spectral region to the best of our knowledge. Energetically above, we identify multiple strongly polarized excitons spanning $1.25$ eV to $3.1$ eV selectively aligned along the two orthogonal axes. A resonance $X^-$, located $24$ meV below the $X_0^b$ progressively transfers oscillator strength to $X_b^0$, a behavior consistent with a coupled trion (Fermi-polarion)/exciton pair. Our experiments also provide polarization-resolved broadband dielectric functions of CrSBr. These results establish CrSBr as a strongly polarization-selective excitonic system and highlight its potential for polarization-selective optoelectronics enabled with its large optical-gap anisotropy.

AI.tldr: 本文通过光学吸收光谱和GW-BSE第一性原理计算，揭示了单层及块体CrSBr中强各向异性的激子景观。发现两个最低亮激子（X₀ᵃ和X₀ᵇ）沿两个面内偏振本征轴的光学带隙各向异性高达470±15 meV，这是近红外到可见光区域已知材料的最高值。此外还识别了多个高度偏振的激子，并观察到与Fermi-polaron/激子对耦合行为一致的trion共振X⁻。
AI.motivation: 探索二维材料中的各向异性激子行为，寻找具有强偏振选择性和大光学带隙各向异性的材料，以推动偏振选择性光电子器件的发展。
AI.method: 采用偏振分辨的光学吸收光谱实验测量，结合GW-BSE（GW近似+贝特-萨尔皮特方程）第一性原理计算，对单层和块体CrSBr的激子光谱进行系统分析。
AI.result: 实验直接测定两个面内偏振方向的激子起始（X₀ᵃ和X₀ᵇ），得到470±15 meV的面内光学带隙各向异性，为近红外-可见光区域已知最高值；在1.25-3.1 eV范围内识别出多个强偏振激子；观测到位于X₀ᵇ下方24 meV的X⁻共振，其振子强度向X₀ᵇ转移，符合trion/激子耦合行为。
AI.conclusion: CrSBr被确立为强偏振选择性激子系统，其巨大的光学带隙各向异性突显了在偏振选择性光电子学中的巨大应用潜力，同时提供了偏振分辨的宽带介电函数数据。

title: Chemical Perspectives on Cuprate Superconductivity: Hole-Protected Spin Dimers as d Wave Cooper Pairs
summary: The observation that the coherence lengths in cuprate superconductors are extremely small motivated us to search for its real-space structure by examining the consequence of hole-doping in CuO4 units in cuprates. We analyzed aggregates of hole-doped CuO4 units that phase-separate from hole-doped CuO2 layers in terms of their segregation-pressure indices defined in this work. Our search suggests that each d-wave Cooper pair is an antiferromagnetically coupled spin dimer protected in an antiferromagnetic hole dimer (AHD), and that the antiferromagnetic chains of AHDs provide channels through which such spin dimers can move collectively without perturbation. Based on these suggestions and their implications, we examined the causes for several seemingly puzzling observations on cuprate superconductors to find that they are naturally explained by the suggestions.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析铜氧化物超导体中CuO4单元的掺杂空穴行为，提出每个d波库珀对是一个被反铁磁空穴二聚体（AHD）保护的反铁磁耦合自旋二聚体，AHD的反铁磁链为自旋二聚体的集体无扰动运动提供了通道，并据此解释了铜氧化物超导体中的多个令人困惑的实验现象。
AI.motivation: 铜氧化物超导体中相干长度极短，促使作者在实空间中探索其超导结构的起源，寻找能自然解释诸多看似矛盾实验现象的微观机制。
AI.method: 通过分析CuO4单元中空穴掺杂的后果，研究空穴掺杂CuO4单元从空穴掺杂CuO2层中相分离的聚集体，并定义了"偏析压力指数"（segregation-pressure indices）来量化分析。
AI.result: 提出d波库珀对是受AHD保护的反铁磁自旋二聚体，AHD反铁磁链提供集体运动通道，并能自然地解释多个关于铜氧化物超导体的令人困惑的实验观察。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的AHD模型能够自然解释铜氧化物超导体中的多个看似矛盾的现象，表明这种实空间结构可能是理解其超导机制的关键。

title: Inertia-Driven Information Flow and Symmetry Breaking in a Nonequilibrium Two-Bead System
summary: We investigate information-flow generation in a nonequilibrium two-bead system coupled to two heat baths. We show that the system acts as an information-flow generator in both overdamped and underdamped regimes, with the underdamped dynamics revealing a divergence of the scaled information flow along specific paths in the thermal asymmetry--inertia parameter space that is hidden in the overdamped limit. This information generation suggests a possible route toward information engines and demon-like mechanisms in nanomachines. A symmetry-perturbation analysis of the response landscape of information flow reveals a geometric structure reminiscent of a Ginzburg--Landau framework: the symmetric reference state can correspond to a minimum or maximum depending on the perturbation direction, while the flat overdamped landscape develops a finite curvature under inertia. Mass asymmetry shifts the resulting maxima, and Hessian eigenvalue and eigenvector analysis reveals level touching of principal modes and bimodality along a constant-diffusion path. These results establish a minimal framework for understanding how inertia and microscopic heterogeneity shape information landscapes in nonequilibrium systems, with potential extensions to more complex heterogeneous networks.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一个由两个珠子构成、耦合到两个热浴的非平衡系统中的信息流生成问题。系统在过阻尼和欠阻尼两种情况下均可作为信息流发生器，且欠阻尼动力学揭示了沿特定路径信息流发散的现象。通过对称性微扰分析，发现信息流响应景观具有类似Ginzburg-Landau的几何结构，质量不对称会移动最大值，Hessian特征值/特征向量分析揭示了主模态的能级接触和双峰性。
AI.motivation: 探索非平衡纳米机械系统中信息流生成的机制，并理解惯性效应和微观异质性（如质量不对称）如何影响信息景观，为信息引擎和类幺（demon-like）机制在纳米机器中的实现提供理论基础。
AI.method: 采用两珠子-两热浴非平衡系统模型，分别在过阻尼和欠阻尼动力学框架下研究信息流；运用对称性微扰分析信息流响应景观；使用Hessian特征值和特征向量分析来刻画景观的几何结构（包括能级接触和双峰性）。
AI.result: 系统在过阻尼和欠阻尼两种动力学下都充当信息流发生器；欠阻尼下沿热不对称-惯性参数空间特定路径出现尺度化信息流发散（过阻尼极限下隐藏）；对称参考态根据扰动方向可对应最小值或最大值；惯性使平坦的过阻尼景观产生有限曲率；质量不对称移动最大值位置；沿恒定扩散路径出现主模态能级接触和双峰性。
AI.conclusion: 建立了一个理解惯性和微观异质性如何塑造非平衡系统信息景观的最小框架，为更复杂异质网络的研究提供了扩展方向，并指出了实现信息引擎和类幺机制的可能途径。

title: Emergent Pair Density Wave and Incoherent Metallic State in a Strongly Correlated Doped System
summary: We investigate the dynamical emergence of a state driven by the interplay between antiferromagnetism (AFM) and singlet $d$-wave superconductivity (SC) within a slave-rotor mean-field framework. By decomposing the electron into charge and spin degrees of freedom, the formalism captures strong-correlation effects beyond conventional mean-field approaches. A PDW order is found to emerge dynamically in the coexistence region of AFM and SC. The AFM-SC coexistence region is significantly modified with correlation, leading to a systematic shift of the tetra-critical point. The doping and temperature evolution of the AFM, SC, and PDW order parameters, together with the rotor condensate amplitude $φ$, which characterizes charge coherence, shows a crossover from a coherent to an incoherent metal with the suppression of coherent quasi-particle spectral weight. Moreover, in the AFM + $(φ\neq 0)$ region, coherent quasi-particle bands coexist with incoherent Hubbard-like excitations, whereas only incoherent spectral features survive in the AFM + $(φ= 0)$ regime. The SC phase exhibits nodal quasi-particles consistent with $d$-wave pairing.

AI.tldr: 本文在slave-rotor平均场框架下研究反铁磁（AFM）与d波超导（SC）之间的相互作用，发现AFM与SC共存区域中会动态涌现出PDW序。研究发现强关联效应显著改变了AFM-SC共存区域，并导致四临界点系统性移动。通过分析掺杂和温度演化，揭示了从相干金属到非相干金属的交叉行为，以及在AFM+φ≠0区域中相干准粒子带与非相干Hubbard激发的共存。
AI.motivation: 理解强关联体系中反铁磁与d波超导之间复杂的相互竞争与共存关系，特别是PDW态的动力学涌现机制，以及关联效应对相图结构的影响。
AI.method: 采用slave-rotor平均场方法，将电子分解为电荷自由度和自旋自由度，通过转子凝聚振幅φ描述电荷相干性，在mean-field层次上捕捉超越传统方法的强关联效应。
AI.result: (1) 在AFM与SC共存区域动态涌现PDW序；(2) 关联效应显著改变AFM-SC共存区域并使四临界点系统性移动；(3) 随着掺杂和温度变化，系统从相干金属过渡到非相干金属，相干准粒子谱权重被抑制；(4) AFM+φ≠0区域表现出相干准粒子带与非相干Hubbard激发共存，而AFM+φ=0区域仅剩非相干谱特征；(5) SC相呈现与d波配对一致的节点准粒子。
AI.conclusion: slave-rotor框架有效揭示了强关联效应对AFM-SC相互作用和PDW涌现的关键影响，为理解铜氧化物高温超导体中电荷-自旋分离、量子临界行为及其与PDW态的关系提供了重要理论见解。

title: Analogue Phase Change Computational Memory with High Precision Reads and Energy Efficient Writes
summary: Resistive memory technologies offer a compelling advantage for in-memory computing. However, realizing a device architecture that simultaneously achieves high computational precision, efficiency, and density has remained elusive due to inherent trade-offs among these performance metrics. Here, we introduce a com- pact phase-change memory device architecture that combines an ultra-confined active switching volume for enhanced electro-thermal efficiency with a non-insulating thin film that suppresses temporal conductance fluctuations. We analytically model and back-end integrate these devices into crossbar arrays. Even with conventional, undoped phase-change materials, the device architecture enables a computational precision approaching 6 bits, low conductance values below 50 μS with an adequate conductance window, and a viable pathway toward sub-100 μA programming currents under nominal operating voltages.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种紧凑型相变存储器（PCM）器件架构，通过超受限有源开关体积提升电热效率，并结合非绝缘薄膜抑制时间电导波动，在交叉阵列中实现了接近6位的计算精度、低于50 μS的低电导值以及亚100 μA的编程电流。
AI.motivation: 电阻式存储器在内存计算中具有显著优势，但现有器件架构难以同时实现高计算精度、高效率和高密度，这三者之间存在固有的性能权衡，亟需一种能够打破该折中关系的器件设计方案。
AI.method: 设计了一种紧凑型相变存储器架构，其核心包括：(1)超受限的有源开关体积以增强电热效率；(2)非绝缘薄膜用于抑制时间电导波动。研究者对该架构进行了解析建模，并通过后端集成工艺将其制备成交叉阵列。
AI.result: 即使使用传统的未掺杂相变材料，该器件架构也能实现接近6位的计算精度、低于50 μS的低电导值且具备足够的电导窗口，并在标称工作电压下提供了亚100 μA编程电流的可行路径。
AI.conclusion: 该器件架构通过创新的物理设计同时突破了精度、效率和密度三方面的权衡限制，为高精度、高能效的内存计算提供了可行的器件级解决方案。

title: Twist-Tunable Paramagnetic Superconductivity in $d$-wave Altermagnet/Superconductor Heterostructures
summary: The interplay between twist-angle engineering and unconventional magnetism provides a powerful new route to control quantum phenomena. We theoretically investigate a heterostructure comprising a $d$-wave superconductor proximitized by a two-dimensional $d$-wave altermagnet. We reveal that the momentum-space mismatch between the superconducting gap nodes and the altermagnetic spin-splitting nodes generates a robust, twist-tunable odd-frequency spin-triplet pairing. Consequently, the macroscopic electromagnetic response of the system can be tuned from a conventional diamagnetic Meissner state to an anomalous paramagnetic Meissner effect driven entirely by the interfacial twist angle. For a $d_{x^2-y^2}$ altermagnet, the paramagnetic response is maximized at perfect alignment ($φ=0$) and completely suppressed at a maximal twist of $φ=π/4$, while a $d_{xy}$ altermagnet exhibits the exact complementary behavior. Our results establish twisted altermagnetic heterostructures as a versatile platform for engineering odd-frequency pairing and macroscopic superconducting phases.

AI.tldr: 本文理论研究了d波超导体与二维d波交变磁体（altermagnet）构成的异质结，揭示了动量空间中超导能隙节点与交变磁自旋劈裂节点之间的失配会产生稳健的、可随扭转角调控的奇频自旋三重态配对，从而将宏观电磁响应从传统的抗磁Meissner态调控为反常顺磁Meissner效应。
AI.motivation: 扭转角工程与非常规磁性的结合为控制量子现象提供了新途径，作者希望探索d波超导体与d波交变磁体异质结中，扭转角如何调控奇频配对和宏观超导响应。
AI.method: 理论计算。构建d波超导体与二维d波交变磁体的异质结模型，分析超导能隙节点与交变磁自旋劈裂节点在动量空间中的失配，研究奇频自旋三重态配对的产生机制，并计算随扭转角变化的宏观电磁响应。
AI.result: 发现扭转角可调的稳健奇频自旋三重态配对；系统电磁响应可从抗磁Meissner态调至反常顺磁Meissner效应；对于d_{x^2-y^2}交变磁体，顺磁响应在对齐（φ=0）时最大、在φ=π/4时完全抑制；而d_{xy}交变磁体表现出完全互补的行为。
AI.conclusion: 扭转交变磁异质结可作为工程化奇频配对和宏观超导相的通用平台，为调控量子现象提供了新途径。

title: On the relaxation problem in statistical mechanics
summary: We reformulate the relaxation problem in statistical mechanics by making explicit what are the \emph{operational} objects subject to relaxation: the local time statistics of the recorded signal $Z(t)$. These local time statistics are simply the estimated histograms of observations $\{Z(t_i)\}_{i=1}^M$ performed at uniformly random times $\{t_i\}_{i=1}^M$ by a clockless observer. The subject of prediction is a belief about a future fresh out-of-sample reading of a measurement outcome whose distribution is inferred from the mathematical model believed to be true. For finite bounded systems of $N\ge 1$ degrees of freedom global irreversible relaxation of predictions can occur but special initial conditions exist. The form of the predictions depends on certain loss functions whose choice is up to the particular observer. Finally, entropy is given a learning interpretation as mutual information between the observer and the unknown past of the system under consideration and, in complete generality, its stationary value depends on the information available.

AI.tldr: 本文重新阐述了统计力学中的弛豫问题，将弛豫的对象明确为记录信号Z(t)的局部时间统计量（即无时钟观测者在随机时刻采样的直方图估计）。预测的对象是对未来样本读数概率分布的信念。对于有限有界N自由度系统，全局不可逆弛豫可以发生但存在特殊初始条件，预测的形式取决于观测者选择的损失函数，熵被赋予学习解释（观测者与系统未知过去之间的互信息），其稳态值依赖于可用信息量。
AI.motivation: 传统的统计力学弛豫理论没有明确区分"操作层面"上真正被弛豫的物理对象，导致对不可逆弛豫的来源和条件缺乏清晰的理解。作者试图以观测者（observer）的视角重新表述弛豫问题，使熵和信息等概念获得明确的语义基础。
AI.method: 将弛豫对象重新形式化为记录信号Z(t)的局部时间统计量，即无时钟观测者在均匀随机时刻进行的M次测量构建的直方图估计。通过引入损失函数（由观测者自行选择）来刻画预测形式，并将熵重新解释为观测者与系统未知过去之间的互信息。
AI.result: 证明即使对于有限有界N>=1自由度的系统，全局不可逆弛豫的预测仍可发生，但需排除某些特殊初始条件。熵的稳态值在完全一般的情况下依赖于观测者可用的信息量，而不仅仅由系统本身决定。
AI.conclusion: 统计力学中的弛豫本质上是一个关于观测者预测更新的问题，其不可逆性来自信息处理的限制（如时间随机采样、损失函数选择），熵具有互信息的学习语义。这为理解统计力学中不可逆性的根源提供了新的视角。

title: Thermal Hall Signatures of Distinct Schwinger-Boson Flux Sectors on the Honeycomb Lattice
comment: main text: 14 pages, 9 figures; supplemental information: 6 pages, 3 figures
summary: Thermal transport offers a bulk probe of charge-neutral excitations in frustrated magnets. It remains challenging, however, to determine whether such transport can distinguish different parton mean-field structures of the same spin system. This question is particularly relevant on the honeycomb lattice, where distinct $0$-flux, $π$-flux, and chiral $π/2$-flux sectors have been proposed. In this paper, we compare self-consistent saddle-point solutions in these three sectors for a frustrated $J_1-J_2$ Heisenberg model with a next-nearest-neighbor Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction and a perpendicular magnetic field. Using finite-temperature Schwinger-boson mean-field theory and the Kubo formula for bosonic Bogoliubov-de Gennes systems, we evaluate the intrinsic spinon thermal Hall conductivity. At a common parameter point where all three branches remain gapped, the $0$-flux response is positive and the $π$-flux response is negative for $D>0$ and $h>0$ under the sign conventions used in this paper, whereas the $π/2$-flux response changes sign with increasing temperature.
