We further show that a projective symmetry combining a sixfold rotation with time reversal forces the zero-field response of a fixed chiral $π/2$-flux domain to vanish. Within the mean-field regime examined in this paper, the sign and temperature dependence of $κ_{xy}/T$ therefore provide a flux-sensitive transport signature.

AI.tldr: 本文通过有限温度Schwinger-boson平均场理论和Kubo公式，系统比较了蜂巢晶格上受挫J1-J2海森堡模型中0-flux、π-flux和手性π/2-flux三个部分子平均场扇区的本征自旋子热霍尔电导，发现其符号和温度依赖可作为区分磁通扇区的输运特征。
AI.motivation: 热输运是探测受挫磁体中电荷中性激发的体探针，但对于同一自旋系统，不同部分子平均场结构（0-flux、π-flux、手性π/2-flux）是否能被热输运所区分仍是悬而未决的问题，尤其是在蜂巢晶格上这一区分尤为重要。
AI.method: 采用含最近邻和次近邻Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用及垂直磁场的受挫J1-J2海森堡模型，在三个磁通扇区中求解自洽鞍点解，使用有限温度Schwinger-boson平均场理论结合玻色Bogoliubov-de Gennes系统的Kubo公式，计算本征自旋子热霍尔电导。
AI.result: 在三个分支均保持能隙的共同参数点，0-flux响应为正而π-flux响应为负（约定D>0、h>0时），π/2-flux响应则随温度升高发生符号转变。此外，六重旋转与时间反演结合的投影对称性迫使固定手性π/2-flux畴的零场响应消失。
AI.conclusion: 在研究的平均场范围内，κ_xy/T的符号及温度依赖性提供了对磁通敏感的输运特征，可用于区分不同部分子平均场结构。

title: Strain-Driven Electronic and Catalytic Modulation of g-C3N4/GeS van der Waals heterostructure for Photocatalytic Water Splitting
summary: Photocatalytic water splitting offers a viable pathway for sustainable hydrogen production. In this study, first-principles density functional theory calculations were performed to explore the strain-dependent photocatalytic behaviour of a two-dimensional g-C3N4/GeS heterostructure. The heterostructure shows type-II band alignment with an indirect band gap of 2.17 eV, smaller than those of the individual g-C3N4 (2.81 eV) and GeS (3.31 eV) monolayers. Biaxial tensile strain up to 3% effectively modulates the band gap and band edge positions, allowing suitable alignment with water redox potentials. The calculated Gibbs free energy for the hydrogen evolution reaction (ΔGHER) is 0.2 eV for the pristine heterostructure and approaches near-thermoneutral values (-/+ 0.1 eV) under +1% and +2% strain. Meanwhile, the OER overpotential decreases from 2.17 V to 0.97 V with increasing strain. AIMD simulations and optical absorption in the visible region confirm the thermodynamic stability and promising photocatalytic potential of the heterostructure for hydrogen generation.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过第一性原理密度泛函理论计算，探讨了二维g-C3N4/GeS异质结在应变条件下的光催化水分解性能。该异质结呈II型能带排列，带隙为2.17 eV，双轴拉伸应变（最高3%）可有效调控带隙和能带边缘位置，使其与水的氧化还原电位相匹配。应变还能优化氢析出反应的吉布斯自由能（接近热中性）并显著降低析氧过电位（从2.17 V降至0.97 V）。AIMD模拟和可见光吸收证实了其热力学稳定性和光催化产氢潜力。
AI.motivation: 光催化水分解是可持续产氢的重要途径，但高效、稳定的光催化剂仍亟待开发。二维异质结构因其可调控的电子结构和丰富的活性位点而备受关注，然而如何通过应变工程优化其光催化性能，特别是实现合适的能带对齐和高效的析氢/析氧反应，仍是亟待解决的关键问题。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，对g-C3N4/GeS异质结进行系统的电子结构分析，包括能带结构、能带排列类型和带隙计算；施加最高3%的双轴拉伸应变，考察应变对带隙和能带边缘位置的影响；计算氢析出反应（HER）的吉布斯自由能变化（ΔGHER）和析氧反应（OER）的过电位；通过从头算分子动力学（AIMD）模拟验证热力学稳定性，并分析光学吸收特性。
AI.result: g-C3N4/GeS异质结呈现II型能带排列，带隙为2.17 eV（小于单层g-C3N4的2.81 eV和单层GeS的3.31 eV）；在+1%和+2%应变下，HER的ΔGHER接近热中性值（±0.1 eV）；OER过电位随应变增加从2.17 V降至0.97 V；AIMD模拟和可见光区吸收证实了其结构稳定性和优异的光催化潜力。
AI.conclusion: g-C3N4/GeS异质结通过应变工程能有效优化其光催化水分解性能，有望成为一种有前景的产氢光催化剂。应变调控策略为二维异质结光催化剂的设计提供了重要的理论指导。

title: Localized orbitals and tunnel couplings from general confinement potentials in gate-defined quantum-dot arrays
summary: Efficient simulation of dense gate-defined multi-quantum-dot arrays requires accurate and scalable modeling methods, compatible with asymmetries and imperfections of realistic voltage-controlled confinement potentials. We present a numerical localization procedure that rotates the eigenbasis of a general one-particle effective orbital Hamiltonian into $s$-, $p$-, $d$-, $\ldots$-shells of localized orbital wavefunctions associated with individual quantum dots. The pairwise tunnel couplings between such states are computed directly as matrix elements of the Hamiltonian. We demonstrate this procedure on a 2D triangular Si-MOS triple-quantum-dot array by obtaining the voltage dependencies of the tunnel couplings and their distributions in the presence of disorder. We discuss the implications of this evaluation method on the many-body calculations, and relate it to the experimental tunnel coupling measurements.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种数值局域化方法，将一般单粒子有效轨道哈密顿量的本征基旋转为与单个量子点相关的局域轨道波函数的s、p、d壳层，并直接通过哈密顿量矩阵元计算成对隧穿耦合。该方法在二维三角Si-MOS三量子点阵列上得到验证，可获得隧穿耦合的电压依赖性和无序分布。
AI.motivation: 密集门控定义的多量子点阵列的高效模拟需要准确且可扩展的建模方法，必须兼容现实电压控制限制势中的不对称性和缺陷。现有方法在建模这些真实系统时面临挑战。
AI.method: 提出一种数值局域化程序，将一般单粒子有效轨道哈密顿量的本征基旋转到与单个量子点相关的局域轨道波函数的s、p、d等壳层中；成对隧穿耦合直接作为哈密顿量的矩阵元计算。
AI.result: 在2D三角Si-MOS三量子点阵列上进行了演示，获得了隧穿耦合的电压依赖性及其在无序存在下的分布。
AI.conclusion: 讨论了该评估方法对多体计算的影响，并将其与实验隧穿耦合测量联系起来。

title: Superconductivity of Tellurium Polyhydride with Tc above 90K
summary: We report experimental diacovery of superconductivity (SC) in tellurium (Te) polyhydride. The compound was synthesized at high pressure and high temperature conditions using a diamond anvil cell combined with a laser heating system. Subsequent in situ transport measurements at high pressures, performed as a function of temperature and applied magnetic field, revealed a superconducting transition with a critical temperature Tc about 91 K at 263 GPa. The superconducting phase is assigned to TeH4 with characterized face shared TeH12 cage forming quasi molecular H2 units based on synchrotron x-ray diffraction experiments. Analysis of the SC behavior at magnetic fields yielded a Ginzburg Landau (GL) coherence length of approximately 47 angstroms. Tellurium polyhydride thus becomes another chalcogen polyhydride superconductor in addition to the landmark discovery of the first polyhydride high Tc SC SH3.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了碲（Te）多氢化物中超导电性的实验发现。研究团队利用金刚石对顶砧结合激光加热系统，在高压高温条件下合成了TeH4化合物，通过原位输运测量观察到约91 K的超导转变温度（在263 GPa压力下），并基于同步辐射X射线衍射确定了其晶体结构。
AI.motivation: 继首个多氢化物高温超导体SH3的里程碑式发现后，探索其他硫族元素多氢化物是否同样具有高温超导电性，以拓展高温超导材料家族并深化对富氢化合物超导机制的理解。
AI.method: 使用金刚石对顶砧与激光加热系统在高压高温条件下合成碲多氢化物；通过原位输运测量（变温、变磁场）表征超导转变；利用同步辐射X射线衍射确定晶体结构；通过磁场下的超导行为分析提取Ginzburg-Landau相干长度。
AI.result: 成功合成了TeH4化合物，在263 GPa压力下测得超导转变温度Tc约为91 K；该超导相具有面共享的TeH12笼状结构，内含类分子H2单元；GL相干长度约为47埃。TeH4成为继SH3之后第二个被实验确认的硫族元素多氢化物高温超导体。
AI.conclusion: 碲多氢化物TeH4被实验证实为高压下的高温超导体（Tc ~ 91 K），进一步验证了硫族多氢化物作为高温超导材料家族的重要地位，为富氢化合物高温超导研究提供了新的实验证据和材料平台。

title: Compensation in continuous symmetric trilayered planar ferrimagnet
summary:
The trilayered (A-B-A type) anisotropic (single site) XY magnetic model is considered with the intra-plane ferromagnetic and
  the inter-plane antiferromagnetic interactions. The equilibrium properties of such trilayered anisotropic XY system has been studied by
  Monte Carlo simulation with Metropolis single spin (randomly chosen) update algorithm. In a given range of interaction parameters, the system has been found to exhibit the high temperature {\it critical} (vanishing sublattice magnetisations and total magnetisation) and low temperature {\it compensation} (vanishing total magnetisation even for non-vanishing sublattice magnetisations) behaviours. The compensation temperature and the critical temperature both are found to increase with the increase of single site anisotropy. The comprehensive phase diagram is drawn. The finite size study reveals the growth of correlations near the critical temperature.

AI.tldr: 本文通过蒙特卡罗模拟（Metropolis单自旋更新算法）研究了三层（A-B-A型）单各向异性XY磁性模型，该模型具有层内铁磁和层间反铁磁相互作用。在特定相互作用参数范围内，系统表现出高温临界行为（亚晶格磁化强度和总磁化强度消失）和低温补偿行为（总磁化强度消失但亚晶格磁化强度非零）。研究发现单点各向异性的增加会同时提高补偿温度和临界温度，并绘制了完整的相图，有限尺寸研究揭示了临界温度附近的关联增长。
AI.motivation: 研究多层磁性系统中层内铁磁与层间反铁磁相互作用竞争所导致的临界行为和补偿行为，特别是各向异性对系统磁性质的影响。
AI.method: 采用蒙特卡罗模拟方法，使用Metropolis单自旋（随机选择）更新算法，对三层（A-B-A型）单各向异性XY磁性模型进行平衡性质研究。
AI.result: 系统在特定参数范围内表现出高温临界行为和低温补偿行为；补偿温度和临界温度均随单点各向异性的增加而升高；获得了全面的相图；有限尺寸研究表明临界温度附近关联增长。
AI.conclusion: 三层各向异性XY模型存在补偿行为与临界行为的共存，各向异性强度是调控两种特征温度的重要参数，该模型可为多层磁性材料的设计提供理论参考。

title: Symmetry-Enforced Topological Structures in Quantum Phase Diagrams
summary: We study the topological structure of the quantum phase diagram of gapped systems by identifying the noncontractibility of loops, so-called $S^1$-families, within the gapped phase diagram in which many-body Hamiltonians can have nontrivial ground-state degeneracy. We manifest the role of symmetries in such $S^1$-family classifications by the exotic symmetry interplay: (i) nontrivial mixed anomalies, (ii) semi-direct product relation between the spontaneously broken and the unbroken symmetries, and (iii) symmetry with noninvertible operators. We find that such structures lead to the novel $S^1$-family classifications inaccessible by earlier classifications based on ``independent'' symmetries. Furthermore, we construct lattice realizations of these $S^1$-families and explicitly demonstrate their novel algebraic structures.

AI.tldr: 本文研究有能隙系统的量子相图的拓扑结构，通过识别相图中不可收缩的环（$S^1$-族）来分类，特别关注非平凡对称性相互作用（混合反常、半直积关系、非可逆对称算子）如何导致传统分类方法无法发现的新的$S^1$-族分类，并构造了格点模型实现。
AI.motivation: 以往对$S^1$-族（相图中有能隙区域中的非平凡环）的分类基于"独立"对称性假设，未能涵盖对称性之间存在复杂相互作用的情形。作者旨在揭示这些特殊对称性结构如何产生全新的$S^1$-族分类。
AI.method: 作者分析三类特殊对称性结构对$S^1$-族分类的影响：(i)非平凡混合反常；(ii)自发破缺对称性与未破缺对称性之间的半直积关系；(iii)具有非可逆算子的对称性。并构造具体的格点哈密顿量模型来显式实现这些$S^1$-族并展示其代数结构。
AI.result: 发现上述三类对称性结构能够产生传统分类（基于独立对称性）无法得到的新的$S^1$-族分类，并通过格点模型显式验证了这些新的拓扑结构及代数性质。
AI.conclusion: 对称性之间的复杂相互作用（而非独立对称性）是产生新$S^1$-族分类的关键，这拓展了对量子相图拓扑结构的理解，为量子相的拓扑分类提供了新的视角。

title: Josephson-Phase Reversal of Non-Bloch Andreev Propagation
summary: Non-Hermitian control is difficult in solid-state systems due to fixed dissipation. Here, we show that in a spin-orbit-coupled planar Josephson junction, changing only the Josephson phase reverses the non-Bloch propagation of a low-energy Andreev band and switches its boundary accumulation between junction edges. The phase reshapes the band's spin and electron-hole composition, causing a fixed reservoir to unequally attenuate counterpropagating modes. Weak-loss theory links this phase-controlled loss imbalance to boundary-selected complex momenta, offering an in situ route to reconfigurable non-Hermitian transport in superconducting platforms.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出在自旋轨道耦合平面约瑟夫森结中，仅通过改变约瑟夫森相位即可逆转低能安德烈耶夫能带的非布洛赫传播，并切换其在结边缘的边界累积位置。通过相位重塑能带的自旋和电子-空穴组成，使固定耗散源对反向传播模式产生不等衰减，从而实现可重构的非厄米输运。
AI.motivation: 固态系统中的非厄米调控通常因耗散固定不变而难以实现。作者希望找到一种在固态超导平台上原位、可重构地控制非厄米输运的方法。
AI.method: 利用自旋轨道耦合平面约瑟夫森结，通过改变约瑟夫森相位来调控低能安德烈耶夫能带的非布洛赫传播。弱损耗理论将相位控制的损耗不平衡与边界选择的复动量联系起来，解释了边界累积的切换机制。
AI.result: 仅改变约瑟夫森相位即可逆转非布洛赫传播方向，并切换边界累积的位置，尽管耗散源本身是固定的。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为在超导平台上实现现场可重构的非厄米输运提供了新途径，扩展了非厄米控制的调控自由度。

title: Machine learning reveals common features of unconventional superconductors with high transition temperatures
summary: Superconductors with high critical temperatures that emerges beyond the phonon-mediated regime are usually considered unconventional in nature, yet unlike conventional superconductors, no broadly applicable predictive theory currently guides their discovery. Here, we use interpretable machine learning to uncover a common materials-space signature of high-$T_{\mathrm{c}}$ unconventional superconductors and develop a data-driven strategy for materials discovery. We construct a unified feature representation for each material by integrating compositional statistics, structural information, and latent representations from trained property-prediction models, followed by structure-aware filtering of an experimentally established superconducting dataset. Without using transition-temperature information, unsupervised analysis shows that cuprate and iron-based superconductors occupy a common region of materials space, characterized primarily by large electronegativity deviation and intermediate mean valence-electron number. A supervised $T_{\text{c}}$ model independently identifies the same descriptors as dominant features, providing complementary evidence for their relevance. Using this empirical materials-space prior together with the $T_{\text{c}}$ model, we prioritize candidate materials, recover recently discovered nickelate superconductors, and identify chemically distinct candidates for future investigation.

AI.tldr: 本文使用可解释机器学习方法，通过整合组分统计、结构信息和预训练模型的潜在表征，构建统一材料特征表示，揭示了高温非常规超导体（铜氧化物和铁基超导体）共有的材料空间特征（大电负性偏差和中等平均价电子数），并基于此提出了数据驱动的材料发现策略。
AI.motivation: 非常规超导体缺乏像常规超导体那样广泛适用的预测理论，发现新材料缺乏理论指导，需要数据驱动的策略来指导材料发现。
AI.method: 构建统一特征表示（融合组分统计、结构信息和预训练属性预测模型的潜在表征），对实验建立的超导数据集进行结构感知过滤；使用无监督分析识别高Tc非常规超导体的共同材料空间区域，并结合监督式Tc预测模型和材料空间先验来筛选候选材料。
AI.result: 无监督分析表明铜氧化物和铁基超导体占据共同的材料空间区域，主要由大电负性偏差和中间平均价电子数表征；监督式Tc模型独立识别出相同描述符；该方法能够恢复近期发现的镍基超导体，并识别出化学上不同的候选材料。
AI.conclusion: 电负性偏差和平均价电子数是高温非常规超导体的关键材料描述符，基于这些经验先验的机器学习方法可为非常规超导体的发现提供有效指导。

title: Overcoming critical slowing down in frustrated spin systems by learned multiscale sampling
summary: Cluster algorithms, such as the Swendsen--Wang and Wolff methods, are among the most successful MCMC methods for mitigating critical slowing down in statistical systems. These constructive cluster algorithms, however, fail in the presence of even extremely weak frustration. Here, we sidestep this fundamental limitation by learning rather than constructing the relevant clusters. Specifically, we use the wavelet conditional renormalization group (WCRG) sampling method to learn the probability distribution of collective fluctuations of a frustrated two-dimensional soft-spin model. Configurations are then generated recursively from coarse to fine scales by sampling conditional wavelet distributions. The WCRG method reproduces the main statistical properties of the system across different phases, including the local-field distribution and the structure factor. At an Ising-like critical point, the conditional dynamics remains decorrelated within $\mathcal{O}(1)$ sweeps at each scale, yielding an overall sampling complexity of $\mathcal{O}(\log_2 L)$, thus making WCRG much more efficient than standard local MCMC methods. These results show that learned multiscale sampling can overcome critical slowing down in frustrated systems for which conventional cluster algorithms fail. By assessing the sampling accuracy of different observables, we also clarify the main tradeoff of the WCRG method: the accuracy of the fast sampling scheme depends on the expressiveness of the energy-based model used to estimate the wavelet conditional distributions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用小波条件重正化群（WCRG）采样方法，通过"学习"而非"构造"簇来解决受阻自旋系统中传统簇算法（如Swendsen-Wang和Wolff方法）因微弱阻挫而失效的问题。该方法在二维受阻软自旋模型中成功复现了统计性质，在类Ising临界点上采样复杂度仅为O(log₂L)，远超传统局部MCMC方法。
AI.motivation: 传统的构造性簇算法（如Swendsen-Wang和Wolff方法）是缓解临界慢化最成功的MCMC方法，但即使是极微弱的阻挫也会导致这些算法失效。这构成了一个根本性的局限性，需要一种能够绕过该限制的新方法。
AI.method: 使用小波条件重正化群（WCRG）采样方法：1) 学习集体涨落的概率分布；2) 从粗尺度到细尺度递归生成构型；3) 通过采样条件小波分布来实现多尺度采样。该方法利用基于能量的模型来估计小波条件分布。
AI.result: WCRG方法成功复现了系统在不同相的主要统计性质（局部场分布和结构因子）。在类Ising临界点，条件动力学在每个尺度上仅需O(1)次扫描即可去相关，整体采样复杂度为O(log₂L)，远优于标准局部MCMC方法。
AI.conclusion: 学习式的多尺度采样能够克服传统簇算法在受阻系统中无法解决的临界慢化问题。WCRG方法的主要权衡在于：快速采样方案的精度取决于用于估计小波条件分布的基于能量模型的表达能力。

title: Holographic Representations of Topological Quantum Criticality: Emergent Symmetry Approach around the Bott Clock
summary: In this article, we apply the idea of emergent symmetries to construct holographic representations of a broad class of topological quantum critical points (tQCPs) that appear in fermionic classes in the Bott clock. We show explicitly that around the Bott clock, an emergent symmetry $U_{EM}$ exists at a tQCP between different symmetry protected gapped phases with protecting symmetry $G_p$ in $d$ spatial dimensions. This emergent symmetry can be used to construct a $(d+1)$ spatial dimensional lattice model with a properly upgraded symmetry such as $U_{EM}\times G_p$ or $U_{EM} \rtimes G_p$, etc. By doubling the degrees of freedom of the adjacent topological class in $d$-dimensions, we successfully show that the $(d+1)$-dimensional lattice models constructed in this way have the desired enlarged symmetry groups that precisely belong to the adjacent topological classes, counterclockwise around the Bott clock. Furthermore, $d$-dimensional boundaries of these $(d+1)$ dimensional lattice models of gapped topological classes are shown to exhibit identical infrared dynamics as the corresponding tQCPs in the $d$-dimensional adjacent topological phases in the Bott clock, with lower symmetries.

AI.tldr: 本文利用涌现对称性（emergent symmetries）的思想，为Bott时钟中费米子类的拓扑量子临界点（tQCPs）构建全息表示。作者证明在tQCP处存在涌现对称性U_EM，并利用该对称性构建(d+1)维晶格模型，其上边界表现出与d维tQCP相同的红外动力学。
AI.motivation: 拓扑量子临界点（tQCPs）是不同对称性保护拓扑相之间的临界点，其物理特性丰富但难以直接描述。作者希望利用涌现对称性的思想，为这些tQCPs提供一个全息（holographic）表示，从而更深入地理解其红外动力学。
AI.method: 1. 证明在d维空间中，不同对称性保护间隙相之间的tQCP处存在涌现对称性U_EM。2. 利用该涌现对称性，构建(d+1)维晶格模型，并通过升级对称性（如U_EM×G_p或U_EM⋊G_p）使模型属于相邻的拓扑类。3. 通过加倍d维相邻拓扑类的自由度来构造这些(d+1)维晶格模型。4. 证明这些(d+1)维模型的d维边界展现出与对应d维tQCP相同的红外动力学。
AI.result: 成功构建了属于Bott时钟中相邻拓扑类的(d+1)维晶格模型，且这些模型具有所需的放大对称群。同时证明了这些模型的d维边界与对应的d维tQCP具有相同的红外动力学（具有较低对称性），从而建立了tQCPs的全息对应。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为拓扑量子临界点提供了全息表示框架，通过涌现对称性构建了高维晶格模型，其边界精确重现了tQCP的红外物理，为理解拓扑临界现象提供了新的理论工具。

title: PINN-Phase: A physics-informed neural network for curvature-driven multiphase-field evolution
comment: 45 pages, 15 figures, 3 tables; Supplementary Material available as an ancillary file (35 pages, 9 figures, 13 tables)
summary: Phase-field simulation of polycrystalline microstructures becomes costly when many related cases must be evolved over long times. We introduce PINN-Phase, a physics-informed neural time integrator that advances the full multiphase field from its initial condition and enforces phase bounds and unit sum at every step; on the reported explicit multiphase-field benchmarks, post-initial-condition reference states serve only for evaluation. Without case-specific tuning, a single trained 25-grain model meets all predefined criteria in seven of eight unseen microstructures fixed before evaluation and in both stress cases, with 0.94-3.71% terminal grain-label disagreement across the ten cases. Each 12,000-step rollout takes about 5.2 min on a single GPU and reaches nearly three times the temporal horizon represented during training. A pre-registered 64-grain model reaches 6.09% disagreement, retaining all 21 reference survivors plus one additional grain; a post-evaluation continuation with a doubled training horizon and 25 additional epochs reaches 3.97% and the exact survivor set. In three dimensions, one trained 16-grain 96^3 model recovers the exact terminal active set and all three extinction identities in six of six unseen microstructures, five of which meet the complete predefined qualification. These results demonstrate structurally admissible long-horizon prediction and prospective initial-condition transfer within fixed benchmark families.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PINN-Phase，一种基于物理信息神经网络的时间积分器，用于多晶微观结构的相场模拟。该模型从初始条件推进完整多相场，并在每一步强制相位边界和单位求和约束。在显式多相场基准上，无需针对具体案例调参，单次训练的25晶粒模型在八个未见微观结构中的七个及两个应力案例中均满足所有预定标准，终端晶粒标签差异为0.94-3.71%。每个12,000步的卷展约需5.2分钟（单GPU），达到训练时间视界的三倍。预注册的64晶粒模型达到6.09%差异；继续训练后降至3.97%并恢复精确存续集。三维中，16晶粒96^3模型在六个未见微观结构中均恢复精确终端活跃集和全部三个灭绝身份。
AI.motivation: 多晶微观结构的相场模拟在许多相关案例需要长时间演化时计算成本高昂，亟需更高效的替代方法来实现长期预测和初始条件迁移。
AI.method: 提出PINN-Phase，一种物理信息神经网络时间积分器，直接推进完整多相场，在每一步强制相位有界性和单位求和约束，无需针对具体案例调参即可泛化到未见微观结构。
AI.result: 25晶粒模型在八个未见案例中的七个满足所有标准（0.94-3.71%标签差异），推断速度为每个12,000步卷展约5.2分钟；64晶粒预注册模型达6.09%差异，扩展训练后达3.97%并精确匹配存续集；三维16晶粒模型在六个案例中全部恢复精确终端活跃集。
AI.conclusion: PINN-Phase展示了结构可容许的长时程预测能力和固定基准族内的前瞻性初始条件迁移能力，为多晶相场模拟提供了高效且具泛化性的神经积分方案。

title: Spin-textured orbitals in altermagnetic artificial atoms
summary: Artificial atoms provide a versatile platform for engineering atomic-like orbitals, yet spin generally remains a passive degree of freedom in their orbital structure. Here, we introduce the concept of altermagnetic artificial atoms formed by confining electrons with momentum-dependent spin splitting. We show that altermagnetism reconstructs conventional confined orbitals into spin-textured orbitals, with spatially distinct distributions of opposite spin components. The resulting confined spectrum retains a twofold degeneracy protected by the combined $C_{4z}\mathcal{T}$ symmetry. These spin textures persist in higher-energy states, where additional radial structures combine with the characteristic angular spin pattern. Furthermore, strain resolves the degenerate orbital pairs into spin-polarized states, and continuously tunes their energy splitting. Our results establish altermagnetic artificial atoms as a route to engineering spin-dependent orbital structures in quantum-confined systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"交变磁性人造原子"的概念，通过将动量依赖的自旋劈裂电子限制在量子阱中，实现了自旋纹理轨道结构的工程化。交变磁性将传统受限轨道重构为具有空间分离自旋分量的自旋纹理轨道，并保留由C4z𝒯对称性保护的二重简并。应变可解除简并并连续调谐能量劈裂，为量子受限系统中的自旋相关轨道工程开辟了新途径。
AI.motivation: 人造原子的轨道工程已较为成熟，但自旋在其轨道结构中通常是被动的自由度，缺乏对自旋-轨道结构协同调控的手段。作者希望引入交变磁性（altermagnetism）这一新概念来主动调控自旋自由度，实现自旋纹理化的轨道态。
AI.method: 将具有动量依赖自旋劈裂（交变磁性特征）的电子限制在量子点/人造原子结构中，系统研究受限能谱的对称性、自旋纹理的空间分布以及高阶态的性质。通过对称性分析（C4z𝒯联合对称性）保护二重简并，并引入应变作为外部调控手段来解除简并并调谐能隙。
AI.result: 交变磁性将常规受限轨道重构为自旋纹理轨道，相反自旋分量在空间上分离分布；受限谱保持C4z𝒯保护的二重简并；自旋纹理在高能态中持续存在，并叠加额外的径向结构；应变可解除轨道对简并并连续调节能量劈裂。
AI.conclusion: 交变磁性人造原子为在量子受限体系中工程化自旋相关的轨道结构提供了一条可行路线，有望在自旋电子学与量子信息领域获得应用。

title: Quadratic pair-breaking absorption edge from Anderson localization in a superconducting wire
summary: We show that Anderson localization fundamentally reshapes dissipative superconducting electrodynamics, replacing the linear Mattis--Bardeen pair-breaking onset with a parametrically weaker quadratic Mott edge while leaving the quasiparticle spectrum unchanged. We derive this behavior for a weakly disordered single-channel wire with a spatially uniform $s$-wave pair potential using a Nambu-space extension of the Berezinskii diagram technique that resums elastic impurity scattering to all orders. Conservation of the Bogoliubov branch collapses the Nambu diagram hierarchy onto an exactly solvable localization problem. The localization length remains equal to its normal-state value, whereas the localization time diverges at the gap edge. The new absorption edge results from the product of the superconducting pair-creation coherence factor and the Mott-suppressed current matrix elements between localized orbitals, which generates the characteristic double logarithm. Localization also reduces the Hebel--Slichter coherence peak. The resulting theory provides an all-orders benchmark for microwave and spin-relaxation experiments on localized superconducting nanowires.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了安德森局域化如何从根本上重塑耗散超导电动力学。研究发现，局域化将线性Mattis-Bardeen对破坏起始替换为参数上更弱的二次Mott边缘，同时准粒子谱保持不变。作者通过Nambu空间的Berezinskii图技术推导了这一行为，该技术将所有阶的弹性杂质散射求和。Bogoliubov支流的守恒将Nambu图层级坍缩为可精确求解的局域化问题。局域化长度保持其正常态值，而局域化时间在能隙边缘发散。新的吸收边缘源于超导对产生相干因子与局域轨道间Mott抑制的电流矩阵元之积，产生特征性的双对数。局域化还降低了Hebel-Slichter相干峰。
AI.motivation: 作者旨在理解无序超导体中安德森局域化对耗散性质的影响，特别是修正标准Mattis-Bardeen理论的预测，为局域化超导纳米线的微波和自旋弛豫实验提供全阶基准。
AI.method: 采用Nambu空间的Berezinskii图技术，对所有阶弹性杂质散射进行求和。利用Bogoliubov支流守恒性质，将Nambu图层级约化为可精确求解的局域化问题。
AI.result: 发现吸收边缘由线性变为参数上更弱的二次Mott边缘，具有双对数特征；局域化长度保持正常态值，局域化时间在能隙边缘发散；Hebel-Slichter相干峰被抑制。
AI.conclusion: 该理论为局域化超导纳米线的实验提供了全阶基准，揭示了安德森局域化与超导耗散之间的深刻相互作用，修正了标准Mattis-Bardeen框架的预期。

title: Pseudospin Dynamics of Charge Order
summary: Charge order is conventionally viewed as a static modulation of the electronic density, despite growing experimental capabilities to probe and manipulate its nonequilibrium evolution. In contrast to spin-ordered systems, a microscopic framework for charge-order dynamics and its control under external driving remains largely underdeveloped. Here, starting from an extended Hubbard model, we derive an effective pseudospin model in which the charge-ordered state maps onto staggered pseudospin order. The resulting charge-order dynamics is governed by Landau--Lifshitz--Gilbert-like equations for the pseudospins, closely analogous to those of a bipartite antiferromagnet. We show that an external electric field directly controls the staggered pseudospin order and, above a threshold field, drives coherent reversal of the charge-order polarity by destabilizing collective pseudospin excitations. Our results establish the charge pseudospin as a microscopic dynamical degree of freedom for coherent switching and control of charge order, providing a charge-sector analogue of the well-established framework for spin-order dynamics in spintronics.

AI.tldr: 本文从扩展Hubbard模型出发，推导出电荷有序态对应的有效赝自旋模型，将电荷有序态映射为交错赝自旋序。电荷有序动力学由类似Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert方程控制，与双亚晶格反铁磁体高度类似。外部电场可直接控制交错赝自旋序，超过阈值场时可驱动电荷序极性相干翻转。
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为电荷序是电子密度的静态调制，尽管实验上已具备探测和操控其非平衡演化的能力，但与自旋有序系统相比，电荷序动力学及其外部驱动控制缺乏微观理论框架。
AI.method: 从扩展Hubbard模型出发，推导有效赝自旋模型，将电荷有序态映射为交错赝自旋序；建立Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert类方程描述电荷序动力学；分析外部电场对赝自旋序的控制及超阈值场的相干翻转机制。
AI.result: 建立了电荷赝自旋作为微观动力学自由度的框架，证明外部电场可直接控制交错赝自旋序，且超过阈值场可驱动电荷序极性相干翻转，通过使集体赝自旋激发失稳来实现。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了电荷有序相干切换和控制的电荷扇区框架，是自旋电子学中自旋序动力学成熟框架的电荷对应物，为电荷序的非平衡操控提供了微观理论基础。

title: Vibrational Origin of the Barocaloric Effect in the Spin-Crossover Complex Fe(pap-5NO2)2: A Combined DFT and Mean-Field Study
summary: Despite the barocaloric performance recently reported for the spin-crossover complex Fe(pap-5NO2)2, the microscopic origin of its pressure-induced entropy change remains poorly understood. In particular, the relative contributions of vibrational, configurational, and spin degrees of freedom to the barocaloric response have not yet been quantitatively established. Here, we develop a theoretical framework that combines density functional theory (DFT) calculations with an effective mean field Hamiltonian to investigate the barocaloric effect in this spin-crossover complex. Vibrational frequencies of the low-spin (S = 0) and high-spin (S = 2) states obtained from first-principles calculations are incorporated into a thermodynamic model that explicitly accounts for configurational, spin, and lattice entropy contributions. By establishing a correspondence between the vibrational spectra of both spin states through displacement-vector overlap analysis, we identify low and mid frequency metal-ligand vibrations as the primary microscopic origin of the vibrational entropy change. The proposed model quantitatively reproduces the experimentally reported barocaloric entropy change for a pressure variation of 2 kbar, corresponding to a maximum reversible entropy change of approximately 70 J kg-1 K-1, and predicts a spin-crossover temperature of T_1/2 = 313 K under ambient pressure, in excellent agreement with the experimental value of 308 K. Analysis of the entropy components reveals that lattice entropy associated with molecular vibrations accounts for approximately 84% of the total barocaloric response, whereas configurational and spin contributions are comparatively small.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个结合DFT计算和有效平均场哈密顿量的理论框架，定量研究了自旋交叉配合物Fe(pap-5NO2)2的压热效应微观机制，发现分子振动的晶格熵贡献约占总压热响应的84%。
AI.motivation: 尽管该自旋交叉配合物已展现出优异的压热性能，但其压力诱导熵变的微观起源尚不清楚，尤其是振动、构型和自旋自由度对压热响应的相对贡献尚未被定量确定。
AI.method: 结合密度泛函理论（DFT）计算与有效平均场哈密顿量：从第一性原理计算低自旋(S=0)和高自旋(S=2)态的振动频率，构建包含构型、自旋和晶格熵贡献的热力学模型，并通过位移矢量重叠分析建立两自旋态振动谱的对应关系。
AI.result: 模型定量重现了实验报道的2 kbar压力变化下的压热熵变（最大可逆熵变约70 J kg⁻¹ K⁻¹），预测环境压力下自旋交叉温度T₁/₂=313 K，与实验值308 K高度一致。熵组分分析表明晶格熵占总压热响应的约84%，构型和自旋贡献较小。
AI.conclusion: 金属-配体振动的低中频振动是振动熵变的主要微观来源，分子振动相关的晶格熵主导了该材料的压热响应。

title: Chiral superconductors and competing states across a Lifshitz transition in rhombohedral pentalayer graphene
summary: Rhombohedral multilayer graphene hosts a distinctive low-energy electronic structure in which strong Coulomb interactions and nontrivial quantum geometry intertwine to generate exotic quantum states. Recent experiments reported signatures of chiral superconductivity in electron-doped rhombohedral multilayer graphene within the spin- and valley-polarized regime. Here we map the normal-state fermiology surrounding chiral superconductivity in rhombohedral pentalayer graphene. Quantum oscillation measurements reveal an electrically controlled Lifshitz transition between a simply-connected circular quarter-metal Fermi surface and an annular quarter-metal Fermi surface. The Lifshitz boundary itself shifts with perpendicular magnetic field, consistent with the strongly momentum-dependent orbital magnetic moment of the low-energy band. Approaching the transition from either side, the electron effective mass becomes strongly enhanced, implying the formation of a nearly dispersionless band bottom and a strongly reduced kinetic-energy scale. This singular electronic structure produces a regime of exceptionally strong instability in which chiral superconductivity competes with Wigner crystalline phases and reentrant quantum Hall states. In particular, two superconducting regions with signatures of orbital time-reversal-symmetry breaking lie on opposite sides of the Lifshitz boundary and have comparable transition temperatures, yet the annular-side state is suppressed by a substantially smaller perpendicular magnetic field. Our calculation finds comparable chiral pairing tendencies on the two parent Fermi surfaces while producing a much lower orbital-Zeeman pair-breaking scale and an additional finite-momentum pairing tendency for the annular state. These results identify Fermi-surface topology as a key control parameter for chiral superconductivity in rhombohedral graphene.

AI.tldr: 本文通过量子振荡测量绘制了菱面体五层石墨烯在正常态下的费米面拓扑结构，揭示了由电场控制的Lifshitz相变（从单连通圆形四分之一金属费米面到环形四分之一金属费米面），并发现该相变边界随垂直磁场移动。研究确定了这一奇异电子结构如何增强手性超导不稳定性，使其与Wigner晶体和回旋量子霍尔态竞争，并证明费米面拓扑是控制菱面体石墨烯手性超导性的关键参数。
AI.motivation: 菱面体多层石墨烯中存在强库仑相互作用与非平凡量子几何交织产生的奇异量子态，近期实验报道了电子掺杂菱面体多层石墨烯在手性超导方面的迹象。理解围绕手性超导的正常态费米面结构，对于揭示超导机制和控制该量子态至关重要。
AI.method: 采用量子振荡测量技术（特别是de Haas-van Alphen或Shubnikov-de Haas振荡）绘制正常态费米面，结合电场调控实现Lifshitz相变的原位观测；通过分析有效质量的增强和磁场依赖的相变边界来表征轨道磁矩的动量依赖性；辅以理论计算比较两种母费米面上的手性配对倾向、轨道-塞曼对破坏尺度及有限动量配对趋势。
AI.result: 1）发现电场可控的Lifshitz相变，连接圆形与环形四分之一金属费米面；2）相变边界随垂直磁场移动，与强动量依赖的轨道磁矩一致；3）在相变两侧电子有效质量显著增强，形成近无色散的能带底部和极小的动能尺度；4）两个手性超导区域位于Lifshitz边界两侧，温度相近但环形侧超导态被显著更小的垂直磁场抑制；5）理论计算显示两种费米面手性配对倾向相当，但环形态具更低的轨道-塞曼对破坏尺度和额外有限动量配对趋势。
AI.conclusion: 费米面拓扑被确认为菱面体石墨烯中手性超导的关键调控参数。Lifshitz相变附近的奇异电子结构（近无色散带底和增强的有效质量）产生了异常强的不稳定性窗口，其中手性超导与Wigner晶体和回旋量子霍尔态相互竞争。环形费米面特有的低轨道-塞曼破坏尺度与有限动量配对倾向为理解其超导态的磁场响应差异提供了理论解释。

title: Microwave-Induced Optomagnetism in High-Temperature Superconductors
summary: We report the first experimental observation of a steady-state, microwave-driven inverse Faraday effect in a high-temperature superconductor. Circularly polarized microwave radiation generates a helicity-dependent response in an epitaxial $\mathrm{YBa_2Cu_3O_{7-δ}}$ film, detected using homodyne Hall transport. The optomagnetic response emerges exclusively below $T_c$, vanishes in the normal state, and exhibits no power-dependent counterpart under linearly polarized excitation. The effective optomagnetic conversion reaches $1.75\,\mathrm{T}/(\mathrm{W\,cm^{-2}})$, surpassing optical benchmarks by several orders of magnitude. At higher microwave powers, the signal collapses when the self-generated field exceeds $B_{c1}$, marking the onset of a vortex phase-slip regime, and subsequently re-emerges at mode-locked vortex-washboard harmonics. These results establish steady-state microwave optomagnetism as a route to contactless, non-inductive magnetic control and nonequilibrium vortex spectroscopy in superconducting quantum systems.

AI.tldr: 本文首次实验观测到高温超导体中稳态微波驱动的逆法拉第效应。在YBa₂Cu₃O₇₋δ外延薄膜中，圆偏振微波辐射产生了依赖螺旋度的响应，并通过零差霍尔输运检测。该光磁响应仅在Tc以下出现，正常态消失，线性偏振激发下无对应效应。有效光磁转换效率达1.75 T/(W·cm⁻²)，比光学基准高出数个数量级。高功率下信号在自生场超过Bc1时崩溃（涡旋相滑移），随后在锁模涡旋梳状谐波处重新出现。
AI.motivation: 探索超导体系中微波频段稳态逆法拉第效应，为接触式、非感应式磁调控和超导量子系统中的非平衡涡旋谱学开辟新路径。传统光学逆法拉第效应效率极低，而超导材料的相干宏观量子态可能提供更高效的光磁转换机制。
AI.method: 使用外延YBa₂Cu₃O₇₋δ高温超导薄膜，施加圆偏振微波辐射，通过零差霍尔输运技术检测螺旋度依赖的响应信号。系统性地对比超导态与正常态、圆偏振与线偏振激发的差异，并在不同微波功率下追踪信号的演化行为。
AI.result: 1) 微波驱动的逆法拉第效应仅在超导态（Tc以下）出现，正常态完全消失；2) 线偏振激发无功率依赖对应信号，确认了效应的螺旋度本质；3) 有效光磁转换效率达1.75 T/(W·cm⁻²)，比光学波段高数个数量级；4) 高功率下信号在自生场超过Bc1时崩溃，呈现涡旋相滑移特征，并在模式锁定的涡旋梳状谐波频率处重新出现。
AI.conclusion: 稳态微波光磁效应是超导态独有的宏观量子现象，可实现高效的光-磁转换，为超导量子系统提供了一种接触式、非感应式的磁控制手段，同时也为研究非平衡涡旋动力学和涡旋谱学提供了新的实验平台。

title: Chiral Color Ice: Exact Local Handedness Constraints and Möbius Zero Modes in Frustrated Magnets
summary: Local constraints govern the low-energy physics of frustrated matter, but familiar ice-type rules constrain flux-like quantities and are insensitive to handedness. Here we show that handedness itself can be imposed as an exact local quantum constraint without selecting an axis in spin space. We construct positive-semidefinite, SU(2)-invariant parent Hamiltonians whose complete zero-energy space on a tetrahedron has a prescribed chirality sign, rather than selecting a particular chiral wave function. For spin-1/2 the local term is a rank-one projector onto a chiral tetrahedral singlet, while for arbitrary spin it factorizes as $B^\dagger B$ through a singlet-annihilation operator, with a completely characterized kernel given by the span of the globally rotated chiral color-ice states. For coherent states, the same zero-energy condition becomes an $S$-independent nonlinear constraint in which three spin directions determine the fourth through a Möbius transformation; compositions of these maps define constraint holonomies on extended lattices. Connecting the same local constraint in different ways produces qualitatively different collective regimes: corner-sharing lattices retain exponentially large quantum ground-state kernels, with rigorous lower bounds exceeding conventional ice benchmarks; edge-sharing lattices support subdimensional plane or line zero modes; while triangular constructions suppress nonuniform coherent deformations and contain the complete Anderson tower of tetrahedral magnetic order at exactly zero energy. Two inequivalent triangular coverings further show that harmonic zero-mode counting does not determine the size of the quantum kernel. These results establish a tractable setting in which local handedness, nonlinear constraint geometry, and quantum degeneracy can be disentangled and related directly to the connectivity of the constraint network.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将手性本身作为精确的局域量子约束的构造方法，在不选取自旋空间特定轴的情况下，通过SU(2)不变的正半定父哈密顿量在四面体上实现零能空间具有规定手性符号的约束。对于自旋1/2为秩一投影算子，任意自旋则通过单态湮灭算子因子化。在扩展格点上，不同的连接方式产生不同的集体量子行为：角共享格具有指数级零能核，边共享格支持次维度零模式，三角构造在零能处包含完整的安德森塔。
AI.motivation: 传统冰规则约束的是通量类物理量，对手性不敏感。然而低能物理中手性本质上是关键自由度，因此作者希望构造一种精确的局域量子约束，使得手性本身成为约束条件，从而建立手性、非线性约束几何与量子简并度之间的直接联系。
AI.method: 构造正半定、SU(2)不变的父哈密顿量。自旋1/2情形下局域项为投射到手性四面体单态上的秩一投影算子；任意自旋情形下因子化为B†B形式，通过单态湮灭算子实现，其核完全由全局旋转的手性颜色冰态张成。对相干态，零能条件退化为S无关的非线性约束，通过Möbius变换决定三个自旋方向与第四个自旋方向的关系，组合映射定义约束和乐。
AI.result: 不同格点连接方式产生不同集体行为：角共享格保留指数级量子基态核（下界超过常规冰基准）；边共享格支持次维度平面或线零模；三角构造抑制非均匀相干形变并在零能处包含完整安德森塔。两种不等价三角覆盖表明谐振零模计数不决定量子核大小。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了局域手性、非线性约束几何与量子简并度可直接关联的可处理框架，表明约束网络的连通性直接决定了量子基态核的大小和结构，为理解受阻磁性系统中的手性约束提供了全新视角。

title: Solid and Quasi-Solid Electrolytes for Zinc Batteries: Balancing Water Activity, Ion Transport, and Interfaces
comment: 48 pages, 6 figures, and 3 tables; the invited review article submitted to Advanced Energy and Sustainability Research
summary: Zinc batteries offer a compelling route to safe and low-cost energy storage, yet their reliance on aqueous electrolytes promotes hydrogen evolution, corrosion, cathode dissolution, and non-uniform zinc deposition. Replacing the liquid with a solid or quasi-solid electrolyte can suppress these processes, but it also removes the medium that enables rapid Zn2+ transport and conformal electrode contact. This tension, the price of removing water, has been obscured by inconsistent use of the term solid state and by comparisons based largely on bulk ionic conductivity. Here we critically examine zinc electrolytes across a continuum from water-rich hydrogels to dry polymers, solvated crystals, and inorganic conductors. We distinguish water content from thermodynamic water activity and classify these materials according to phase state, mobile-solvent fraction, and dominant transport mechanism. We show that neither high conductivity nor nominally water-free composition reliably predicts cell performance: electrolyte thickness, Zn2+ transference, interfacial resistance, and evolving contact often determine the practical outcome. Controlled-solvation and hybrid electrolytes therefore provide the most credible near-term path, whereas genuinely solvent-free Zn2+ conductors remain a longer-term scientific target. Progress will require transparent reporting of solvent state and validation using thin electrolytes, realistic electrode loadings, limited zinc excess, and calendar-life testing.

AI.tldr: 本文批判性地审视了从富水水凝胶到干燥聚合物、溶剂化晶体和无机导体的锌电解质连续谱，指出"固态"术语使用不一致和仅基于体相离子电导率的比较掩盖了去除水的代价。研究发现高电导率和名义上无水组成并不能可靠预测电池性能，电解质厚度、Zn2+迁移数、界面电阻和接触演变往往决定实际结果。可控溶剂化和混合电解质提供了近期最可信的路径，而真正无溶剂的Zn2+导体仍是长期科学目标。
AI.motivation: 锌电池有望实现安全低成本储能，但含水电解质会引发析氢、腐蚀、阴极溶解和不均匀锌沉积等问题。用固体或准固体电解质替代液体可抑制这些过程，但也移除了促进快速Zn2+传输和保形电极接触的介质。这一"去除水的代价"的张力被"固态"术语的不一致使用和主要基于体相离子电导率的比较所掩盖，亟需澄清。
AI.method: 作者在一个从富水水凝胶到干燥聚合物、溶剂化晶体和无机导体的连续谱上系统审视锌电解质，区分水含量与热力学水活度，并根据相态、可移动溶剂分数和主导传输机制对材料进行分类，同时考察电解质厚度、Zn2+迁移数、界面电阻和接触演变等实际因素对电池性能的影响。
AI.result: 研究发现高电导率或名义上无水组成都不能可靠预测电池性能；电解质厚度、Zn2+迁移数、界面电阻和不断演变的接触通常决定实际结果。可控溶剂化和混合电解质被认为是最可信的近期路径，而真正无溶剂的Zn2+导体仍是长期科学目标。
AI.conclusion: 进展需要透明报告溶剂状态，并使用薄电解质、现实电极负载、有限锌过量以及日历寿命测试进行验证，以推动锌固态电解质领域从模糊的比较走向可靠的实用评估。

title: Universal tuning of Förster resonance energy transfer in gate-programmable conductor-dielectric-conductor heterostructures
summary: We develop a quantum-electrodynamical theory for universal tuning of spontaneous emission and Förster resonance energy transfer (FRET) in a material-agnostic conductor-dielectric-conductor heterostructure. The platform consists of a dielectric spacer of thickness $W$ bounded by two gate-tunable two-dimensional conductors. The only microscopic input from the surrounding materials is the transverse-magnetic and transverse-electric reflection amplitudes $r_{\TM/\TE}(q_ρ,ω)$ of the two sheets. Starting from the QED photon propagator, we derive the retarded Maxwell dyadic, the vacuum/Hadamard field propagator, and the time-ordered Feynman propagator in the same geometry. The spontaneous-emission rate is controlled by the local vacuum spectral density, while FRET is controlled by the nonlocal retarded/advanced product $\obG_{\text R}(\bx_D,\bx_A;ω_D)\Im\,\balpha_A(ω_D)\obG_{\text A}(\bx_A,\bx_D;ω_D)$. In the transparent limit $r_{\TM}\to 0$, the near-field FRET rate recovers the bulk $x_ρ^{-6}$ law. In the Dirichlet/PEC branch $r_{\TM}\to -1$, the gapless transverse mode is removed and the donor-acceptor coupling acquires a Bessel-$K$ envelope, giving an exponentially screened FRET rate $Γ_{D\to A}\propto\exp(-2πx_ρ/W)$ at large lateral separation. In the opposite Neumann/PMC-like branch $r_{\TM}\to 1^{-}$, a nearly gapless transverse mode survives and produces a wide quasi-two-dimensional logarithmic propagator, enhancing the nonlocal electromagnetic coupling over a gate-programmable range $x_{ρ,*}\sim W/(1-r_{\TM})$. For graphene-Er implementations, the same retarded Green tensor also separates dissipative on-shell Er-to-graphene decay, governed by its absorptive part, from dispersive virtual-plasmon-mediated Er-Er coupling, governed by its reactive part; a plasmonic band gap can suppress the former while retaining the latter.

AI.tldr: 本文发展了一套量子电动力学(QED)理论，用于在电介质-导体-电介质异质结构中普适地调控自发辐射和Förster共振能量转移(FRET)。该平台由厚度为W的介电间隔层和两个可栅极调控的二维导体构成，唯一的微观输入是两片导体的横磁/横电反射振幅。通过该理论，作者揭示了三种不同的电磁边界分支（透明极限、Dirichlet/PEC和Neumann/PMC类）对FRET速率的根本影响，并展示了在石墨烯-铒体系中可区分耗散性衰变与色散性虚等离子体耦合。
AI.motivation: 自发辐射和FRET是光与物质相互作用中的核心过程，在量子光学、纳米光子学和量子信息处理中具有广泛应用。然而，在可调控的导电平面上精确调控这些过程的物理机制尚未被系统地理解和理论化。作者旨在建立一个材料无关的通用理论框架，通过栅极调控二维导体的电磁边界条件，实现对近场电磁耦合的普适调谐，从而为量子光源、能量转移和纳米尺度光调控提供理论基础。
AI.method: 作者从QED光子传播子出发，推导了电场-介质-导体异质结构中的延迟麦克斯韦并矢、真空/Hadamard场传播子和时间有序Feynman传播子。自发辐射速率由局部真空谱密度控制，而FRET由非局域延迟/超前乘积控制。理论的关键输入是两片二维导体的TM和TE反射振幅。作者系统分析了三种边界极限：透明极限(r_TM→0)恢复体材料x^-6定律；Dirichlet/PEC分支(r_TM→-1)产生指数屏蔽的FRET；Neumann/PMC类分支(r_TM→1^-)则产生近无间隙横向模，增强非局域电磁耦合。
AI.result: 理论预测了三种截然不同的FRET行为：(1) 透明极限下保持近场x^-6体材料定律；(2) Dirichlet/PEC分支去除无间隙横向模，FRET速率以exp(-2πx_ρ/W)指数衰减；(3) Neumann/PMC类分支保留近无间隙横向模，产生对数型传播子，在栅极可编程范围x_ρ*~W/(1-r_TM)内增强非局域耦合。对于石墨烯-铒实现，相同的延迟格林张量可分离壳上Er-石墨烯耗散衰变（由吸收部分控制）与虚等离子体介导的Er-Er耦合（由反应部分控制），等离子体能隙可抑制前者同时保留后者。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了一个统一、材料无关的QED理论框架，展示了通过栅极调控二维导体界面，可以在同一平台上实现对自发辐射和FRET从指数屏蔽到长程增强的广泛调控。这一理论为设计可编程的纳米光子平台、控制量子发射体间的能量转移以及分离耗散与反应性耦合通道提供了新的工具和见解。

title: Evaluating a 4B open-weights local LLM for agentic DFT workflows: a literature reproducibility audit
summary: Agentic workflows in materials science relying on hosted commercial models face severe reproducibility, economic, and data-privacy constraints. To explore fully local agentic science, this work evaluates an open-weights Qwen3:4B model executing an autonomous scientific pipeline across varying hardware constraints. Applied to pentagonal two-dimensional materials, the system extracts parameters from unstructured text, translates them into density functional theory (DFT) inputs, and drives simulations to convergence under a strict neurosymbolic architecture where agents propose and deterministic code disposes. The workflow is guarded by verbatim text grounding and multi-pass inference unions to counteract hardware-induced structural collapse. Evaluated against 201 expert judgements, the extractor achieves 95.7% precision (95% CI 90.3-98.1%) and 67.3% recall (59.8-74.0%), ensuring extracted parameters are strictly factual. However, precision identifying absent parameters does not exceed 47.0%, establishing that the measured omission rate constitutes a loose upper bound on true literature incompleteness. Across three hardware configurations, complete GPU residency governs extraction quality more fundamentally than weight or cache precision, raising Matthews correlation from 0.414 to 0.530 at fixed quantisation and to 0.560 with an unquantised cache. A corpus-scale audit indicates only 19 (33.3%) of the 57 studies are reproducible in principle, reporting every method parameter needed to re-initialise the calculation. Driven to convergence, the workflow reproduces published lattice constants with a mean absolute relative error of 2.3% where the relaxed structure retains its prototype, establishing that lightweight open-weights models can reliably drive autonomous agentic workflows when bounded by deterministic code gates.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了开源轻量级模型Qwen3:4B在完全本地化的自主科学智能体工作流中的表现，应用于五边形二维材料的DFT计算。系统通过"智能体提议、确定性代码决策"的神经符号架构，实现从非结构化文本到DFT模拟的全流程自动化。结果显示提取器在201项专家判断下达到95.7%精确率和67.3%召回率，且在收敛后以2.3%的平均绝对相对误差复现了文献中的晶格常数。
AI.motivation: 商业托管模型驱动的材料科学智能体工作流面临严重的可重复性、经济成本和数据隐私问题。为探索完全本地化的自主科学智能体，需要评估开源轻量级模型在硬件约束下的执行能力。
AI.method: 采用Qwen3:4B模型构建自主科学流水线，在神经符号架构下运行：智能体负责从非结构化文本中提取参数并生成DFT输入，确定性代码负责驱动模拟收敛。通过逐字文本锚定和多轮推理并集来防止硬件引起的结构坍缩。在三种硬件配置（不同权重精度、缓存精度和GPU驻留状态）下评估系统性能。
AI.result: 提取器在201项专家判断下达到95.7%精确率（95%CI: 90.3-98.1%）和67.3%召回率（95%CI: 59.8-74.0%）。全GPU驻留对提取质量的影响比权重或缓存精度更根本，将Matthews相关系数从0.414提升至0.530（固定量化下）和0.560（非量化缓存下）。文献审计显示57项研究中仅19项（33.3%）原则上可复现。收敛后系统以2.3%的平均绝对相对误差复现了文献晶格常数。
AI.conclusion: 轻量级开源模型在确定性代码门的约束下可以可靠驱动自主智能体工作流，为完全本地化的材料科学智能体提供了可行路径。但文献自身的不完整性以及模型识别缺失参数的局限性仍需关注。

title: Switchable Magnetoelectric Transport in Graphene via a Van der Waals Multiferroic
summary: Electric and magnetic control of transport properties at atomic interfaces is central to the development of next generation electronics and spintronics. Van der Waals multiferroics materials that simultaneously host dielectric and magnetic orders down to the monolayer limit offer a promising platform for such interfacial control, yet the realization of electronic functionalities that exploit the unique attributes of van der Waals multiferroics has largely remained elusive. Here, we realize a van der Waals heterostructure comprising graphene and the multiferroic CuCrP2S6, enabling gate-switchable magnetoelectric transport in graphene, mediated by the multiferroic layer. The charge-neutrality resistance peak of graphene exhibits pronounced hysteresis arising from polarization flip in the multiferroic state. Application of an in-plane magnetic field shifts this peak in a polarization-dependent manner, revealing magnetic-field-induced polarization modulation a direct signature of the magnetoelectric effect. Furthermore, cooling the device under an applied electric field enables domain control of the multiferroic order, allowing reversible switching of the interfacial magnetoelectric transport. These results provide the first demonstration of interfacial magnetoelectric transport in a vdW heterostructure, and establish a pathway for engineering two-dimensional van der Waals interfaces for functional device applications.

AI.tldr: 本文首次在石墨烯/CuCrP₂S₆范德华异质结中实现了界面磁电输运调控，展示了栅极可开关的磁电输运、磁致极化调制以及电场控制的畴翻转，为二维范德华多功能器件开辟了道路。
AI.motivation: 电和磁对原子界面输运性质的控制是下一代电子学和自旋电子学发展的核心。范德华多铁材料在单层极限下同时具备介电和磁有序，为界面控制提供了有前景的平台，但利用其独特属性的电子功能实现此前仍难以达成。
AI.method: 构建由石墨烯和多铁性CuCrP₂S₆组成的范德华异质结，通过测量石墨烯的电中性点电阻峰来探测多铁层的极化状态；施加面内磁场观察电阻峰的极化依赖位移，并通过电场冷却实现多铁畴的控制。
AI.result: 石墨烯的电荷中性电阻峰表现出由多铁态极化翻转引起的显著磁滞回线；面内磁场使该峰以极化依赖的方式移动，直接证明了磁电效应；在电场下冷却器件可实现多铁序的畴控制，实现界面磁电输运的可逆切换。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次在范德华异质结中演示了界面磁电输运，为利用二维范德华界面进行功能器件工程提供了新途径。

title: High-Field Terahertz Spin Resonance in Cr$_2$O$_3$ above the Spin-Flop Transition
summary: We report single-shot terahertz time-domain spectroscopy of Cr$_2$O$_3$ in pulsed magnetic fields up to 30 T. Well above the spin-flop field, in the 20-30 T range, the resonance frequency exhibits a nearly linear field dependence with a slope of ~22 GHz/T, smaller than the 28 GHz/T reported from low-field measurements. This reduction is insensitive to temperature and to a 15° field tilt, suggesting an intrinsic high-field property.

AI.tldr: 该论文报道了在高达30特斯拉的脉冲磁场下对Cr₂O₃进行单发太赫兹时域光谱测量。在自旋翻转场以上（20-30 T区间），共振频率呈近线性磁场依赖关系，斜率为~22 GHz/T，低于低场测量报告的28 GHz/T。该减小对温度和15°磁场倾斜均不敏感，表明是内在的高场特性。
AI.motivation: 探索Cr₂O₃在高磁场（超过自旋翻转场）下的磁共振特性，研究共振频率场依赖是否与低场测量一致，以揭示可能的高场内在物理机制。
AI.method: 采用单发太赫兹时域光谱技术，在脉冲磁场（最高30 T）下对Cr₂O₃进行测量，分析20-30 T范围内共振频率的磁场依赖性，并改变温度和磁场倾斜角度以验证结果的稳健性。
AI.result: 在20-30 T区间内，共振频率随磁场近似线性变化，斜率约22 GHz/T，显著低于低场报告的28 GHz/T。该斜率变化对温度变化和高达15°的磁场倾斜均不敏感。
AI.conclusion: 高场下共振频率磁场依赖斜率低于低场值，且不受温度或磁场倾斜影响，表明这是Cr₂O₃的一种内在高场特性，可能反映了高磁场下磁结构或磁激发性质的改变。

title: Singlet-doublet transitions and Josephson currents in a superconducting ring with a quantum dot
summary: We investigate the ground state properties of a superconducting ring embedded with a quantum dot (QD) by using a variational wave-function approach. A theoretical formulation for the treatment of the finite-U Anderson impurity coupled with a superconducting ring are presented. We demonstrate singlet-doublet transitions of the ground state for this system with the QD in the mixed valence regime. It is shown that the supercurrent in the superconductor ring shows oscillations with the external enclosed magnetic flux and exhibits abrupt jumps at the singlet-doublet phase transition points.

AI.tldr: 本文采用变分波函数方法研究了嵌入量子点的超导环的基态性质，展示了混合价态区域内的单重态-双重态相变，并发现超电流随外磁通振荡并在相变点发生突变跳跃。
AI.motivation: 研究嵌入量子点的超导环系统，理解有限U安德森杂质与超导环耦合的基态性质，特别是混合价态区域的单重态-双重态相变行为及其对超电流的影响。
AI.method: 采用变分波函数方法，提出了处理有限U安德森杂质与超导环耦合的理论框架。
AI.result: 展示了该系统在量子点处于混合价态区域时基态发生单重态-双重态转变；超导环中的超电流随外部封闭磁通呈现振荡行为，并在单重态-双重态相变点处出现突变跳跃。
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了超导环-量子点耦合系统中基态相变与超电流行为的关联，为理解和调控此类介观系统的物理性质提供了理论基础。

title: Phonon-Localization-Driven Decoupling of Dual-Channel Transport for Record-Low Intrinsic Lattice Thermal Conductivity
summary: A fundamental bottleneck in pushing the intrinsic lattice thermal conductivity of inorganic crystalline solids to its lowest limit arises from the inherent competition between the particle-like propagation (\(κ_{\mathrm{L}}^{\mathrm{P}}\)) and wave-like tunneling (\(κ_{\mathrm{L}}^{\mathrm{C}}\)) channels. Herein, we demonstrate that phonon localization provides a robust pathway to decouple the dual-channel transport, achieving record-low \(κ_{\mathrm{L}}\) in quasi-1D ternary helical crystals. Despite the structural complexity leading to densely populated phonon branches and thus inducing abundant coherent phonons, the weak interchain interactions and heavy elements compress numerous branches into highly localized, nearly dispersionless flat bands. Such strong localization simultaneously suppresses both the diagonal and off-diagonal components of the group velocity, thereby synergistically suppressing \(κ_{\mathrm{L}}^{\mathrm{P}}\) and \(κ_{\mathrm{L}}^{\mathrm{C}}\). Taking InSeI as an example, the interchain room-temperature \(κ_{\mathrm{L}}^{\mathrm{P}}\) and \(κ_{\mathrm{L}}^{\mathrm{C}}\) are 0.145 and 0.053 W/mK, respectively, yielding an ultralow total \(κ_{\mathrm{L}}\) of 0.198 W/mK. Weaker interchain interactions further drive the room-temperature \(κ_{\mathrm{L}}\) of GaSeI and AlSeI to record lows of 0.086 and 0.089 W/mK, respectively; these values even drop to 0.058 and 0.059 W/mK at 900 K. These findings provide useful insights into exploring the thermal conductivity limit in crystals.

AI.tldr: 本文通过声子局域化策略解决了无机晶体本征晶格热导率中粒子状传播与波状隧穿双通道传输相互竞争的根本瓶颈，在准一维三元螺旋晶体中实现了创纪录的超低晶格热导率（如GaSeI室温下仅0.086 W/mK）。
AI.motivation: 将无机晶体本征晶格热导率推向极限时，粒子状传播通道和波状隧穿通道之间存在固有的竞争关系，传统方法难以同时压制两个通道，亟需一种能够解耦双通道传输的新策略。
AI.method: 利用准一维三元螺旋晶体的结构特征——弱链间相互作用和重元素——将密集的声子分支压缩成高度局域化、近似无弥散的平带，从而同时抑制群速度的对角和非对角分量，协同压制两个热输运通道。
AI.result: InSeI室温链间总热导率为0.198 W/mK（粒子通道0.145、波状通道0.053 W/mK）；GaSeI和AlSeI分别达到创纪录的0.086和0.089 W/mK，且在900 K时进一步降至0.058和0.059 W/mK。
AI.conclusion: 声子局域化是探索晶体热导率极限的有效途径，为设计超低热导率材料提供了重要见解。

title: Scalar Spin Chirality from Dissipative Pumping and Lamb Shift Precession
summary: Circulating currents in triangular triple quantum dots reverse repeatedly with bias even at zero magnetic flux and for a real Hamiltonian, a phenomenon whose origin has remained unclear. We show that dissipative tunneling prepares an orbital pseudospin, while virtual charge fluctuations generate a noncollinear Lamb field that rotates it toward the chiral direction. Bias changes their relative orientation and thereby reverses the current. This reservoir-induced orbital Hanle effect converts a nonchiral orbital polarization into scalar spin chirality, which an exact ground-multiplet identity links to the circulating current. Hierarchical-equations-of-motion calculations show that the low-bias reversal survives beyond the second-order weak-coupling description, while the quadratic growth of chirality after a sudden voltage switch identifies precession. More broadly, time-reversal-odd responses can emerge in open quantum systems from the interplay between dissipative state preparation and coherent precession.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了三角三量子点中循环电流即使在零磁通和实数哈密顿量下也会随偏压反复反向的物理机制：耗散隧穿制备轨道赝自旋，虚电荷涨落产生非共线Lamb场使其向手性方向旋转，偏压改变两者相对取向从而反转电流。作者将此称为"储库诱导轨道Hanle效应"，并通过层次运动方程计算验证了该效应超越二阶弱耦合描述。
AI.motivation: 三角三量子点中循环电流在零磁通和实数哈密顿量下随偏压反复反向的现象长期缺乏理论解释，作者旨在阐明这一反常现象的微观物理起源。
AI.method: 采用层次运动方程（HEOM）方法，结合耗散隧穿制备轨道赝自旋与虚电荷涨落产生非共线Lamb场的理论框架，将自旋物理中的Hanle效应推广到轨道自由度。
AI.result: 证明了储库诱导的轨道Hanle效应可将非手性轨道极化转化为标量自旋手性，并通过基态多重态恒等式与循环电流关联。低偏压下的电流反转在超越二阶弱耦合描述后仍然存在；电压突变后手性的二次增长证实了进动机制。
AI.conclusion: 在开放量子系统中，耗散态制备与相干进动的相互作用可在时间反演对称性下产生奇响应，为理解非平衡量子系统中的手性现象提供了更广泛的框架。

title: Valley-Enabled Intrinsic Dresselhaus Spin-Orbit Coupling in Silicon
summary: We develop a symmetry-based theory of spin-orbit-valley coupling in silicon that reveals an intrinsic source of Dresselhaus spin-orbit coupling independent of interfaces or external electric fields. Treating the valley degree of freedom as a symmetry-carrying quantum degree of freedom, we show that the Dresselhaus interaction is necessarily valley off-diagonal and that a bulk contribution proportional to the valley Pauli matrix $τ_1$ is symmetry allowed. Tight-binding calculations yield a bulk coupling more than an order of magnitude larger than typical interface-induced spin-orbit coupling; achieving the same energy scale through the interface-induced mechanism would require electric fields roughly 50 times larger than typical fields. We further derive the symmetry-allowed spin-valley couplings generated by magnetic-field gradients and show how they account for the valley-dependent Zeeman splitting observed in micromagnet experiments. A slight tilt of the background magnetic field out of the plane produces an additional isotropic contribution linear in $B_z$, providing an experimentally accessible signature of the corresponding coupling constant. Finally, we predict a spin-independent micromagnet-induced valley splitting in the $τ_3$ channel, which is distinct from the $τ_{1,2}$ channels generated by alloy disorder and therefore remains robust against disorder-induced cancellation. These results establish valley symmetry as a fundamental ingredient in the spin-orbit physics of silicon and provide new mechanisms for controlling and probing spin and valley degrees of freedom in silicon quantum devices.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了硅中自旋-轨道-谷耦合的对称性理论，发现了一种不依赖界面或外电场的本征Dresselhaus自旋轨道耦合来源。将谷自由度视为携带对称性的量子自由度，证明Dresselhaus相互作用必然是谷非对角的，且存在正比于谷Pauli矩阵τ₁的体耦合贡献。紧束缚计算表明体耦合比典型界面诱导的自旋轨道耦合大一个数量级以上，达到相同能量尺度需要约50倍大的电场。文中还推导了磁场梯度产生的自旋-谷耦合，解释了微磁体实验中观察到的谷依赖Zeeman劈裂。此外，预测了自旋无关的微磁体诱导谷劈裂（τ₃通道），区别于合金无序产生的τ₁,₂通道，对无序引起的抵消保持鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 硅量子器件中自旋轨道耦合的传统理解依赖于界面或外电场诱导的Rashba/Dresselhaus效应。然而，硅的谷自由度作为重要的量子自由度，其在自旋轨道耦合中的作用尚未被系统研究。作者希望建立基于对称性的理论框架，揭示谷自由度在硅自旋轨道物理中的基础性作用，并探索新的自旋和谷操控机制。
AI.method: 作者采用对称性分析的方法，将谷自由度视为携带对称性的量子自由度，推导了Dresselhaus自旋轨道耦合的对称性允许形式。结合紧束缚计算验证体耦合的数值大小，并与界面诱导的耦合进行比较。进一步利用对称性理论推导磁场梯度诱导的自旋-谷耦合形式，预测可实验观测的物理效应。
AI.result: 1) 发现体Dresselhaus自旋轨道耦合与谷Pauli矩阵τ₁成正比，比典型界面诱导耦合大一个数量级以上；2) 推导了磁场梯度产生的自旋-谷耦合，能够解释微磁体实验中观察到的谷依赖Zeeman劈裂；3) 预测背景磁场轻微倾斜产生正比于B_z的各向同性额外贡献，可作为耦合常数的实验探针；4) 预测微磁体诱导的τ₃通道自旋无关谷劈裂，对无序引起的抵消保持鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: 谷对称性是硅自旋轨道物理的基本要素，谷自由度与自旋轨道耦合的耦合提供了新的自旋和谷操控与探测机制，为硅量子器件的设计与优化开辟了新途径。

title: Evanescent-mode Casimir-Josephson force and gate-controlled resonances in ballistic graphene Josephson junctions
summary: We develop a microscopic scattering theory of the phase-dependent equilibrium mechanical response of a ballistic superconductor-graphene-superconductor Josephson junction. The calculation is based on an energy-dependent Dirac scattering matrix embedded in a normalized Matsubara determinant, so the reported force correction contains the complete Bogoliubov-de Gennes spectrum of the stated ideal model. At charge neutrality the full determinant approaches a closed-form evanescent-mode result proportional to $ΔW/L^2$, reaching $2\ln 2\,ΔW/(πL^2)$ at phase difference $π$ in the zero-temperature short-junction limit. Gate doping produces propagating channels and Fabry-Pérot structure, causing large oscillations and sign reversals of the phase-dependent force correction $δF=F(φ)-F(0)$. We distinguish the interband-to-intraband Andreev crossover, controlled by $|μ|/Δ$, from the evanescent-to-propagating crossover, controlled by $|μ|L/(\hbar v_F)$. Exact real-energy subgap poles obtained from the same energy-dependent scattering matrix are used to diagnose specular/interband and retro/intraband character; these labels are not treated as separately measurable thermodynamic forces in the mixed regime. We also quantify the difference between the complete determinant result and the frozen-scattering short-junction approximation without identifying that difference with a pure continuum force. The resulting gate- and phase-dependent mechanical signal provides a Dirac-material extension of earlier superconductivity-induced mechanical-force proposals.

AI.tldr: 本文发展了超导体-石墨烯-超导体弹道约瑟夫森结中相位依赖的平衡力学响应的微观散射理论，基于能量相关的Dirac散射矩阵嵌入归一化Matsubara行列式，涵盖完整Bogoliubov-de Gennes谱。在电荷中性点，完整行列式趋近于封闭形式的倏逝模结果，与ΔW/L²成比例；栅极掺杂产生传播通道和Fabry-Pérot结构，导致相位依赖力修正δF的大幅振荡与符号反转。文章区分了由|μ|/Δ控制的带间-带内Andreev交叉和由|μ|L/(ħv_F)控制的倏逝-传播交叉，并量化了完整行列式结果与冻结散射短结近似之间的差异。
AI.motivation: 旨在将超导诱导力学力的概念扩展到Dirac材料（石墨烯），建立相位依赖的力学响应微观理论，并澄清不同隧穿/Andreev过程对力学信号的贡献，为栅极可调的机械传感应用奠定理论基础。
AI.method: 基于能量相关的Dirac散射矩阵嵌入归一化Matsubara行列式进行微观散射计算，包含完整Bogoliubov-de Gennes谱；利用实能量亚隙极点诊断镜面/带间与回射/带内Andreev过程；对比完整行列式结果与冻结散射短结近似。
AI.result: 电荷中性点得到封闭形式倏逝模结果，短结零温极限下相位差π处达2ln2·ΔW/(πL²)；栅极掺杂引起力学力修正的大幅振荡和符号反转；识别出两类独立交叉（Andreev带间-带内及倏逝-传播），并量化了完整结果与冻结散射近似之间的差异。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为Dirac材料中的超导诱导力学力提供了完整微观理论框架，揭示了栅极和相位双重可调的力学信号，为石墨烯基超导机械器件提供了新的理论指导，同时澄清了不同物理过程对力学响应贡献的分类界限。

title: Floquet Topological Spin-Valley-Layertronics on a Layered Dice Lattice
summary: The recent discovery of long-sought dice flat band in layered YCl electride has opened up rich possibilities of correlation and topological physics in dice lattice systems [Nature Communications 17, 2213 (2026), arXiv:2509.05958]. Here, we reveal a plethora of distinctive correlated topological phases in a generic layered dice lattice system at band filling of $ν=4$ under on-site Hubbard interactions: (i) the system is an intrinsic sublattice anti-ferromagnetic (AFM) quantum spin-valley Hall insulator; (ii) a circularly polarized light (CPL) drives the AFM spin-valley insulator into a Floquet odd-parity $f$-wave altermagnet(AM) insulator; (iii) a vertical displacement field turns the Floquet $f$-wave AM insulator into a spin-valley-layer-polarized Chern insulator, with the sign of spin, valley and Chern number all controlled by the direction of the displacement field. Our results not only establish the layered dice lattice as a versatile platform for electrically switchable magnetic and topological phases, but also provide an all-electrical scheme for integrated spin-valley-layertronics for non-volatile information storage and processing.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了在层状骰子（dice）晶格体系中，在填充数ν=4和Hubbard相互作用下存在多种关联拓扑相：本征亚晶格反铁磁量子自旋-谷霍尔绝缘体、圆偏振光驱动的Floquet奇宇称f波交变磁绝缘体，以及垂直位移场调控的自旋-谷-层极化Chern绝缘体，为电控自旋-谷-层电子学提供了全电学方案。
AI.motivation: 近期在层状YCl电子化物中发现了长期以来寻找的骰子平带，这为骰子晶格体系中的关联物理和拓扑物理研究开辟了丰富可能性。作者旨在探索这一通用层状骰子晶格体系在相互作用下可能出现的关联拓扑相及其电场调控机制。
AI.method: 在层状骰子晶格体系中，考虑在位Hubbard相互作用，在填充数ν=4下研究系统基态性质。通过引入圆偏振光（CPL）驱动系统进入Floquet regime，并施加垂直位移电场调控电子态，系统地研究了相互作用、光照和电场对磁性和拓扑性质的协同调控。
AI.result: 发现了三种截然不同的关联拓扑相：(i) 本征亚晶格反铁磁量子自旋-谷霍尔绝缘体；(ii) CPL驱动的Floquet奇宇称f波交变磁（AM）绝缘体；(iii) 垂直位移场将f波AM绝缘体转化为自旋-谷-层极化Chern绝缘体，其中自旋、谷和Chern数的符号均可由位移场方向控制。
AI.conclusion: 层状骰子晶格被确立为电学可切换磁性和拓扑相的多功能平台，为集成自旋-谷-层电子学提供了全电学方案，可用于非易失性信息存储和处理。

title: Dynamics of a nanoscale ferromagnetic vortex
summary: We propose a ferromagnetic vortex stabilized by the interfacial Dzyaloshinskii--Moriya interaction (iDMI) and investigate its properties through theoretical analysis and micromagnetic simulations. Our results demonstrate that this vortex can remain stable even in nanoscale ferromagnetic disks with radii below $5\,\text{nm}$---far smaller than those of conventional nanodot vortices having about $1\,μ\text{m}$ radius. We analytically solve the nonlinear equation of motion describing the anharmonic vortex oscillation, and identify the critical frequency that determines the stability of the driven oscillation of the vortex. This nanoscale vortex exhibits conventional properties of microscale vortices, including gyrotropic oscillation and resonance frequency shift under an out-of-plane magnetic field. It also exhibits unconventional behaviors, such as a strongly anharmonic potential, nonlinear oscillations, and a Duffing-oscillator-like response under the external AC bias.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种由界面Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用（iDMI）稳定的铁磁涡旋，并通过理论分析和微磁模拟研究了其性质。该涡旋能在半径小于5 nm的纳米级铁磁圆盘中保持稳定，远小于传统纳米点涡旋（约1 μm半径）。作者解析求解了描述非简谐涡旋振荡的非线性运动方程，并确定了决定涡旋驱动振荡稳定性的临界频率。
AI.motivation: 传统铁磁纳米点涡旋的尺寸受限于约1 μm量级，难以进一步缩小到纳米尺度，这限制了其在纳米器件中的应用。作者希望通过利用iDMI来稳定更小尺寸的涡旋结构，从而突破传统涡旋的尺寸瓶颈。
AI.method: 通过理论分析与微磁模拟相结合的方法。具体包括：1) 利用iDMI稳定纳米尺度铁磁圆盘中的涡旋结构；2) 解析求解描述非简谐涡旋振荡的非线性运动方程；3) 通过微磁模拟验证理论的正确性。
AI.result: 该纳米涡旋在半径小于5 nm的圆盘中保持稳定。该涡旋保留了微米尺度涡旋的传统特性（如旋磁振荡、面外磁场下的共振频移），同时也表现出非传统行为，包括强非简谐势、非线性振荡以及在外加交流偏置下的Duffing振荡器式响应。研究确定了决定驱动振荡稳定性的临界频率。
AI.conclusion: iDMI稳定涡旋能够在远小于传统尺寸的纳米圆盘中保持稳定，且兼具传统涡旋的常规特性与非线性动力学的新奇行为。这为纳米尺度涡旋器件（如纳米振荡器、非线性自旋电子器件）的开发提供了新的可能性。

title: Moiré-induced lattice reconstruction at buried atomic interfaces
summary: Atomic reconstruction at twisted two-dimensional interfaces governs many of their emergent optical, electronic, and mechanical properties, including sliding ferroelectricity. Despite recent progress in understanding lattice reconstruction in suspended twisted bilayers, structural changes at van der Waals heterointerfaces between multilayer crystals remain largely unexplored. Here we use multi-slice electron ptychography to non-invasively recover the three-dimensional atomic structure at marginally twisted rhombohedral interfaces between thick transition-metal dichalcogenide crystals. With a position precision of ~3 pm and a depth resolution ~1 nm, we resolve the twist-induced lattice reconstruction field per layer, and the resulting dislocation network at the buried interface. Despite the bulk nature, we observe markedly strong in-plane interfacial reconstruction due to suppression of the out-of-plane bending by outer layers, exceeding predictions from our three-dimensional modelling. Furthermore, we extract the strain tensor evolution during the decay of the reconstruction into the bulk, providing a structural foundation for understanding multi-layer moiré systems.

AI.tldr: 本文利用多切片电子叠层衍射成像技术（multi-slice electron ptychography），非侵入性地恢复了厚过渡金属二硫族化物晶体间轻微扭转菱面体界面的三维原子结构，实现了约3 pm的横向位置精度和约1 nm的深度分辨率，成功解析了每个原子层的扭转诱导晶格重构场、埋藏界面处的位错网络，并发现由于外层抑制面外弯曲导致的面内界面重构强度超出三维模型预测，同时提取了重构向体相衰减过程中的应变张量演化。
AI.motivation: 尽管悬浮扭转双层中的晶格重构已被广泛研究，但多层晶体之间范德瓦尔斯异质界面的结构变化仍未被充分探索。理解这种埋在体相中的界面的重构行为对于阐明多层莫尔体系的涌现性质至关重要。
AI.method: 采用多切片电子叠层衍射成像技术（multi-slice electron ptychography），以非侵入方式恢复厚过渡金属二硫族化物晶体间轻微扭转菱面体界面的三维原子结构，逐层解析重构场与位错网络，并结合三维建模进行对比分析。
AI.result: 实现了约3 pm的位置精度和约1 nm的深度分辨率；观察到即使在体相条件下，因外层抑制面外面弯曲而导致的显著强面内界面重构，其强度超过三维模型预测；成功提取了重构衰减进入体相过程中的应变张量演化。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示了多层范德瓦尔斯异质界面中由体相约束塑造的独特重构机制，为深入理解多层莫尔体系的结构与物性关联提供了关键的结构学基础。

title: Van Hove singularities at the $L$-face of the lutetium nitride phonon dispersion
summary: We report the structural and vibrational properties of the prototypical 4$f$-filled nonmagnetic member LuN of the lanthanide nitrides, \textit{Ln}N, with elastic and inelastic neutron scattering data at $4$~K. We find a peak in the generalized density of states which, through input from a DFT+$U$ computation, we ascribe to a van Hove singularity on the fourfold-degenerate $L$-face of the Brillouin zone. This work advances the understanding of phonon dynamics in \textit{Ln}N beyond the $Γ$-point.

AI.tldr: 本文通过弹性和非弹性中子散射实验，在4K温度下研究了镧系氮化物代表性非磁性成员LuN的结构和振动性质，并结合DFT+U计算，将广义态密度中的一个峰归因于布里渊区四重简并L面上的范霍夫奇点，从而将LnN声子动力学的研究从Γ点扩展到整个布里渊区。
AI.motivation: 镧系氮化物（LnN）的声子动力学此前主要局限于Γ点附近的研究，缺乏对布里渊区其他高对称点声子行为的理解。本研究旨在通过实验与理论结合，深入理解LuN的振动性质，特别是超越Γ点的声子特征。
AI.method: 使用弹性与非弹性中子散射技术在4K低温下测量LuN的结构和振动性质，并结合DFT+U计算对实验结果进行解释和分析。
AI.result: 在广义态密度中发现了一个峰，通过DFT+U计算将其归因于布里渊区四重简并L面上的范霍夫奇点。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将LnN声子动力学的研究从Γ点推进到整个布里渊区，增进了对镧系氮化物振动性质的全面理解。

title: Exact fluctuation relations in voltage- and temperature-biased Laughlin-edge constrictions
summary: We present a comprehensive analysis of non-equilibrium fluctuation-dissipation relations connect- ing experimentally accessible chiral-current auto- and cross-correlations to the tunneling-current noise and conductance in Laughlin edge states coupled through a quantum point contact (QPC). We examine their validity for two chiral Laughlin edges held at different temperatures and voltages and show that the relations remain exact for arbitrary tunneling strength, voltage bias, and edge- state temperatures. We further generalize them to spatially extended QPCs and to tunneling am- plitudes with an explicit voltage dependence, and discuss the conditions and limitations associated with these generalizations. Our results establish that the local tunneling-current noise generated at the QPC can be reliably reconstructed from experimentally accessible auto- and cross-correlations measured downstream, providing a robust route to characterize non-equilibrium transport in chiral edge states.

AI.tldr: 本文对非平衡涨落-耗散关系进行了全面分析，将实验可测量的手性电流自相关和互相关与Laughlin边缘态中通过量子点接触(QPC)的隧穿电流噪声及电导联系起来。研究发现这些关系在任意隧穿强度、电压偏置和边缘态温度下均严格成立，并进一步推广到空间扩展QPC和具有显式电压依赖的隧穿振幅情形。结果表明，可通过下游测量的自相关和互相关可靠重构QPC处产生的局域隧穿电流噪声。
AI.motivation: 作者希望建立实验可测量的手性电流涨落（自相关和互相关）与局域隧穿噪声之间的严格联系，从而为表征非平衡态手性边缘态输运提供稳健的途径，并系统探讨这些关系的普适性及其适用边界。
AI.method: 对两个处于不同温度和电压下的手性Laughlin边缘态通过QPC耦合的体系进行分析，系统考察非平衡涨落-耗散关系在任意隧穿强度、电压偏置和不同边缘态温度下的有效性；并将结果推广至空间扩展QPC及具有显式电压依赖的隧穿振幅情形。
AI.result: 证明这些涨落-耗散关系在任意隧穿强度、电压偏置和边缘态温度下均精确成立；成功推广至空间扩展QPC和电压依赖隧穿振幅的情形，并明确讨论了推广的条件与局限性。
AI.conclusion: QPC处的局域隧穿电流噪声可以从下游测量的自相关和互相关中可靠重构，为非平衡手性边缘态的输运表征提供了坚实的理论依据和实验可行的路径。

title: Libron-phonon coupling and hydrogen-bond dynamics in the vacancy-ordered perovskite (NH4)2SnCl6: a temperature- and pressure-dependent Raman study
summary: Vacancy-ordered perovskites R2MX6 combine a rigid inorganic framework with a molecular A-site cation, but how the cation dynamics couples to the lattice phonons under external perturbation remains largely unexplored. The librational motion of NH4+ in (NH4)2SnCl6 is strictly Raman-silent by symmetry, which is why it has been probed almost exclusively by neutron scattering, NMR and NQR. We show that it is nevertheless accessible to Raman spectroscopy, through the renormalization it imposes on the allowed [SnCl6]2- modes. Combining single-crystal X-ray diffraction with Raman scattering between 10 and 300 K and up to 10.1 GPa, we find that the average cubic structure varies smoothly with no anomaly, while below ~100 K the [SnCl6]2- modes acquire a libron-phonon renormalization (E_eff ~ 4.7 meV) and a symmetry-selective line asymmetry, and the N-H stretch passes through a minimum near 120 K (E_eff ~ 9.3 meV); both track the classical-to-quantum crossover of the ammonium rotor. The two effective energies lie below the bare librational transition of 13.4 meV measured by neutrons, as expected for a self-energy scale. The ammonium linewidths, by contrast, are governed by pure dephasing rather than by anharmonic decay and carry no crossover signature. Under pressure the octahedral modes stiffen smoothly, whereas the cavity responds twice: the translational F2g mode of NH4+ gains Raman intensity above 1.3 GPa, and the N-H stretch inverts its pressure slope near 1.7 GPa, with no change of space group and full recovery on decompression. The rigid octahedral framework is thus essentially decoupled from a dynamically active NH4+ subsystem that carries the response to both perturbations, offering a route to tune cation-phonon coupling independently of the octahedral network.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过单晶X射线衍射和拉曼光谱（10-300 K，最高10.1 GPa），发现(NH4)2SnCl6中NH4+的摆动运动虽然对称性上拉曼禁戒，但可通过其对[SnCl6]2-模式的再归一化间接观测。低于~100 K时八面体模式出现libron-声子再归一化（E_eff~4.7 meV）和线不对称性，N-H伸缩在~120 K出现最小值（E_eff~9.3 meV），均追踪铵转子经典-量子交叉。压力下八面体模式平滑硬化，而空腔响应两次：F2g平移模式在1.3 GPa以上获得拉曼强度，N-H伸缩在1.7 GPa附近压力斜率反转，且完全可逆。刚性八面体框架与动态活跃的NH4+子系统基本解耦。
AI.motivation: 空缺有序钙钛矿R2MX6结合了刚性无机框架和分子A位阳离子，但外部扰动下阳离子动力学与晶格声子的耦合关系尚未被充分探索。特别是NH4+的摆动运动因对称性严格拉曼禁戒，以往只能用中子散射、NMR和NQR探测，缺乏拉曼光谱这一便捷且高分辨的探测手段。
AI.method: 将单晶X射线衍射与变温（10-300 K）和变压（至10.1 GPa）拉曼散射相结合，通过观测NH4+运动对允许的[SnCl6]2-振动模式的再归一化效应（有效自能、线不对称性）、N-H伸缩峰位移及其压力依赖，间接表征铵转子的动力学行为及其与晶格声子的耦合。
AI.result: 平均立方结构随温度和压力平滑变化无异常；低于~100 K时[SnCl6]2-模式获得libron-声子再归一化（E_eff~4.7 meV）和对称选择性线不对称性，N-H伸缩在~120 K出现最小值（E_eff~9.3 meV），两者均追踪铵转子经典-量子交叉；两个有效能量低于裸摆动跃迁13.4 meV。铵线宽由纯退相控制而非非谐衰减。压力下八面体模式平滑硬化，NH4+的F2g平移模式在1.3 GPa以上获得拉曼强度，N-H伸缩在1.7 GPa附近斜率反转，无空间群变化且完全可逆恢复。
AI.conclusion: 刚性八面体框架本质上与动态活跃的NH4+子系统解耦，NH4+子系统单独承载对外部扰动的响应。这为独立于八面体网络调控阳离子-声子耦合提供了可行途径，同时展示了用拉曼光谱探测对称性禁戒的分子运动的新方法。

title: Predictive wavelength tailoring of uniform GaSb-based quantum dots for emission at 1.55 um
summary: A detailed study of emission wavelength tailoring of GaSb-based QDs formed by InGaSb-filling of droplet-etched nanoholes in AlGaSb is presented. The study shows that the emission wavelength can be modified from 1.48 um to the center of the telecom C-band at 1.55 mm by independently varying the QD composition and size. More specifically, the optical transition energy shifts linearly as a function of In-content of the QD material at a rate of -4.4 meV/In-percentage, and with the number of monolayers (ML) of material used for filling the nanoholes, at -2.0 meV/ML. These experimentally observed energy shifts are well predicted by simulations yielding rates of -4.3 meV/In-percentage and -2.1 meV/ML, respectively. For the simulation, a uniform In composition, low intermixing, and microscopically measured QD geometry is considered. Additionally, excellent ensemble QD uniformity, with unprecedented inhomogeneous broadening well-below 7 meV across all samples is demonstrated. Finally, photoluminescence of single-QDs reveals narrow excitonic emission lines of 13.8+/-6.7 ueV and low fine-structure splitting values reaching <10 ueV. These results identify GaSb-based LDE QDs as a tunable telecom platform for scaling quantum-photonic applications over long-haul optical fiber networks.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了基于GaSb的量子点(QDs)的发光波长调控，通过InGaSb填充液滴刻蚀的纳米孔洞实现。发射波长可从1.48μm调谐至电信C波段中心1.55μm，通过独立调节QD组分和尺寸实现。实验测得光学跃迁能量随In含量线性变化(-4.4 meV/In%)和随单层数线性变化(-2.0 meV/ML)，与模拟结果高度吻合。器件展现优异的均匀性(非均匀展宽<7 meV)、窄激子发射线宽(13.8±6.7 μeV)和低细结构分裂(<10 μeV)，被确认为可调谐的电信平台。
AI.motivation: 面向长距离光纤网络的量子光子应用需要工作在电信C波段的可调谐量子光源。GaSb基量子点具有潜在优势，但此前缺乏对其波长调控机制的系统性研究，需要建立组分与尺寸对发射波长影响的定量关系。
AI.method: 采用InGaSb填充液滴刻蚀纳米孔洞(LDE)方法形成GaSb基量子点；通过独立变化In含量和填充单层数(ML)来调控QD组分与尺寸；结合实验光致发光测量与基于均匀In组分、低互混假设的数值模拟进行对比验证。
AI.result: 波长可从1.48μm调至1.55μm(C波段)；跃迁能量随In含量线性变化速率-4.4 meV/In%(模拟-4.3)，随ML变化速率-2.0 meV/ML(模拟-2.1)；所有样品非均匀展宽<7 meV；单QD激子线宽13.8±6.7 μeV，细结构分裂<10 μeV。
AI.conclusion: GaSb基LDE量子点被确认为可调谐的电信平台，兼具波长可调控性、优异的均匀性和单光子性能，适用于长距离光纤网络中可扩展的量子光子应用。

title: Two-step transient liquid phase bonding of NiTi to Ti-6Al-4V through a NbZrW barrier
summary: Dissimilar joining of NiTi to Ti-6Al-4V (Ti-64) is limited by brittle Ti2Ni formation and degradation of NiTi functionality. A two-step transient liquid phase (TLP) route was developed in which a refractory NbZrW diffusion barrier converts the incompatible couple into two independently bondable interfaces. The barrier plays a different role for each alloy: a reactive substrate for NiTi, dissolving to form a Ti-rich Ni-Ti-Nb liquid that infiltrates its own grain boundaries and is terminated by selective Ti absorption into the barrier; and an inert substrate for Ti-64, joined through contact melting of a sacrificial Cu foil. Both interfaces are fully dense and free of continuous intermetallic layers. In tension, joints spanning both interfaces began transforming at 350 MPa, exhibited a stress plateau to 2.5 global strain (consistent with stress-induced transformation of the NiTi half of the gauge) and failed beyond the plateau at 380-410 MPa. Five load-unload cycles to 460 MPa showed stable superelastic loops with minor ratcheting. These results demonstrate that a diffusion barrier enables dissimilar TLP joining of otherwise incompatible alloys.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种两步瞬态液相(TLP)连接工艺，通过引入难熔NbZrW扩散屏障，将NiTi与Ti-6Al-4V这对不相容合金的异种连接转化为两个可独立键合的界面。该工艺成功获得了无连续金属间化合物层、完全致密的接头，且在拉伸和循环载荷下展现出良好的超弹性行为。
AI.motivation: NiTi与Ti-6Al-4V的直接异种连接受限于脆性Ti2Ni金属间化合物的形成以及NiTi功能性的退化，传统方法难以同时解决这两个问题。因此需要一种新的连接策略来克服该不相容性。
AI.method: 采用两步TLP连接路线：1) NiTi侧利用NbZrW扩散屏障作为反应性基板，溶解形成富Ti的Ni-Ti-Nb液态金属沿晶界渗透，并通过Ti选择性吸收终止反应；2) Ti-64侧利用牺牲性Cu箔的接触熔化，将屏障作为惰性基板进行连接。两个界面均通过屏障独立优化。
AI.result: 两个界面均完全致密且无连续金属间化合物层。拉伸测试中，接头在350 MPa开始相变，应力平台延伸至2.5%全局应变（与NiTi半侧应力诱发马氏体相变一致），在380-410 MPa超出平台后失效。五次460 MPa的加载-卸载循环表现出稳定的超弹性滞回环，仅有轻微棘轮效应。
AI.conclusion: 扩散屏障策略使原本不相容的合金体系可通过TLP工艺实现高质量异种连接，同时保留了NiTi的超弹性功能特性，为类似不相容材料体系的连接提供了通用性解决方案。

title: Coexistence of polariton bound states in the continuum and 2D radiative excitons
summary: Bound states in the continuum (BICs) enable optical modes with ideally infinite radiative lifetimes despite lying within the radiation continuum. Radiation-matter interaction in periodically patterned planar waveguides embedding two-dimensional (2D) optically active excitations can be described quantum mechanically by diagonalizing a non-Hermitian operator, known as the Hopfield matrix, which can be generalized to incorporate independent photonic and excitonic losses into the polaritonic states. However, since 2D excitons undergo intrinsic wavevector-dependent radiative decay within the light cone, whether the Hopfield formalism can consistently account for this process while preserving polariton BICs has remained an open question. Here we show that a non-Hermitian Hopfield formalism incorporating excitonic radiative losses correctly captures the existence of genuine $k=0$ polariton BICs with diverging radiative lifetimes. The theory provides a unified microscopic framework for radiative excitons and polariton BICs, and an efficient predictive tool for designing photonic-crystal platforms coupled to quantum wells, transition-metal dichalcogenides, and other 2D excitonic materials.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了包含激子辐射损耗的非厄米Hopfield形式体系能够正确描述k=0极化激元连续谱束缚态（BICs），其辐射寿命趋于发散，为辐射激子与极化激元BIC提供了统一的微观理论框架。
AI.motivation: 二维激子在光锥内具有固有的波矢依赖辐射衰变，此前尚不清楚Hopfield形式体系能否在保持极化激元BICs的同时一致地描述这一过程。
AI.method: 通过推广包含独立光子和激子损耗的非厄米Hopfield矩阵，引入激子辐射损耗项，并求解该非厄米算符的本征问题来研究极化激元BICs的性质。
AI.result: 证明了包含激子辐射损耗的非厄米Hopfield形式体系能够正确获得k=0极化激元BICs，其辐射寿命发散，为设计耦合量子阱、过渡金属硫化物等二维激子材料的光子晶体平台提供了高效预测工具。
AI.conclusion: 该理论统一了辐射激子与极化激元BIC的微观描述框架，为光子晶体与二维激子材料耦合平台的设计提供了有效工具。

title: Attosecond Reconstruction of Strain Tensors via Electronic Fingerprints
summary: We demonstrate an attosecond transient absorption spectroscopy (ATAS) scheme for reconstructing strain tensors in two-dimensional materials. Using strained graphene as a prototype system, we show that the fishbone structures in ATAS serve as distinctive spectral fingerprints of strain, where strain-induced shifts and splittings of van Hove singularities encode the magnitude and orientation of the strain tensor, respectively. By combining density-matrix simulations with analytical modeling, we establish a direct mapping between transient absorption spectra and strain tensors, enabling accurate retrieval of lattice deformation from ultrafast electronic responses. Our work introduces an attosecond spectroscopic paradigm for ultrafast strain metrology, where electronic fingerprints replace conventional structural probes for sensing lattice deformation in quantum materials.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种利用阿秒瞬态吸收光谱（ATAS）重建二维材料应变张量的新方案。以应变石墨烯为原型系统，揭示了ATAS中"鱼骨"结构作为应变的独特光谱指纹，其中van Hove奇异点的位移和劈裂分别编码应变的幅值和取向。通过密度矩阵模拟与分析建模结合，建立了瞬态吸收光谱与应变张量之间的直接映射，实现了从超快电子响应中精确反演晶格形变，为量子材料的超快应变计量开辟了新的阿秒光谱学范式。
AI.motivation: 传统的应变测量依赖于结构探针（如X射线衍射等），难以实现超快时间尺度下的应变动态监测。作者希望利用电子光谱指纹替代结构探针，以实现二维材料中超快应变张量的直接重建和计量。
AI.method: 采用阿秒瞬态吸收光谱（ATAS）技术，以应变石墨烯为原型系统。通过密度矩阵模拟模拟ATAS光谱，并结合解析建模建立光谱特征（鱼骨结构的位移与劈裂）与应变张量（幅值与取向）之间的直接映射关系，从而实现从瞬态吸收光谱中定量反演应变张量。
AI.result: 研究表明，ATAS中的鱼骨结构可作为应变的独特光谱指纹：应变引起的van Hove奇异点位移反映应变幅值，劈裂反映应变取向。结合密度矩阵模拟与解析模型，成功建立了从瞬态吸收光谱到应变张量的直接定量映射。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出了一种阿秒光谱学的新范式，用电子级指纹替代传统结构探针来感知量子材料中的晶格形变，为超快应变计量提供了全新的技术途径，有望推广到其他二维量子材料的应变动态研究。

title: Supermoiré Reconstruction and Topological Mosaics in Twisted Trilayer WSe$_2$ and MoTe$_2$
summary: We investigate lattice relaxation and band structures of helical and alternating twisted trilayer WSe$_2$ and MoTe$_2$ using machine-learning force fields and large-scale ab initio calculations. Interference between the two bilayer moiré lattices generates a supermoiré lattice that, upon relaxation, reconstructs into a few dominant domain types with locally commensurate bilayer moiré lattices. Because the systems lack $C_{2z}$ symmetry, domains otherwise related by this symmetry become energetically and topologically distinct, unlike in twisted trilayer graphene. Band structure calculations show that the topmost valence bands originate from the $K$ ($K'$) valleys and carry domain-dependent valley Chern numbers. The resulting supermoiré lattice hosts a mosaic of topologically inequivalent domains, offering a platform for exploring correlated and topological physics.

AI.tldr: 本文利用机器学习力场和大规模从头计算，研究了螺旋和交替扭曲三层WSe₂和MoTe₂的晶格弛豫与能带结构。两个双层莫尔晶格干涉产生超莫尔晶格，弛豫后重构为少数具有局域共度双层莫尔晶格的主导畴。由于系统缺乏C₂z对称性，这些畴在能量和拓扑上变得不同（不同于扭曲三层石墨烯）。能带计算表明最顶层价带来自K(K')谷，具有依赖于畴的谷陈数。由此形成的超莫尔晶格包含拓扑不等价的畴嵌合体，为关联和拓扑物理研究提供了平台。
AI.motivation: 探索扭曲三层过渡金属硫属化物（TMD）中双层莫尔干涉产生的超莫尔晶格行为，并揭示其弛豫后重构的畴结构及其拓扑性质，特别关注C₂z对称性缺失导致的畴拓扑不等价性——这是扭曲三层石墨烯中不存在的物理。
AI.method: 采用机器学习力场进行大尺度晶格弛豫模拟，结合大规模从头计算（ab initio）研究能带结构；分析螺旋与交替两种堆垛构型的扭曲三层WSe₂和MoTe₂。
AI.result: 1) 双层莫尔晶格干涉产生超莫尔晶格，弛豫后重构为少数主导畴类型；2) 因缺乏C₂z对称性，畴间不再存在对称性关联，在能量和拓扑上彼此不同；3) 最顶层价带源自K(K')谷，各畴具有不同的谷陈数。
AI.conclusion: 超莫尔晶格可承载拓扑不等价畴组成的镶嵌结构，为研究关联电子态和拓扑物理提供了新的平台。

title: Coexisting Large and Small Polarons in Photoexcited CeO$_2$
summary: Time-resolved terahertz (THz) spectroscopy is used to probe polaron formation in CeO$_2$. The ultrafast THz photoconductivity is dominated by contributions from large hole and small electron polarons. Delocalized large hole polarons are formed on a $820 \pm 50$ fs time scale and are of Fröhlich type, with optical conductivity well described by a simple Drude model and a transient hole mobility of $100$ cm$^2$/Vs. Small electron polarons form via localized coupling to Ce lattice sites, revealed by reduction in the lattice Born effective charge causing a transient phonon softening. These results establish the dual polaron nature of CeO$_2$ and provide a basis for understanding charge transfer dynamics in metal oxide photocatalysts.

AI.tldr: 本文利用时间分辨太赫兹光谱研究了CeO₂中的极化子形成过程，发现其光导率主要由大空穴极化子和小电子极化子贡献。大空穴极化子在约820飞秒内形成（Fröhlich型，可用Drude模型描述，瞬态空穴迁移率100 cm²/Vs），而小电子极化子通过与Ce晶格位点的局域耦合形成，导致晶格Born有效电荷降低和声子软化。这些结果确立了CeO₂的双极化子本质。
AI.motivation: 理解CeO₂中极化子形成的超快动力学过程，为揭示金属氧化物光催化剂中的电荷转移机制提供理论基础。
AI.method: 采用时间分辨太赫兹光谱技术探测CeO₂中的超快光导率变化，结合Drude模型分析光导率谱，并通过晶格Born有效电荷的变化（声子软化）来识别小电子极化子的形成。
AI.result: 大空穴极化子在820±50 fs时间尺度上形成，属Fröhlich型，迁移率约100 cm²/Vs；小电子极化子通过局域Ce晶格耦合形成，伴随声子软化。
AI.conclusion: CeO₂同时具有大空穴极化子和小电子极化子的双极化子特性，为理解金属氧化物光催化剂中的电荷转移动力学提供了重要基础。

title: Local phase-space Berry curvature and Hall transport in textured twisted bilayer graphene
summary: Slow twist-angle and heterostrain textures in twisted bilayer graphene provide a natural route to phase-space Berry geometry. We show that a purely geometric tetrad/shift sector does not generate mixed Berry curvature once the spin connection is treated consistently. By contrast, a projected textured mini-Dirac cone in twisted bilayer graphene acquires genuine mixed phase-space curvature. We analyze a controlled local Hall-bar limit with a one-dimensional texture and mirror $M_x$. In that limit the pseudogauge gradient renormalizes only the longitudinal conductivity along the textured direction, while a dc nonlinear Hall response appears only when an additional valley-odd tilt generates a Berry-curvature dipole. Both geometric responses peak at the same local filling, $μ_{\rm loc}=\sqrt{2}\,m$, providing a gate-tunable fingerprint of their common origin. All local-cone parameters and their texture susceptibilities are extracted from a heterostrained Bistritzer-MacDonald model at $θ=1.3^\circ$. The tilt invoked in the transport estimates corresponds to heterostrain of only $0.03\%-0.2\%$, below values routinely imaged in devices. The resulting theory provides a local analytic framework for textured moiré Dirac materials and cleanly separates geometric, texture-induced, and transport-level ingredients relevant to realistic TBG.

AI.tldr: 本文研究扭转双层石墨烯（TBG）中慢扭转角度梯度和异质应变纹理如何产生相空间Berry几何效应。作者证明纯几何tetrad/shift扇区在一致处理自旋联络时不产生混合Berry曲率，但投影纹理化mini-Dirac锥会产生真实的混合相空间曲率。在一维纹理和镜面对称M_x的局部霍尔棒极限下，赝规范梯度仅重整化沿纹理方向的纵向电导，而直流非线性霍尔响应仅当额外的谷奇倾斜产生Berry曲率偶极子时才出现。两种几何响应在同一局域填充处达到峰值，提供栅极可调的指纹特征。
AI.motivation: 探索扭转双层石墨烯中由慢扭转角梯度和异质应变纹理诱导的几何响应，特别是相空间Berry曲率效应及其在输运性质中的可观测表现，为理解纹理化moiré狄拉克材料提供理论框架。
AI.method: 通过理论分析结合数值计算：1) 严格处理具有扭转/应变纹理的TBG中的tetrad/shift几何，证明纯几何扇区不产生混合Berry曲率；2) 建立投影纹理化mini-Dirac锥模型，获取真实混合相空间曲率；3) 分析局部霍尔棒极限（一维纹理+M_x对称），推导电导与非线性霍尔响应；4) 从异质应变Bistritzer-MacDonald模型（θ=1.3°）提取所有局域锥参数及其纹理敏感性。
AI.result: 发现赝规范梯度仅重整化沿纹理方向的纵向电导；dc非线性霍尔响应需要谷奇倾斜产生Berry曲率偶极子；两种几何响应在μ_loc=√2 m处同时达到峰值；输运估计所需的异质应变仅为0.03%-0.2%，远低于器件中常规观测到的值。
AI.conclusion: 该理论为纹理化moire狄拉克材料提供了局域解析框架，清晰区分了几何扇区、纹理诱导效应和输运层面因素，为真实TBG中的几何响应研究提供了可验证的预测。

title: Covariant formula for the driving force for interface migration
summary: Interfaces of crystalline materials are strongly affected by the anisotropy of interface energy. A key quantity in this context is the interface stiffness tensor, which characterizes the response of the interface energy to changes in interface orientation and plays a role in determining the driving force for interface migration. The latter is expressible via contraction of the stiffness tensor and interface curvature tensor. Practical computations involving tensors necessarily rely on their individual components. In this work, an explicit component-wise expression is derived for the contraction of the stiffness and curvature tensors, valid in arbitrary coordinate systems. Within this formulation, to get the driving force, the curvature tensor is contracted with the pullback of a stiffness-related tensor - originally defined in three-dimensional Euclidean space - onto the interface manifold.
